This paper conducts AC voltage discharge experiments on floating conductors with different diameters and lengths under different electrode structures and combines with electric field simulation for analysis. In the rod-plane gap and small sphere- plane gap, the breakdown voltage curves show an initial increase followed by a decrease as the floating conductor moves away from the high voltage electrode. For the large sphere-plane gap, the breakdown voltage curve shows an increasing trend, and the phenomenon of the discharge the sub-gap between floating conductors occurs when the conductors are near the high voltage electrode, thereby influencing the breakdown voltage.

articleTitle: Planning Microgrids in Industrial Parks Considering the Uncertainty of Carbon Price and Renewable Energy: A Stochastic Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The concerns about limiting carbon emissions and controlling global warming promote the decarbonization of the energy sector. The microgrid can integrate different energy sources and increase renewable penetration by balancing the local supplies and demands flexibly. The introduction of the carbon pricing mechanism further impels the energy transition from fossil-fuel generation to renewable generation. However, the uncertainty of renewable outputs and carbon pricing challenges microgrid planning. In this paper, we propose a stochastic optimization model for planning microgrids in industrial parks. It includes three parts: the retirement of existing fossil fuel generators, the deployment of renewable generators, and the installation of energy storage systems. Typical scenarios are generated and reduced to simulate the fluctuations of renewable outputs and carbon price. An adaptive genetic algorithm is adopted to solve the proposed planning model. The case study result verifies the effectiveness of the proposed model and indicates that the proposed model can provide reasonable microgrid planning strategies.

articleTitle: Fast Computational Modeling of Probabilistic Available Transfer Capability Combining Deep Learning and Approximation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing penetration of new energy sources in the power system, it is difficult for traditional methods to effectively characterize the probabilistic nature of the available transfer capability (ATC). This paper proposes a fast calculation method for probabilistic available transfer capability based on deep learning and approximation methods. First, an ATC prediction model based on Bayesian optimized CatBoost(BO-CatBoost) is constructed to quickly obtain the ATC corresponding to the estimated point in the operating scenario, and the shapley additive expIations (SHAP) is used to improve the interpretability and credibility of the model. Then the improved multi-point estimation method (IMPEM) is used to construct the estimated points, and the moment information of the ATC is quickly obtained by combining with the ATC prediction model. Finally, we use the maximum entropy (ME) to fit the probability density function based on the moment information. The performance of the proposed method in different scenarios and its advantages over the traditional methods are verified using a modified IEEE39 node system.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Basic Properties and Thermal Oxidation Aging Performance for Synthetic Ester Insulating Oils
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Synthetic ester insulating oil is an excellent alternative to traditional mineral insulating oil due to its high flash point, biodegradability, and low carbon emissions. Its application enhances the reliability of power equipment operation and meets the demand for green power development. Midel 7131 is the preferred commercial synthetic ester insulating oil product internationally. Although other newly developed synthetic ester insulating oils have emerged, their practical applications in environmentally friendly transformers are hindered by a lack of comprehensive performance evaluation and comparison. Therefore, this paper evaluates the physicochemical properties, insulation properties, and thermal oxidation aging performance of Midel 7131, PA, SJ, and ZK. The results demonstrate that the physicochemical properties of ZK and Midel 7131 are comparable. SJ and ZK exhibit superior insulation performance in comparison with Midel 7131. After a seven-day closed thermal oxidation aging process, four synthetic ester insulating oils exhibit minimal changes in properties except for the acid value.

articleTitle: Study on Influence of Processing Methods on Loss Coefficients of Iron Loss Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The process manufacturing of silicon steel wafers significantly influences their magnetic properties, as well as hysteresis and eddy current losses within the Bertotti iron consumption separation model. However, the current study does not consider the loss coefficients of the constituent parts as variables, which change with variations in magnetic density magnitude and frequency. It is crucial to analyze these loss coefficients in relation to the fluctuations in magnetic density magnitude and frequency under different processing processes, and to provide relevant reference values. This paper employs the Ionel algorithm to extract hysteresis loss coefficient, empirical coefficient, eddy current loss coefficient and stray loss coefficient of the Bertotti loss separation model. It establishes a mathematical model for material parameters with respect to magnetic flux density and frequency, analyzing the effects of various processing techniques on the loss coefficients. The study provides a reference for selecting processing techniques and loss coefficients, aiming to reduce iron losses and improve motor efficiency.

articleTitle: Temperature Rise Calculation Method of Aircraft Wire Based on Fluid-Heat Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cable is an important part of aircraft, and its temperature rise directly affects the safety and reliability of the aircraft. Accurate calculation of cable temperature rise can minimize cable weight, reduce aircraft manufacturing costs, and enhance aircraft economy and competitiveness. With the continuous development of multi-electric/all-electric aircraft, the complexity and integration of aircraft cables are increasing, as well as the special requirements of CCAR-25 Division H for civil aircraft EWIS (Electrical Wiring Interconnection System), modern aircraft have extremely strict requirements for EWIS cable design. Due to the low precision and limited application scenarios, the previous standards are no longer suitable for new development situations, while existing research lacks comprehensive consideration of various environmental factors. Therefore, this article proposes a wire temperature rise calculation method based on fluid thermal coupling, which combines accuracy and speed. Based on the needs of aircraft scenarios, this article considers the impact of environmental temperature and pressure changes with altitude on temperature rise calculation. Finally, the correctness of the proposed method was verified through experimental testing.

articleTitle: Research and Application on the Method of Rotor Winding Sweep Frequency Impedance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To increase the sensitivity of detecting the rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault, we developed a new rotor winding deformation detection system based on sweep frequency impedance(SFI) method, a double water internal cooling condenser and a fault simulator generator was tested separately by the system, and a 660MW generator rotor was detected and analyzed by artificial short circuit fault. The results show that the SFI detection system has a high repeatability, the rotor winding inter-turn short circuit fault will change the data of low frequency including the value of SFI curve at 50 Hz, it will significantly change the value of maximum resonance peak, and its degree of change is significantly higher than the other resonance peaks.

articleTitle: Mesoporous Activated Carbon Derived from Corn Stalk as Supercapacitor Electrodes
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Activated carbon (AC) is a promising electrode material for supercapacitors due to its excellent cycling stability. However, the synthesis of AC with significant performance is still limited. The development of AC preparation is important for supercapacitors. Herein, AC derived from corn stalks was prepared. The crystal structure and morphological properties can be modified by changing the ratio of corn stalk and potassium hydroxide (CS: KOH). Specific capacitances were 63.53, 88.24, and 70.5 F g-l in 1 M KOH electrolyte at the current density of 1 A g-l for the CS: KOH ratios of 1:1, 1:2, and 1:3, respectively. Moreover, it still maintained a capacitance retention ratio of 92.4 % at a current density of 8 A g-l after 50,000 cycles. Hence, based on the insights gained, optimized synthesis routes of AC can provide a reference for high-performance and long-life-span supercapacitor electrodes.

articleTitle: Plug-in Harmonic Voltage Mitigation for Variable Frequency Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The variable frequency AC electrical power system has become the mainstream of future more electric aircrafts (MEAs). With the increasing use of aviation DC load equipment, the quality of DC bus power supply becomes increasingly important. To supply the DC bus voltage from AC generators, transformer diode rectifier units are conventionally used, which are straightforward and reliable. However, the output of passive rectifier units contains massive harmonic distortions that degrade the power quality. To solve this issue, Considering the energy storage batteries for the existing auxiliary power in the aircraft's variable frequency A C units, this paper develops a plug-in harmonic mitigation technique based on the existing DC/DC converter. The variance of AC voltage frequency, i.e., 360Hz-800Hz, is first identified by a frequency-locked loop (FLL). On this basis, harmonic compensation is implemented using a voltage resonant control method, frequency-adaptive harmonic compensation is realized through an auxiliary function of the DC/DC converter. In addition, a proportional-integral (PI) control method is employed to regulate the output power of the energy storage battery. Finally, simulation results validate the feasibility of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: A Novel Model Predictive Control Strategy Based on Passivity for DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the strong controllability and high reliability of DC microgrids, it has become the predominant power supply system in the field of power electronics today. Owing to the access of loads, energy storage devices, photovoltaic, and other subsystems. The performance characteristics of microgrid control are complex. However, the traditional linear control makes it difficult to meet the high dynamic performance requirements of the microgrid. In order to improve the control effect, nonlinear control methods are widely used nowadays. In this paper, a novel control strategy named PB-FCSMPC is employed, which is based on finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) and passivity-based control (PBC). To verify the control effect of the scheme, the Euler-Lagrange (EL) model of the boost converter is established, and the passive controller is designed using the damping injection method. Then, the output voltage obtained from the passive control equation is embedded in the FCS-MPC cost function to ensure predictive control and achieve multi-obj ective optimization. Finally, simulation experiments are conducted to validate the proposed control strategy in the boost converter. In a comparative simulation analysis, the control results of the proposed control strategy are compared with the conventional PBC, which validated that the PB-FCSMPC has better dynamic performance.

articleTitle: Model Identification of Grid-following System for Stability Evaluation with Transient Data
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To accurately identify the dynamic behaviors of inverter-based resources in the time domain for stability evaluation. This paper proposes a model identification method only with operation data for the general grid-following system. Firstly, a general grid-following (GFL) system's structure is introduced and clarified into several standard blocks. The doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) and high-voltage direct current (HVDC) system are further illustrated. Secondly, the core idea of the proposed method is formulated as a regression form, and the transient data combined with the corresponding GFL model blocks constitute several parallel regression problems. Then, the regression problem is solved using a sequentially thresholded least-squares algorithm. Lastly, a typical DFIG integrated with HVDC lines is tested using the proposed method in the time domain to show its effectiveness, and a pole plot evaluates the damping of modes. This study contributes significantly to acquiring a precise online model for real-time damping estimation, participation analysis, and adaptive control.

articleTitle: Temperature Aging Characteristics of Zinc Oxide Varistors at DC Overvoltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Operating temperature was one of the factors affecting the performance of zinc oxide varistors. A kind of test method of DC aging under constant temperature heating was presented and the experimental study was carried. The volt-ampere characteristics of zinc oxide varistors before and after aging at different temperatures were obtained through comparison experiments. It was found that, after DC aging, the threshold voltage of ZnO varistors increased. The effect of temperature on the band gap of ZnO varistor ceramics was not significant, but the relative dielectric constant of grain boundary decreased with the temperature increasing and the goodness of linear fitting decreased significantly.

articleTitle: Research on the Linearization Relationship of Small Disturbances in Converter Interfaced AC Power Systems Based on Operating Points of Internal-voltage Amplitude/Frequency and Active/Reactive Current
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Oscillation problems with unknown mechanisms often occur in today's power systems, resulting in serious consequences such as equipment damage or even off-grid. However, existing methods are difficult to adapt to new forms of system analysis and have certain limitations. In this paper, starting from the understanding of the objective dynamic process of AC power system, and taking the converter grid-connected AC system as an example, firstly, the basic operation principle of the power system is elaborated, and the internal voltage amplitude/ frequency and active/reactive current operating points of the AC power system and their energy connotations are clarified, and then based on that, the internal voltage amplitude/frequency and active/reactive current small perturbation relationship of the converter grid-connected AC system and its linearization method are proposed, and finally the influence of the system structural control parameters on the stability of the system is explored and analyzed. The method proposed in this paper reveals the root cause of the oscillation phenomenon from the physical mechanism, which can provide a theoretical basis for the subsequent oscillation suppression.

articleTitle: Method of Enhanced Robust Control of the DC-DC Converters Based on Adaptive Nonlinear State Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In an effort to enhance the dynamic performance and reduce interference in the DC-DC boost converter, this paper proposes an improved active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) methodology. Firstly, the converter's dynamic model is implemented, treating all system uncertainties as the collective disturbance present in the input side. To achieve heightened estimation precision and quicker dynamic response, a novel adaptive nonlinear state observer (ANSO) is established to assess the potential disturbance, distinguishing it from the conventional extended state observer (ESO). Subsequently, a linear feedback control law is devised to counteract the disturbance and regulate the output voltage, ensuring stability throughout the entire closed-loop system. Finally, the good performance of the proposed approach is substantiated through simulation results.

articleTitle: A Multi-Phase Capacitive Coupling Structure Based Capacitive Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes an 800 W power level high frequency three-phase power inversion capacitive wireless power transfer (CPT) system. The multi-phase coupling structure is built with a metal column coupling structure. This paper innovatively puts forward a six-metal plate curved structure coupling coupler. It will improve the mutual capacitance of the coupling structure and power transfer capacity of the CPT system. Concurrently, the column coupler structure could minimize the installation space and enhance the system's resistance to drift. It could help to solve problems of charging voltage and current fluctuations caused in dynamic environment. The wireless power transfer capacity could be also promoted. The experiments were carried out in air medium. An 800 W experimental results have a good match with the theory analysis. The peak 80% power transfer efficiency with the air medium are achieved with the stable operation performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Simultaneous Wireless Power and Data Transfer System Based on DDR Coil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize a high-power, high-rate transmission system, it is necessary to improve the bandwidth and signal-to-noise ratio. In this paper, the Multiple inductive channels-simultaneously wireless power and data transmission (MIC-SWPDT) system is constructed by using DDR coils, two pairs of independent coils are isolated from the physical structure, and the magnetic fields are orthogonal to each other and decoupled in order to reduce the mutual interference. We also carry out the parameter design and transmission characteristics of the energy transmission circuit and information transmission circuit, establish the time domain model of the information transmission circuit, analyze the influence of different parameters on the information transmission gain and conversion time, and provide guidance for the parameter design. Finally, an experimental platform is set up to complete the synchronous transmission of energy and information at 5kw and 200kbps, which verifies the feasibility of the design.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method of Automobile Engine Based on GA-BP Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The distortion of secondary voltage waveform of automotive engine ignition system can reflect the fault information of different parts of the engine. At present, digital multimeter, automotive ignition oscilloscope and other manual diagnosis methods are usually used to analyze voltage waveform to judge the fault, which requires high technical knowledge and experience. This paper proposes an artificial intelligence diagnosis method based on GA-BP algorithm. In this paper, the secondary ignition voltage waveform is deeply analyzed and the key parameters reflected in the fault information are extracted as the input of GA-BP fault diagnosis model. The fault diagnosis model based on GA-BP algorithm is used for pattern recognition in order to locate the fault positions. This paper takes the Honda Accord engine failure as an example, the GA-BP fault diagnosis model is used for MATLAB simulation analysis. The simulation results show that the fault diagnosis method based on the GA-BP model can intelligently identify the engine ignition system failure efficiently and accurately.

articleTitle: Aircraft DC Arc Fault Detection Approach Based on Sliding Time Window with Peak-to-Peak Value and Spectrum Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Arc fault is a serious discharge phenomenon that can damage insulation systems and cause electrical fires. With the development of aircraft towards multi-electrical and all-electrical., the problem of arcing faults in the aircraft will become more and more serious. Therefore, the development of the arc fault detection method in the aircraft electrical system is urgent. An aircraft 270 V and 28 V DC electrical system are built in this paper. Series arc experiments with different type of resistive loads and capacitive loads are carried out. The time and frequency domain fault characteristics of the arc current are analyzed, and a sliding time-window threshold arc fault detection method based on peak-to-peak value and spectrum integration is proposed. The proposed algorithm is validated using the available experimental data, which proves the practicality of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Optimized Design and Modelica Simulation Study of Fast Locking Mechanism Based on Fault-Tolerant Control of Dual-Winding Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article takes the fast locking mechanism as the application background and uses a daul-winding permanent magnet synchronous motor instead of the permanent magnet synchronous motor as the actuator of the motor drive system to ensure high reliability of the system. The motor is characterized by having two sets of stator windings with a phase shift angle of 0 and sharing a set of rotors, forming a double redundant structure. The controller, driver and other parts also use dual-channel, hot backup working mode to control the drive unit motors respectively to further ensure the reliability of the system. Based on the mature vector control strategy and planned fault working mode, the entire rapid locking mechanism is cross-coupled and modeled in the multi-domain simulation platform Dymola/ Modelica, and corresponding mechanical, electrical, control and other modules are built. Finally, based on the actual working conditions of the fast locking mechanism, the corresponding speed curve is planned, and the entire system is simulated in fault-free, single-channel, hot backup mode to verify the correctness and fault tolerance of the redundant design.

articleTitle: Optimization of multilayered insulation performance by regulating temperature-dependent conductivity coefficient
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the flexible DC transmission system, the internal discharge of the optical fiber insulator may be caused by the mismatch of the characteristics between the materials. The conductivity of the outer coating layer varies significantly with temperature, which leads to a particularly serious problem of mismatched conductivity at the optical fiber. In this paper, the outer coating layer was modified by adding nano-AlsOa particles to reduce the conductivity temperature coefficient. The surface potential decay was used to analyze the trap change after the modification of the outer coating layer. The high temperature and high field conductivity test was used to analyze the change of conductivity temperature coefficient after the modification of the outer coating layer. The differential scanning calorimeter was used to analyze the change of glass transition temperature after the modification of the outer coating layer. The results showed that after the incorporation of nano-alumina particles, the deep traps increase, the conductivity temperature coefficient decreases, and the glass transition temperature increases. The conductivity mismatch problem at the fiber surface is reduced.

Index Terms: Increase In The Glass Transition Temperature

articleTitle: Characteristics Analysis of the Wireless Power Transfer System Using LCC/S Unilateral Magnetic Integrated Compensation Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The characteristics of the wireless power transfer (WPT) system based on LCC/S unilateral magnetic integrated compensation circuit are analyzed in this paper, including output power, transmission efficiency and turn-off current of the inverter. Magnetic integrated topology has the advantage of small volume and can also improve the misalignment tolerance. By modeling the integrated compensation circuit, the system characteristics under variable load and offset distances are studied. Moreover, the influence of the capacitance connected in series with the transmitting coil on the output power is also analyzed. Finally, the theoretical analysis is verified by the experiments. The results show that the error between experimental values and theoretical values of the transmission power and turn-off current of the inverter is small, and the misalignment tolerance of the WPT system can be improved.

articleTitle: Reliability-Oriented Design Study of Dual-Channel Manual Cockpit Opening Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In response to the frequent failures and multiple malfunctions of the manual opening mechanism for aircraft cockpit canopies, this paper proposes a dual-channel manual opening mechanism. This mechanism allows for the manual opening of the cockpit canopy from inside the cockpit in case of failure of the electric opening method. Additionally, it enables ground personnel to manually open the cockpit canopy from the outside. A reliability analysis model of the transmission system gear structure, based on finite element method and subset simulation method, is developed. Combining digital simulation methods, the design analysis of the transmission system gear structure is conducted, and the relevant physical parameters of the proposed manual opening mechanism are obtained. Subsequently, simulations are performed to verify the reliability of the proposed manual opening mechanism and to assess the variations in contact force. Finally, high reliability and practicality of the opening mechanism are confirmed through simulated experiments and experimental validation.

articleTitle: Comparative Study and Evaluation of Doubly Salient PM Motors with Different Stator/Rotor-Pole Number Combinations and Stator Iron Core Segments
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study and evaluation of doubly salient PM (DSPM) motors with different stator/rotor-pole number combinations and stator iron core segments. Firstly, their machine topologies and working principles are described. Thereafter, electromagnetic performance is analyzed under no-load and load conditions, mainly including back-EMFs (back-electromotive forces), cogging torque, inductances, and so on. The results reveal that by changing conventional E-core segment of stator and 12/8-pole combination, the 12/11- and 12/13-pole T-core DSPM motors benefits from very low torque ripple, although the torque is slightly reduced.

articleTitle: Simulation Analysis of Electromagnetic and Heat Field Distribution in 330kV High Voltage AC Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Power cable, as a carrier of electric energy in the power system, has an important role in high-voltage large-capacity power transmission. With the exponential growth of China's power demand, the voltage level and line length are constantly rising, the thermal stability and fixture reliability of cable operation gradually decline. The cable will be subjected to three kinds of stresses, electric, magnetic and thermal, under the operating conditions of industrial frequency, this paper simulates and analyzes the electromagnetic heat of 330 kV high-voltage AC cable in the case of industrial frequency, and obtains the distribution of the cable flux density distribution and temperature field distribution, and finds that the maximum internal magnetic flux density is 2.6 mT while the minimum is 1.0 mT, and the maximum temperature of the cable operation is 316.26 K. The thermal effect is significantly weakened at the location of the copper core and the metal shield, where the thermal conductivity is large. Due to the skin effect, the magnetic flux density and temperature both spread outward from the center of the cable, increasing and then decreasing, reaching a maximum value near the surface of the core, while near the interface of the metal shield, the magnetic flux density instantly decreases to zero.

articleTitle: Measurement of Capacity Payment Tariff for Coal-Fired Power Plants-Capacity Payment Mechanism for Coal-Fired Power Plants Based on Guaranteed Construction Cost Recovery Years
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the accelerated construction of China's new power system<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">[1]</sup>, the rapid expansion of new energy (wind power, photovoltaic) installed capacity, and the rapid increase in the proportion of new energy power, resulting in the poor return of traditional coal-fired power plants. This paper proposes a capacity payment tariff calculation method based on the fundamental principle of “ensuring that coal-fired power plants can recover construction costs within a reasonable period”, and verifies the validity of the method by taking a provincial power grid as an example.

articleTitle: Research on the Mechanism and Suppression Methods of Commutation Failure in High-Voltage Direct Current Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage Direct Current (HVDC) transmission technology has obvious advantages in power transmission, so it has been developed rapidly. Commutation failure is one of the most common faults in HV AC-DC hybrid transmission systems, which can cause DC lock and power oscillation. This paper takes commutation failure as the research object analyzes its causes and main influencing factors and puts forward corresponding suppression strategies, which are significant for the safe and stable operation of HVDC transmission systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Power Frequency Electromagnetic Field in Outdoor AIS and Indoor GIS Substations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The burgeoning economic and societal demands for electricity in China have spurred the continuous growth of quantity and voltage levels of substations. Consequently, there is an increasing focus on the electromagnetic environment surrounding these substations. Ansys Maxwell, the finite element analysis software, was used to model and simulate the industrial frequency electromagnetic field distribution in 110kV outdoor air-insulated substations (AIS) and indoor gas-insulated substations (GIS). The simulation results affirm that power frequency electromagnetic field (EMF) values of both substations at 1.5 m above the ground meet national controlling limits. Furthermore, the analysis reveals that the maximum EMF value in the indoor substation is only 1/10 of that observed in the outdoor substation. This finding underscores the significant role played by GIS in mitigating EMF levels in substations. Consequently, it is suggested that GIS technology be widely adopted in substations located in densely populated areas, such as cities.

articleTitle: DC Microgrid Bidirectional Virtual DC Motor Parameter Adaptive Control Research
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In a DC microgrid, the voltage of the DC bus is susceptible to power fluctuations resulting from variations in renewable energy sources and local loads. To enhance the inertia and damping characteristics of the DC microgrid, virtual DC motor control (VDCM) is employed to emulate the inertial properties exhibited by a DC motor. The existing proportional-integral (PI) control loop in VDCM is employed in this study to obviate the necessity of power measurement and torque calculation, thereby significantly streamlining the conventional VDCM control structure. By incorporating differential compensation in addition to the powerless loop VDCM control, the dynamic performance of the system can be enhanced without compromising its steady-state characteristics. Additionally, a novel parameter adaptive control approach is proposed for VDCM. In comparison to conventional fixed-parameter control, the enhanced adaptive control method optimizes the dynamic response of the system. The control system has been modeled using a small-signal approach, and the impact of VDCM parameters on system stability has been analyzed through the utilization of Bode plots and impedance ratio criteria. The proposed control method was ultimately verified via simulation using the Matlab/Simulink platform.

articleTitle: Experimental Study of Partial Discharge Pulses Coupling Characteristic in Stator Winding Bar of Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Large-scale hydro-turbine generator stator winding structure is complex, stator winding in the partial discharge (PD) signal from the discharge power supply to the detection point, will occur in varying degrees of attenuation and deformation, so the propagation characteristics of the signal in the stator winding is the premise of accurately measuring the signal put in the bureau. In view of the controversy about electromagnetic coupling mode in the existing literature, this paper designs the slot coupling model of generator stator bar and the coupling test of end coupling model according to the structure of generator stator winding and upper and lower layers of the same slot. The experimental results show that there is end coupling and slot coupling in the generator stator bar. The electromagnetic coupling of the synthesizing bar not only causes the bureau signal to reach the detection point faster, the signal attenuation law is more complex, but also leads to the signal phase-shifting phenomenon in the line detection, which confuses the discharge position and increases the difficulty of locating the discharge power supply. This paper studies the transmission coupling characteristics of generator stator bars, provides a basis for the rational selection of detection points and frequency bands, and also enlightens noise suppression, and further excavates the method of locating the power supply and calibrating the discharge.

articleTitle: Anti-Surge Driving Strategy Based on the Thyristor-Controlled Phase-Shifting Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Thyristor-Controlled Phase Shifting Transformer (TCPST) holds significant prospects in the increasingly complex power grid flow control due to its reliable load regulation and cost-effectiveness. However, the semi-controlled characteristics of thyristors introduce the possibility of current surges of short-circuit during mode switching, restricting the widespread engineering application of TCPST. To address this issue, this paper proposes an anti-surge driving strategy for mode switching on the basis of the TCPST: a locking driving strategy that combines current direction of valve-group and operating mode to address the current surge issues induced by coil short-circuit during mode switching. Additionally, an RC buffer circuit is added within the valve-group, and a power reference threshold is introduced in the driving strategy to reduce the voltage surge associated valve-group momentary open-circuit. Finally, simulations are conducted on a 220kV grid environment with the TCPST, confirming the effectiveness of the proposed anti-surge driving strategy.

articleTitle: Application of Integrated Modular Avionics Technology in the Areospace Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Integrated modular avionics (IMA) technology is the development trend of future aerospace. IMA technology allows the miniaturization, lightness and modularity of electronic devices on the aerospace vehicles, but it also reduces development costs. In order to meet the strict constraints of aerospace vehicle weight, volume and power consumption, this paper applies IMA technology to establish a comprehensive aerospace control (CAC) device. The implementation of the CAC device is discussed by design concept, hardware architecture and software architecture in this paper.

articleTitle: Simulation of VHF-UHF Radiation and Leakage Characteristics of GIS Partial Discharge with Different Insulator Types
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The ultra-high frequency (UHF) and very high frequency (VHF) electromagnetic waves radiating from internal discharges within gas insulated switchgear (GIS) can escape into the surrounding space through non-metallic components. This phenomenon presents an opportunity for detecting partial discharge (PD) signals using high-frequency sensors and locating the sources of discharges. The GIS basin insulator structure primarily comprises metal shield and open types. In the event of internal insulation discharge, non-metallic components such as casting holes or flange gaps in metal closed insulators can release electromagnetic waves into the external space. Similarly, open devices can directly emit electromagnetic signals to the exterior through the basin insulator. This paper establishes simulation models for two typical GIS structures and investigates the leakage characteristics of electromagnetic waves in the VHF and UHF bands. Studies have shown that open insulators exhibit greater signal leakage ability in both the VHF and UHF bands. The high-pass characteristic of the antenna results in significantly lower leakage parameters in the VHF range compared to the UHF range. This conclusion offers theoretical insights for guiding the selection of frequency bands in subsequent partial discharge sensor research.

articleTitle: The Packaging Design of SiC Power Modules Based on Silver Sintering Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article introduces the packaging design of a SiC power module with a double-sided pressure-assisted silver sintering process. Initially, the structure of the power module is optimized and verified through electro-thermal-mechanical multiphysics field simulation experiments. Subsequently, the assembly processes of the module are further described. The module is characterized by the use of pressure-assisted silver sintering process twice to sinter the chip and the DTS copper sheet of the module, thereby further improving the yield of copper wire bonding. The first silver sintering process attaches the SiC chip to the AMB substrate, and the second silver sintering process attaches the DTS copper sheet to the source surface of the SiC chip, thus better accommodating the interconnection process of copper wire bonding. The push-pull force test is conducted for validation. The results show that the overall pull force of the copper wire is normally distributed, focusing on 1.6-2.2kg, and the breakage occurs either at the root of the solder joint or in the middle of the bonding wire, with the bonding parameters meeting the current process requirements and achieving ideal effects.

Author Keywords: Double-Sided Pressure Assisted Silver Sintering Process

articleTitle: Vibration Characteristics Analysis of Vehicle In-Wheel Motor Based on Multi-Physical Field Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to find out the general law of vibration characteristics of permanent magnet vernier motor for in-wheel motor vehicle, a method of vibration characteristics analysis and research of induction motor based on multi-physical field coupling is introduced. The electromagnetic force of the permanent magnet vernier motor is coupled with the vibration characteristics through the harmonic response analysis, and the vibration solution and calculation of the permanent magnet vernier motor are realized. The results of the analysis prove that the radial electromagnetic force of the motor is the main cause of the vibration problem.

articleTitle: A Presice Model for Inverter Nonlinear Effect
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a new mathematical model for inverter nonlinear effect(INE). The INE is caused by various factors such as dead time and switch nonlinearity. The proposed mathematical model, based on the existing mathematical model of dead time, also considers the impact of parasitic capacitance on the output voltage of inverters during switching on/off delay time. Then, obtain compensation voltage by using parameters of Infineon FSIOOR06KE3 IGBT through simulation. Next, use the same IGBT to build an experimental platform, and obtain the inverter compensation voltage through the experiment. Compare the two compensation values. The comparison results verified the accuracy of the proposed mathematical model and provided physical information for the transfer learning of inverter nonlinear compensation.

articleTitle: Suppression Strategy Research of DFIG Forced Subsynchronous Oscillation Based on Passivity-Based Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The forced sub-synchronous oscillation (FSSO) accident in Hami, Xinjiang, has the new characteristics of time-varying frequency. It is significantly different from the previous negative damping sub-synchronous oscillation, which has aroused widespread concern. In this paper, the generation mechanism of FSSO is analyzed, and an oscillation suppression strategy based on passivity-based control (PBC) is proposed. Firstly, the generation mechanism of FSSO under the excitation of disturbance source is analyzed using an equivalent disturbance equation. Secondly, based on the disturbance suppression and damping compensation effect of the PBC, the overall control framework and oscillation suppression strategy are proposed. Finally, considering the influence factors such as wind speed, line series compensation degree and the number of online wind turbines, a FSSO simulation model of wind farm is built, which verifies the effectiveness of the suppression strategy proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Dynamic Configuration Planning for Resource Pool of Policy-driven Virtual Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power grid requires significant regulation to maintain safe and stable operation. However, current regulation methods incur substantial costs that some power grid companies struggle to afford. Therefore, a cost-effective regulatory approach needs to be proposed to address this issue. This paper introduces a novel operating model for the virtual power plants (VPP) called the policy-driven virtual power plants (PVPP). In this model, the government acts as a facilitator between the power grid and enterprises, assisting in alleviating the economic burden on power grid companies and enhancing the regulatory capacity of the power grid. Furthermore, a dynamic planning method for the PVPP resource pool is proposed to optimize grid revenue in the medium to long term, especially when participating in multiple services. Finally, a case study is presented to demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed method, showcasing the significant potential for the application of PVPP.

articleTitle: Study on Breaking Characteristics of Double-Break High-Voltage Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Circuit breaker is the extremely important control and protection device in power system, as the driving part of circuit breaker, hydraulic operating mechanism has the characteristics of fast response and instantaneous high power. For high-voltage circuit breaker, especially its operating mechanism often faces various faults due to design and processing problems, how to design and optimize the operating mechanism with high performance and high reliability is an important engineering practical problem. Aiming at the internal motion process of the cylinder block in hydraulic actuator, this paper makes use oil's incompressible characteristics, focuses on the piston structure, comprehensively considers the different flow control equations of the piston movement to different positions, and combines the piston kinematics equation to study the motion parameters of hydraulic actuator during the breaking process. On the other hand, on the basis of the original model, this paper uses different structure parameters of cylinder block to study the influence of key parameters of the cylinder block on the breaking process's motion parameters of the hydraulic operating mechanism, which provides a theoretical basis for the structural optimization design.

articleTitle: Research on SOC Estimation of Lead-Acid Batteries Based on ICS-PF
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Lead acid batteries are an important component of power system substations and have a significant impact on the safety and stability of the power system. Due to the complexity of real-time operating conditions in the power system caused by new energy generation and the existence of consistency issues in battery packs, accurate assessment of battery state of charge plays an important role in battery condition assessment, prolonging battery service life, and maintaining the stability of the entire power system. This article considers the problem of particle impoverishment in particle filtering and uses the improved cuckoo bird optimization algorithm (ICS) to improve the accuracy of the algorithm's prediction by online identification of equivalent circuits using the least squares method. Finally, by conducting simulation experiments on a 500Ah lead-acid battery, the experimental data was obtained for predicting the state of charge of lead-acid batteries using Kalman filtering, particle filtering, and cuckoo bird search algorithm optimized particle filtering (ICS-PF), thereby verifying the higher accuracy of ICS-PF in predicting the state of charge of lead-acid batteries.

Author Keywords: Improving the cuckoo search algorithm and optimizing particle filtering

articleTitle: A Modified Rotor Position Estimation Strategy for PMSM Using Predictive Current Error of FCS-MPC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Finite control-set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) is a promising scheme for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) with its advantages of simple structure and multi-constraint control, where the applied voltage vector is directly selected by the cost function. However, due to the inherent discrete nature of FCS-MPC, conventional position estimation methods using single t5-axis predictive current errors suffer from power generation instability during medium and high speed regions. To address this problem, a modified rotor position estimation strategy is proposed to improve the power generation stability. Among that, the predictive current errors of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\delta -\mathbf{axis}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\gamma-\mathbf{axis}$</tex> are used simultaneously to extract positional information. The experimental results are eventually conducted to validate the proposed methods.

articleTitle: An Integrated Condition Monitoring Method for Insulation Health of Multiple Motor System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The monitoring of motor conditions has become a focal point in recent years, driven by its potential to prognosticate latent failures. Prior research has established the efficacy of leakage-current-based methods in monitoring insulation health. Nonetheless, the adoption of such methods for multiple motors incurs heightened costs due to the requisite high-sensitivity current sensors. This paper introduces an integrated approach to condition monitoring, specifically targeting the insulation health of multiple motors. The proposed method utilizes a single set of monitoring equipment capable of simultaneously monitoring multiple motors. Installation of the monitoring equipment at the grounding line of the neutral point of a distribution transformer allows for the measurement of the overall leakage current of all motors connected to this transformer. A novel method is presented for detecting the individual health conditions of each motor, and its effectiveness is substantiated through diverse case studies.

articleTitle: Study on Self-Starting Technology of Pumped Storage Unit Considering Iron Loss of Doubled Fed Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of self-starting of pumped storage unit, a self-starting control strategy of doubly-fed motor based on rotor side converter is proposed by analyzing the mathematical model of doubly-fed motor and using impedance parameter equivalent transformation to simplify the model. The results showed that the stator phase current waveform, rotor phase voltage waveform and rotational speed waveform were stable, which could realize the smooth start-up of the unit. The simulation results are in good agreement with the actual situation, and have certain reference value for engineering application.

articleTitle: Advance Scheduling of Energy Storage in the Integrated Energy System of the Park and the Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of cloud computing and the advancement of new infrastructure construction, the electricity consumption of interconnected data centers is rapidly increasing. Reasonable planning while ensuring the quality of data center services is of great significance in reducing the total cost of data center planning and improving the flexibility of the new power system. Therefore, this paper proposes a day ahead scheduling method for integrated energy system including data center energy storage park based on information gap decision-making theory. Firstly, based on the power constraints of IT equipment and the thermal characteristics of the data center, a flexible operation model for the data center is established. Secondly, based on the energy hub architecture, a comprehensive energy system scheduling model including data center energy storage was established. Then, for the uncertain parameters in the model, information gap decision theory is introduced to model and analyze them. Finally, in a park integrated energy system for example test, to verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed model and algorithm.

articleTitle: A Hardware-Efficient Vector Limiter Algorithm and Its Programmable Logic Realization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vector limiter is a computationally complex component of vector control, but its hardware-friendly algorithm is rarely discussed. This paper presents an efficient solution with pure shift-and-add operations, namely the dual vector rotation algorithm (DVRA). Its programmable logic realization is also provided. The DVRA is then simulated in a motor driving system, and physical validation is made on a Xilinx FPGA. Furthermore, performance comparison is conducted between the DVRA and four control groups (conventional algorithms). All control groups are built by Xilinx IPs under diversified configurations, thus human bias can be minimized. Post-implementation results evince that the DVRA exhibits significantly less resource expenditure and better timing, with power consumption and accuracy comparable to the control groups.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Planar Magnetics for CLLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a magnetic integrated structure of CLLC resonant converter is proposed. The non-staggered winding structure design is adopted, and the distance between the primary and secondary windings is increased as a control variable, which effectively increases the leakage inductance of the transformer. Only one magnetic component is used to realize the three magnetic components in the CLLC resonant tank, which solves the problem of the magnetic components in the CLLC resonant converter. Too many problems. At the same time, the influence of the parasitic capacitance of the winding on the working characteristics of the CLLC resonant converter is introduced, and the factors that affect the parasitic capacitance of the winding are analyzed on this basis. Finally, an experimental prototype with 400V input, 40V~60V output, 1kW power rating and resonant frequency of 1MHz is designed. The experimental results verify the correctness and effectiveness of the proposed optimal design method for planar magnetic components.

articleTitle: Research on the Coupling Relationship Between Cogging Torque and Suspension Force Pulsation Based on Air-gap Field Modulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There are two simultaneous issues in bearingless permanent magnet slice motors (BPMSMs): cogging torque and suspension force pulsation. Existing studies treat them as two separate parts without considering the potential relationship between them. To establish a theoretical basis for simultaneously reducing both components in the motor design stage, this paper proposes a method for analyzing the relationship between cogging torque and suspension force pulsation. An overview of air-gap field modulation is provided first. Based on this, the traditional motor theory is expanded to explain how cogging torque and suspension force pulsation are generated by the interaction of two modulated harmonics. The analysis also examines how adopting different winding structures affects the coupling relationship and the pulsation of suspension force. Finally, Finite Element Analysis (FEA) is used to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Calculation of Lightning Impulse Voltage Distribution of Voltage Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A circuit model was employed to estimate the lightning surge voltage distribution within a 245-kV voltage transformer. Model parameters were determined using a combination of analytical formulas and the finite element method. The model was implemented in circuit simulation software, and the voltage distribution in the voltage transformer windings was calculated for a standard <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$2.5/50\mu \mathrm{s}$</tex> lightning surge. Subsequent experimental validation confirmed the accuracy of the model's predictions.

articleTitle: Modeling of Sequence Impedance for VSC-HVDC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: VSC-HVDC grid connection technology has gradually become an ideal solution for large-capacity long-distance offshore wind power grid connection. This scheme has the problem of instability caused by the interaction between the wind turbine and the VSC-HVDC converter and its control system, which may cause sub-synchronous oscillation. To solve this problem, this paper uses the harmonic linearized impedance modeling method to establish the sequential impedance models for the receiving and transmitting stations of VSC-HVDC, respectively. The corresponding simulation model was established on PSCAD and the correctness of the sequence impedance model was verified.

articleTitle: Half-Turn LLC-DCX Based Two-Stage DC-DC Converter for Wide Input Voltage Range Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Compared with the traditional single-stage converter architecture, the two-stage architecture has the advantage of being able to maintain high efficiency over the full input voltage range. However, in low voltage and high output current applications, the Buck+LLC-DCX based two-stage solution could not maintain high efficiency with the increasing of power level due to the low middle bus voltage. Thus, a Boost+LLC-DCX based two-stage converter is employed to reduce the conduction loss and improve efficiency. In addition, to further reduce the conduction losses at the secondary side of LLC-DCX converter, a half-turn transformer is adopted. Furthermore, the implementation and optimization of the half-turn transformer have been carried out. A 200-400V input, 28V/1.8kW output prototype has been fabricated in the lab. The experimental results show that the full load efficiency of the prototype is higher than 94%.

articleTitle: Research on Online Upgrade of Gun Servo System Based on CAN Bus
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the debugging efficiency is reduced due to the difficulty of software upgrade during the whole gun joint debugging of the servo system, an online upgrade method based on CAN bus is proposed, which adopts the IAP download method to get rid of the JTAG emulator without changing the DSP power-on startup mode, and innovatively adds the online upgrade function of the upgrade module, and the application program and the upgrade program can be upgraded with the help of the CAN interface reserved by the servo system. The upper computer software converts the format of the application to be upgraded, extracts and subcontracts it, and then distributes and caches to the on-chip SARAM of JDSPF28335 through USB-CAN. The upgrade program pre-burned to the on-chip Flash receives, checksums and moves to the specified storage space, and finally jumps to the application program to realize online upgrade. Tests have proved that the method is stable and reliable, improves the efficiency of product development, saves scientific research and production costs, and has engineering application value.

articleTitle: A Fault Ride-Through Control Scheme for Active Power Cooperative Support of New Energy Base
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The new energy base (NEB) contains tens of million kilowatts, and 70% of the capacity is made up of new energy, which is far more than normal new energy generation system. When a fault occurs, the voltage drops of NEB may cause unacceptable active power shortage in the whole power system and lead to grid frequency collapse. Existing fault ride-through (FRT) schemes are aimed at voltage support and ignore the active power. To overcome this problem, characteristic of the NEB aggregate model is analyzed for active power support in this article. Then, an FRT of the NEB scheme is proposed for active power cooperative support (APCS). Compared with existing FRT scheme, active power shortage of the NEB is minimized by proposed scheme. Effectiveness of the proposed scheme is proved by simulation results.

articleTitle: Virtual Flux-Based Scheme for Passivity Enhancement in MMC-HVDC System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Inherent control delays pose significant challenges to the stability of the Modular multilevel converter-based high voltage direct current (MMC-HVDC) system, inducing the risk of high-frequency resonances (HFR). This paper provides the virtual flux-based passivity enhancement schemes to remove the influence of the time delay terms. The negative damping risks can be eliminated, improving the system's stability and safety. The impedance modeling and simulation results validate the effectiveness of the approach.

articleTitle: Improvement of Surface Insulating Performance for Ceramics used in Spark Plugs by APPJ with Two-Dimensional Dynamic Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cylindrical ceramics are commonly used as insulating materials in spark plugs for their high-temperature resistance and excellent insulating properties. However, the spark plug failures are always caused by carbon fouling due to the high polarity of the ceramic surfaces, which further decreases the surface insulation capability. Surface treatment is needed to restrain carbon fouling by decreasing the surface polarity of ceramics and enhancing surface insulation properties. In this paper, Ar/HDMSO APPJ excited by a nanosecond pulse power supply is employed for the two-dimensional dynamic treatment of cylindrical ceramic. The plasma source moves linearly with the ceramic rotating at constant velocity. The treatment effects are examined through the distribution of water contact angles (WCA) and polarity on the surfaces under different linear motion and rotary motion velocities. The insulating properties are analyzed through the variation of flashover voltage for different positions. Additionally, the surface morphology of ceramic materials at typical treatment positions is observed using SEM. The results indicate that the super-hydrophobic treatment is realized at ceramic surfaces and the surface polarity decreased by 67.8%, with the flashover voltage improvement of 29%, when the linear velocity is 1 mm/s and the rotary motion velocity is 4.2 r/min. SEM results reveal that a uniform thin film is deposited on the surface and a large number of white cluster-like structures are observed on the surface of ceramic. The results of this paper provide the experimental basis for the dynamic treatment of materials with irregular shapes by APPJ for applications in internal combustion engines.

articleTitle: Nonintrusive Load Monitoring Based on Spectrum Information Preserving Data Augmentation Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nonintrusive load monitoring (NILM) enables to decompose the aggregate signal of household's electricity consumption into appliance-level data. Data augmentation is an effective way to overcome limited data sets for NILM. However, existing data augmentation strategies may destroy the core information of the target appliance and affect the decomposition results. To this end, a new neural model spectrum information preserving for NILM (SIP4NILM) is proposed. SIP4NILM aims to protect the core information of the appliance by combining the original and augmented input spectrum weighted by preservation map. Experimental results based on the Reference Energy Disaggregation Data Set (REDD) and comparison with five existing data augmentation methods indicate that the proposed method outperform state-of-the-art models, with better generalizability, stability, improving MAE gain and SAEδ gain to unseen appliances.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Excitation Reactance of Fifteen-Phase Induction Motor Based on Field-Circuit Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article focuses on solving the excitation reactance for a 45 kW fifteen-phase induction motor. Based on the field-circuit coupling method and the air-gap magnetic density solved by the finite-element simulation, this article employs a dual-layer iteration process with the help of the T-type equivalent circuit in induction motors. The first layer involves the iteration of excitation reactance and excitation current, while the second layer involves the iteration of slip rate and target power. This approach can be used to determine the excitation reactance of the fifteen-phase induction motor under different operating conditions. Compared with traditional magnetic circuit methods, this method can consider the actual complex structure and material properties of the motor, and can more accurately calculate the effects of iron core saturation and slot effects, resulting in more accurate calculation of the excitation reactance. Finally, the accuracy of the calculation method is verified through the no-load experiment in this article.

articleTitle: A Full Duplex Megahertz Simultaneous Wireless Power and Data Transfer System with High Communication Rates
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, simultaneous wireless power and data transfer (SWPDT) is introduced to the megahertz (MHz) wireless power transfer system. A megahertz simultaneous wireless power and data transfer (MHz SWPDT) system for full-duplex communication with higher communication rates is proposed. The proposed system communicates with a power loop by sharing a coupling coil, which is tapped to inject and extract high-frequency data carrier to send and receive data. Two MHz communication bands are constructed to achieve stable and accurate full-duplex communication. In this paper, the design method of the power part and the signal part is given in detail. Finally, in order to verify the feasibility of the proposed method, the system simulation is carried out to realize the full-duplex communication with transmission speeds of 2Mbps and 4Mbps. At the same time, the prototype experiment is carried out, and half duplex communication is carried out under 2Mbps and 4Mbps, and the demodulation results of half duplex communication under 2Mbps are given. The received signal can reproduce the original signal more completely.

Author Keywords: simultaneous wireless power and data transfer(SWPDT)

articleTitle: A Visualization-Based Resonant Parameter Space Modeling Method for Bidirectional CLLC Converters Considering Comprehensive Performance Constraints
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to high computation complexity, traditional design methods for bidirectional CLLC converter usually consider limited kinds of performance, and the process for searching the optimal parameter scheme is discrete, which might cause the missing of real optimal solution. In order to solve these problems, a visualization-Based resonant parameter space modeling method for bidirectional CLLC converters considering comprehensive performance constraints based on numerical calculation method is proposed in this paper. According to numerical calculation method, the operation mode of PO mode is determined, and the simulation verifies the correctness and effectiveness of the numerical calculation method. Then, the closed parameter space for resonant parameters are established in both charging and discharging operation under the constraints of operation mode, switching frequency and ZVS based on numerical calculation method, respectively, which features a comprehensive consideration of performance aspects. A 1000W experimental protype of CLLC resonant converter has been built to verify the numerical calculation method, waveform obtained from theoretical analysis is very close to those obtained from simulation and experiment, which supports the effectiveness of the numerical calculation method proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Economic Analysis of Agricultural Microgrid Based on Greenhouse Crop Growth Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Greenhouse agriculture is an important part of modern agriculture. At present, the energy use management of greenhouse agricultural systems does not take into account the plant growth model, and the system energy efficiency is low. This research aims to establish a load forecasting model and propose a scheme to configure the greenhouse optical storage and power supply system based on the forecasting model. The study first determined the optimal growth conditions of greenhouse vegetable through simulation experiments. Subsequently, the configuration of photovoltaic energy storage systems (PV-ES) is optimized, aiming to achieve more efficient and economical energy use. This methodology provides practical solutions for energy management in agricultural production processes. The results show that crop yields and quality can be significantly improved, while energy consumption and costs can be reduced by precisely controlling environmental conditions in greenhouses and optimizing energy use.

articleTitle: Optimal capacity configuration of photovoltaic-storage microgrid considering flexible load
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of continuous growth of renewable energy penetration and continuous transformation of energy industrial structure, how to effectively balance photovoltaic consumption and economic benefits of power grid has become an important challenge for the future development of new power system. Based on the perspective of improving photovoltaic consumption capacity and reducing the comprehensive cost of power system, this paper proposes a capacity configuration method of photovoltaic-storage microgrid considering flexible load response. An optimization model of optical storage capacity with the goal of minimizing the total annual cost of optical storage microgrid is established, and the constraints of flexible load response, user satisfaction, power balance and energy storage operation are comprehensively considered for example simulation. The results of the example show that considering the flexible load response can effectively improve the economy of the optical storage microgrid and enhance the flexible adjustment ability of the system.

articleTitle: Friction Compensation Strategy for Feed Servo Systems Based on Static Friction Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Improving the precision of positioning and minimizing errors in position tracking constitute primary control objectives for feed servo systems. In the practical realm of machine tool feed servo systems, frictional errors occurring during motor reverse motion serve as a significant impediment to the efficacy of feed servo position control. The presence of nonfeed friction can result in conspicuous tracking errors during position reversal, consequently leading to a deterioration in the position control performance of feed servo systems. To address this challenge, this study initially integrates the specific operational conditions of feed servo systems and conducts a comprehensive analysis of the mechanisms underlying frictional errors. Following this, this paper proposes a friction identification and compensation technique based on static friction model. And a torque reference feedforward control scheme under the “Coulomb & Viscous” friction model is established and it effectively mitigates position tracking errors within the complete closed-loop control. Ultimately, through experimental validation, the study corroborates the efficacy of the proposed method in augmenting the precision of position control in feed servo systems.

articleTitle: A Fault-Tolerant Control with Dynamic Braking Strategy for Avivation Winch System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the gradual development of electric motors, especially permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). Electric winch is gradually developing to replace hydraulic winches. Fault during electrification can result in uncontrolled cable release from the winch. In this paper, a fault-tolerant based on dynamic braking strategy is proposed. Emergency braking in case of motor loss of control is realized. The experimental results verify the control strategy.

articleTitle: Layout Method of Transmission Line Icing Monitoring Device Based on Terrain Index
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the shortcomings of only considering a single terrain factor in the current icing device layout method of transmission lines, this paper proposes a method of icing monitoring device layout based on terrain index by using digital elevation model and neural network algorithm. Based on the neural network algorithm, this paper establishes a prediction model with terrain index and icing thickness as input and output respectively. According to the principle of distribution density, the monitoring points are selected, and the historical data of average maximum icing thickness of transmission lines in a certain area are used to verify the correctness of the proposed strategy. The research in this paper can provide reference for the rationality of the layout of the icing monitoring device of the existing transmission line and the layout of the icing monitoring device of the new transmission line.

articleTitle: High Temperature Silicon Carbide Power Module with Integrated Current Sensors for Paralleled Chips
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The integration of current sensors in silicon carbide devices can make the power module have the ability of realtime current monitoring, which can not only replace the current measurement device with large volume and weight outside the power module, but also has a broad application prospect in the field of short-circuit protection and active equalization of the results of the monitoring of chip current inside the power module. However, the existing research can not meet the needs of high-temperature SiC module within the current sensor integration. This paper proposes a high-temperature SiC device with integrated low-temperature co-fired ceramic (LTCC) small-volume high-temperature current sensors, the integrated sensor can be used to measure the transient current distribution of the parallel SiC chips. What's more, the use of high-temperature encapsulation process to achieve the high-temperature packaging at 225°C. Experimentally demonstrated that the sensor integrated in the proposed SiC device has measurement accuracy, and can accurately measure the chips current in parallel. The drive voltage of parallel chips can be changed by discrete driver to regulate current distribution characteristics of chips.

articleTitle: Construction and Testing of Detailed Simulation Examples for Wind Turbine Generator Units
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As global energy demand continues to increase and environmental concerns grow, wind power has emerged as an important source of clean energy worldwide. However, the lack of detailed simulation models for wind turbine generators poses a significant challenge. This paper addresses this gap by introducing a comprehensive simulation model for wind turbine generators and demonstrating its practicality and superiority through experiments. The study is motivated by the need to optimize wind turbine generator performance, stabilize power systems, and broaden the application scope of wind power research. By constructing single-machine simulation models of 2 MW wind turbine generators in Simulink and performing comprehensive simulations of their aerodynamic, mechanical, and electromagnetic components using the open-source software OpenFAST, this research provides theoretical and practical support for the advancement of wind power technology. The comparison with traditional simplified models further reinforces the importance of the detailed simulation approach. The main findings of this study highlight the importance of detailed simulation models in improving wind turbine performance, ensuring power system stability, and expanding the research landscape of wind power technology.

articleTitle: Research on Active Support Control Strategy of Double-Fed Wind Generator Unit for System Inertia Requirement
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The frequency response of the ‘double high’ power system with high proportion of new energy and high proportion of power electronic equipment decreases, and the system inertia decreases, which leads to the deterioration of frequency regulation performance. In this paper, aiming at the problem that the overall inertia level of the system is low and the frequency is high when small disturbances occur after the doubly-fed wind turbine is connected to the grid, firstly, a grid-structured active support control strategy for the rotor-side converter of the doubly-fed wind turbine is proposed to release the kinetic energy contained in the rotor shaft and improve the active and reactive power support ability of the wind turbine. Secondly, considering that the DC link capacitor of the back-to-back converter of the doubly-fed wind turbine has some available energy, a grid-side active support control strategy is proposed. The phase angle of the output voltage of the grid-side converter is added to the phase angle feedback to increase the output power of the grid-side converter and improve the frequency of the system during the disturbance. The lowest point; finally, taking the three-machine nine-node system as an example, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by simulation under small disturbance.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Property Analysis and Rotor Eddy Current Loss Optimization of Low Temperature and High Speed Permanent Magnet Motor Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rotor eddy current loss of low-temperature and high-speed permanent magnet motors used in liquefied natural gas (LNG) pumps is too high, which can easily lead to vaporization of the transported LNG.
