Firstly, the correlations of power consumption level and communication burden of 5G base stations are analyzed, and a power regulation model of 5G base stations is constructed considering these correlations and the standby energy storage role of 5G base stations. Then, two defined parameters of the modularity and cluster accommodation capacity were combined to form a comprehensive cluster partition index, and a cluster partitioning algorithm was designed based on K-means and discrete binary particle swarm optimization(DPSO). Finally, simulation results of a modified IEEE 33-bus system have verified the effectiveness of the proposed method for partitioning distributed generation.

articleTitle: Droop-Free Distributed Control Strategy for DC Microgrids with Single Variable Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a distributed control strategy based on consensus algorithm for DC microgrids is proposed to realize the goal of average bus voltage restoration and current sharing by exchanging only single variable between each converter. Conventional control often requires the transmission of multiple messages to accomplish the control goal, however, more data transmitted results in higher communication requirements and the greater computational burden. Therefore, in the scheme proposed in this paper, the voltage and current are effectively combined into single integrated variable for transmission, and the droop control in the primary control is removed while the secondary controller is enabled to enhance the dynamic performance. The performance of the proposed scheme is verified by the PLECS platform under the working conditions of load switching and plug-and-play to verify its superiority.

articleTitle: A non-isolated high-gain three-port DC-DC converter based on Y -source impedance network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of low voltage level and discontinuous power supply of photovoltaic power supply, a non-isolated high-gain three-port DC-DC converter based on Y-source impedance network is proposed in this paper. The proposed converter has continuous port current, which is more suitable for distributed power supply. The proposed converter can operate in four different operating modes. In this paper, the voltage gain of the converter is derived by analyzing the working principle in different modes. A control strategy is proposed to achieve the seamless switching between maximum power output and constant power output of photovoltaic power supply on the premise of maintaining constant output power, so as to ensure the maximum energy utilization efficiency. The simulation results prove the feasibility of the converter and control strategy.

articleTitle: Study on Thermal Stability of Liquid Nitrogen Bidirectional Flow Superconducting Composite Energy Pipeline
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The majority of China's electricity and natural gas resources are distributed in the west and north, and the energy pattern of “west-east power transmission and west-east gas transmission” has existed for a long time. Multi energy transmission has been proposed by many scholars to achieve efficient energy transmission and save space. Superconducting composite energy pipelines are an effective approach. However, the existing superconducting energy pipeline structure design is difficult to achieve liquid nitrogen cycle, and the uniformity of thermal field distribution is poor. This article proposes a bidirectional flow superconducting composite energy pipeline for liquid nitrogen, which improves the uniformity of thermal field distribution while achieving liquid nitrogen recycling. The multi-physical field model of superconducting composite energy pipeline is established, the key factors affecting thermal field distribution are studied, and the thermal stability of liquid nitrogen single and bidirectional flow pipeline under various fault conditions is compared and analyzed. The liquid nitrogen bidirectional superconducting composite energy pipeline not only improves the thermal stability of the superconducting composite energy pipeline, but also reduces the cost.

articleTitle: Optimal Scheduling Control Strategy for Distribution Network Considering Energy Storage of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of electric vehicle (EV), its large-scale and disorderly access causes drastic voltage fluctuation in distribution network, coupled with the uncertainty and volatility brought by photovoltaic grid-connection, which further affects the power quality of distribution network. In order to alleviate voltage fluctuations and suppress harmonics, this paper proposes the flexible energy storage of EV to participate in the two-layer scheduling control strategy of the grid. For the upper coordination control layer, the SOC dynamic change model is analyzed by mining the travel characteristics of EV power battery. Under the premise of satisfying the owner's power consumption constraints, grid constraints and battery constraints, the power battery dispatchable capacity model is established and divided into rechargeable clusters and dischargeable battery clusters according to the SOC state. Next, an optimized control strategy based on EV power battery is proposed to dynamically manage the scheduling behavior of each type of cluster. Then, in the lower device control layer, the power factor correction (PFC) control technology strategy for EV power battery-grid bidirectional converter is proposed, considering the harmonic pollution caused by EVs to the grid during the dispatching process. Finally, the effectiveness of the above research content is verified by example simulation.

articleTitle: Power Loss Analysis of Powertra in Inverter with SiC MOSFETs and Si IGBT for 400V and 800V Battery Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The mainstream battery voltage of electric vehicles is increasing from 400V to 800V. This higher voltage class brings significant benefits, including faster charging speed, higher power density, and increased efficiency. With the increase in voltage class, SiC MOSFETs are becoming the primary choice for powertrain inverters. This paper investigates the power losses of powertrain inverters using both SiC MOSFETs and Si IGBTs, operating under both 400V and 800V battery voltage classes. Through analysis of power losses and efficiency comparisons under various application conditions, it is demonstrated that SiC MOSFETs offer greater efficiency benefits under low-speed and light-load conditions. Mission profile based motor drive simulation results validate these findings.

articleTitle: No-Load Torque Weakening of Dual-Parallel Rotor Permanent Magnet Motor Based on Torque Harmonic Analysis and Auxiliary Slots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the absence of partial stator core and windings, the dual-parallel rotor permanent magnet synchronous motor (DR-PMSM) has a large no-load torque, which limits its application in parallel drive machinery. This paper analyzes the no-load torque based on torque harmonic and realizes the weakening of no-load torque by stator auxiliary slots. The topological structure of double parallel rotor permanent magnet motor is introduced. According to different influencing factors, the composition of no-load torque is analyzed, which includes cogging torque, end effect torque and permanent magnet gears transmission torque. The analytical expression of each torque component is constructed, the relationship between the harmonic frequency of no-load torque and each component is established, and the correctness of theoretical analysis is verified by finite element model. It is proposed to add auxiliary slots in the stator coupling area and on the stator teeth to weaken different no-load torque components. The weakening effect of the number, position and size of auxiliary slots on each component is studied. The performance of the motor before and after optimization is compared and analyzed, and the prototype test platform is built to verify the accuracy of the analysis model. The results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the no-load torque of DR-PMSM.

articleTitle: A Real-Time Waste Segregation Using Machine Vision for Recycling Facilities
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Recycling facilities are often challenged by the demanding task of waste segregation, a process traditionally requiring substantial time and manpower, and lacking efficient automated solutions. Addressing this, our study explores the use of convolutional neural networks (CNNs), particularly the ResNet-18 model, known for its balance of accuracy and computational efficiency compared to its deeper counterparts like ResNet-50 or ResNet-101. ResNet-18 provides sufficient complexity for precise image classification while enabling faster processing speeds essential for real-time applications. Our method employs this CNN to effectively categorize waste into five distinct types, streamlining the sorting process. In this paper, we introduce a custom-designed hardware system, incorporating motor control for the physical segregation of waste. This system operates in tandem with the ResNet-18's classification results, ensuring that each type of waste is accurately sorted into designated bins. Our integrated approach, which pairs the image classification capabilities of ResNet-18 with a practical hardware automation system, aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of waste segregation in recycling facilities.

articleTitle: Optimal Model of Electric–Heat Integrated Energy System with Conditional Value-at-Risk in Cold Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In light of the significant rise in the percentage of photovoltaic in the grid, which contributes to system uncertainty, this study presents an optimal operation model for integrated energy system (IES) in cold regions. The objective function in the model contains three components: day-ahead operation cost, real-time operation cost, and the product of risk attitude level and risk cost. The model employs conditional value-at-risk to compute the risk cost, considering both the risk attitude level and risk cost during the operation of the IES as crucial factors influencing the scheduling decision. Through the calculation of scheduling and risk cost for systems with varying risk attitude levels, it is found that considering risk cost results in a reduction of 6016.85 RMB compared to not considering it. This suggests that the consideration of risk cost significantly impacts the decision-making process of the IES. Additionally, it is observed that as the risk attitude level increases from 1 to 5, the operating cost increases by 5560.19 RMB and the risk cost decreases by 2610.36 RMB. The study illustrates that the risk attitude level significantly affects the operational planning of the system and serves as a guiding factor for the operation of the IES.

articleTitle: An Improved Duty Cycle Model Predictive Modulation Method for Open-Winding Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to suppress the zero-sequence current in the control system of open-circuit permanent magnet synchronous motor (OW-PMSM) with common DC bus winding and further improve the current quality, an improved duty cycle model predictive modulation method is proposed. The duty cycle control is added to the traditional MPC strategy, and the duty cycle MPC strategy is proposed. The deadbeat control principle is used to calculate the duty cycle, and the influence of the current zero-sequence component is considered in the value function. The zero-sequence current suppression strategy is actively added. Compared with the traditional single-vector model predictive current control, the proposed modulation method effectively reduces the AC-DC axis and zero-axis current fluctuations of the system.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Circulation Current of Single-Core Submarine Cable Based on ATP-EMTP
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Both ends of single-core submarine cable sheath and armor are directly grounded, and the grounding current of submarine cable during operation is large, which is an important factor affecting its safe operation. This paper uses the electromagnetic transient analysis software ATP-EMTP to analyze the effect of the relative permeability of the armor, the grounding resistance, and the length of the submarine cable on the circulation current, providing a solution for accurately judging the operation status of the submarine cable and formulating maintenance and repair strategies.

articleTitle: Hybrid Model Based on Temporal Convolutional Network and Attention Mechanism for Short-term Wind Power Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wind power forecasting plays a key role in the overall task of curbing greenhouse gas emissions. To achieve this goal, there is a growing argument for leveraging sophisticated deep learning techniques to improve the accuracy of predictive models and contribute to a greener and more sustainable future. This paper proposes a hybrid forecasting model based on deep learning, harmoniously integrating temporal convolutional network (TCN) and attention mechanism. By considering historical information from various time scales, this model achieves adaptive weighted summation. Besides, by forecasting the difference instead of directly forecasting the power generation, this model can achieve efficient and high-quality forecasts. This research fills gaps in the literature by introducing a novel TCN hybrid model and conducting systematic comparisons among deep learning models for wind power forecasting. Rigorous validation on real datasets confirms the effectiveness of the hybrid model, leading to significant innovations and insights that can drive advancements in predictive modeling for renewable energy resources.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Operation Model of Home Energy Management System Considering Emergency Operation State of Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous increase of residential electricity load in the whole society, there will be a situation of power supply exceeding demand in the power grid at the peak load, which is called emergency operation state. The power balance can be realized by regulating interruptible loads and transferable loads in the emergency state, so as to guarantee the safe and reliable operation of the important loads of the home energy management system and reduce the losses brought by the emergency state. In this paper, a multi-objective optimization model of home energy management system considering the emergency operation state of the power grid is established, with the power reduction of users and the cost of users constituting the objective function of the optimization model, taking into account the constraints of users' maximum purchased power, and the introduction of user satisfaction indexes. The results show that the model can not only effectively reduce the user's electricity cost under the emergency operation state of the power grid, but also ensure the operation safety of the power system to the greatest extent.

Author Keywords: home energy management systems;emergency operating conditions

articleTitle: Influence of MMF Space Harmonic on PM Eddy- Current Losses in a Modular Fault-Tolerant In-Wheel Motor under Open-Circuit Faulty Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the influence of magneto motive force (MMF) space harmonic on permanent magnet (PM) eddy-current losses in a modular fault-tolerant in-wheel motor under open-circuit faulty operations. First, reconfiguring maximum round MMF with constant amplitude of current is taken as the fault-tolerant (FT) strategy for the open-circuit of one phase in one module. Second, the harmonic components of MMF under the faults and corresponding FT control are analyzed respectively. Then, an analytical model based on multi-loop method for calculating PM eddy-current losses induced by MMF harmonics is proposed. The PM losses induced by each MMF harmonic can be obtained through the model. The total PM losses named Ppm consist of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{mmf}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{slot}$</tex>. The former is induced by spatial harmonics of MMF. <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{slot}$</tex>, the most important losses in PMs, are those generated by the fundamental frequency magnetic flux due to the stator slot openings. The influences of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{mmf}$</tex> and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P_{slot}$</tex> on the total PM losses under various operations are analyzed respectively. Finally, the analytical results are verified through finite element method (FEM).

articleTitle: High Step-up Ratio and Low Input Current Ripple Magnetic Integration DC-DC Converter for Low-voltage Fuel Cell System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a novel high step-up ratio and low input current ripple non-isolated dc-dc converter based on magnetic integration technique is proposed, which is suitable for the low-voltage fuel cell power condition system. First high input/output voltage step-up ratio of the proposed converter can be realized due to the coupled inductor along with the auxiliary step-up unit. Meanwhile, the input current ripple can be reduced to minimum because of the input current ripple cancellation network. All three inductor windings (input, output and ripple cancellation) are integrated in one magnetic core in order to lower the size and weight of the magnetic component. Moreover, the voltage stress of the switch in proposed converter is much smaller compare with the output voltage, which allows more options and lower losses of the main power switch. Finally, a 1-kW prototype with 100-V input and 500-V output voltage has been fabricated and tested. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed magnetic integration converter.

articleTitle: Multipath Equalization Topology of Series Battery Pack Based on Inductor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the current context of global energy challenges and evolving development trends, the significance of battery balancing technology has become increasingly apparent. It plays a pivotal role in addressing the inconsistencies that often arise within battery packs, thereby ensuring the safe and reliable operation of energy storage systems. This paper design and analysis of a multi-path battery equalization circuit topology based on a single inductor. The objective is 1) to improve a topology of balancing circuit based on inductor with more flexibility; 2) the bidirectional switches with low on-loss resistance are adopted to achieve arbitrary cell(s)-to-cell(s) equalization with high output power and balancing speed; 3) and the continuous current loop stage is added to solve the problem of high voltage spikes caused by the absence of a continuous current path. SOC is used as the balance variable of the balance strategy, it can achieve better balancing effect. To validate the effectiveness of the proposed topology, simulations are carried out on a four-cell battery pack under different operating conditions, including battery charging, discharging, and rest states. This endeavor holds significant importance in achieving capacity balance among batteries within a battery pack, thereby not only improves the overall performance of energy storage systems but also extends the lifespan of the battery pack.

articleTitle: Low-Carbon Robust Optimization Scheduling for Multi-Virtual Power Plants Considering P2P Trading
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Virtual power plant large-scale grid connection brings a new direction for studying the scheduling strategy of multi-VPP systems. However, in practical application, the uncertainty of the output of renewable energy, how to trade VPP efficiently on the untrusted trading platform, and the operation problems caused by the large-scale grid connection of VPP are all challenges that need to be faced. Therefore, this paper focuses on the coordination and optimization scheduling strategy of point-to-point (Peer to Peer, P2P) Trading of multi-VPP systems. First, it studies the structural model, uncertainty model and stepped carbon price model of multi-VPP systems. Given the unpredictability of renewable energy generation in the VPP, we have employed robust optimization to address this issue. Introduce the ladder carbon price type carbon trading into the multi-VPP system for research. Based on the given analysis example, robust optimization offers a solution to address output uncertainty. Additionally, a proposed structural model for P2P trading in VPP system tackles the scheduling problem. Moreover, to promote dynamic and effective Trading among VPP participants, a game theory-inspired incentive mechanism known as Nash bargaining is implemented. The simulation comparative analysis shows that when the multi-VPP system is in the P2P trading market, the overall economy of the system is relatively much improved compared with the traditional trading market.

articleTitle: Research on Accelerating IGBT Thermal-Electrical Coupling Model Solution Methods Based on Improved Kernel Extreme Learning Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This study aims to accelerate the solution process of the IGBT electro-thermal coupling model through an improved Kernel Extreme Learning Machine (KELM) method. Considering the speed and accuracy limitations of traditional solution methods when dealing with complex models, this paper introduces an optimized KELM by adjusting algorithm parameters to enhance solution efficiency. Through a series of experiments, the performance differences between the improved method and traditional techniques were compared. The results indicate that the improved KELM significantly speeds up the solution process while maintaining high accuracy. This research not only provides an effective solution tool for electro-thermal coupling models but also opens new avenues for rapid solution of other complex systems.

articleTitle: Joint Optimal Scheduling for EV-UAV Model in Wireless Charging Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can serve as a wireless power source within wireless charging sensor networks (WCSNs). The combination of electric vehicles (EVs) and UAVs introduces a novel paradigm in WCSNs. Within the EV-UAV model, the EV functions as a mobile depot, supporting its attached UAVs as they depart from the EV to fulfill electricity replenishment tasks. The EV enhances its mileage endurance by utilizing distributed energy sources and can also replenish energy for the UAVs. A two-echelon framework, utilizing mixed-integer linear programming (MILP), is proposed for optimal joint scheduling, considering constraints such as time windows and the battery capacity of EVs and UAVs.

articleTitle: Coordinated Control Strategy for Centralized Frequency Modulation in Wind Farms Based on the Estimation of Frequency Modulation Capacity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Under the background of the era of building a new type of power system with new energy as the main body, new energy represented by wind power will certainly continue to develop at a high speed, and the shape of the high proportion of new energy power system will also be expanded continuously from the local to the overall situation. In wind power generation, due to the introduction of a large number of variable-speed wind turbines, the frequency regulation capability of the grid-connected system gradually decreases with the increase of wind power penetration. For this reason, this paper analyzes the participation of variable-speed wind turbines in the system's frequency modulation (FM) process, and quantifies the participation of variable-speed wind turbines in the FM capacity, and gives the correspondence between the active increment and the FM duration of wind turbines participating in the system's FM process, and proposes an optimization strategy for active support of the frequency of wind farms, which is a synergy of the autonomous response of the single machine and the centralized control of the station, based on which the active support optimization strategy for the frequency of wind farms is put forward. According to this strategy, each wind turbine in the wind farm can effectively participate in system frequency regulation. The simulation example proves that by orderly controlling the FM power and FM time of the WTGs, the primary offset of the system frequency and the secondary offset of the system frequency after the WTGs are cut out are effectively reduced, and at the same time, the FM economic benefit of the WTG group can be maximized.

articleTitle: Voltage Analysis of Distribution Network Based on Data-Driven Source-Load Distribution Curve
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The stochastic nature of PV output and the volatility of load power consumption have a significant impact on the voltage of distribution networks, so a data-driven distribution network voltage analysis model based on the source-load distribution graph is proposed. Firstly, the impacts of PV and load access on the distribution network are analysed, and the key factors affecting voltage are extracted, and then the K-means clustering algorithm is used to find the “worst” scenario in which the PV power is the smallest and the load power is the largest. This data set is used as an input, and finally the simulation is carried out on the IEEE 33-node distribution system to output the voltage at each node, which verifies that the proposed model has good engineering value.

articleTitle: Application of Integrated and Split Magnetics in LLC Resonant Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Magnetics are important components of power electronic converters, which can realize transmission and storage of magnetic energy, harmonic filtering and electrical isolation. The study of magnetic components is an important way to improve the power density and performance of power electronic converters. Split type and integrated type are two commonly used forms of magnetic components in power electronic converters. This article analyzes the application of integrated and split magnetic components in LLC resonant converters, presents their design process, and verifies them through experiments. Finally, the advantages and disadvantages of integrated and split magnetic components are discussed.

articleTitle: Spatial Distribution Prediction of Wildfire Risk in Transmission Line Corridors Based on Dynamic Bayesian Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The wildfire disasters near the transmission line corridor may lead to a large area of power outage. Accurate prediction of potential wildfire disasters can provide auxiliary guidance for power emergency repair. This paper proposes a prediction model of wildfire distribution in transmission corridor based on dynamic Bayesian network (DBN). Firstly, a total of 17 wildfire factors in four categories of meteorology, human, vegetation and geography were selected. The random forest algorithm is used to select the optimal factor set. The DBN model of different time scales is established by eliminating the coupling relationship between factors through static Bayesian network. With the decrease of time scale, the effect of DBN model is gradually improved, and the accuracy of DBN model with 3 days as time scale is 86.39%. Finally, the model was used to predict the occurrence of wildfires during the Spring Festival in Zhaoqing City, Guangdong Province in 2023, and a spatio-temporal distribution map of wildfires with a resolution of 1km× 1km was drawn. The validity of the distribution map is verified by real fire points.

articleTitle: The Unity of Field Modulation Effect and Armature Structure in Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the magnetic field modulation effect in the integral slot winding permanent magnet synchronous machine (PMSM) from the perspective of air gap harmonic modulation considering the slotting effect. It is found that there is magnetic field modulation effect in the integral slot winding PMSM. This article classifies PMSM based on the winding structure, and shows that the magnetic field modulation effect commonly exists in PMSM with different winding structures, and from the perspective of multi-harmonic operation, this article explains the trade-off relationship between the harmonic content utilized in magnetic field modulation and the winding coefficient.

articleTitle: Effect of Space Charge on Interface Discharge Characteristics in Multilayer Dielectric
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In direct current field, space charge is the key factor affecting insulation performance. In multilayer composite insulation structure, the interface of two insulating media is more likely to accumulate space charge due to discontinuity, which becomes the weak link of the whole insulation system. In flexible HVDC engineering, the optical internal discharge of fiber insulator is probably related to the accumulation of space charge at the interface of optical fiber sheath and coating layer. In this paper, finite element method was used to simulate the accumulation of space charge in a double-layer dielectric composed of fiber jacket and coating based on Maxwell-Wagner polarization model and bipolar carrier transport model. Then the relationship between interfacial discharge characteristics and space charge was studied. The results showed that the charge accumulated at the interface at normal temperature was mainly caused by polarization. However, at higher electric field strength, the injection of space charge gradually increased, and the cumulative effect of interface charge was more obvious. When the interface accumulated space charge, the initial discharge voltage decreased greatly. The interface discharge characteristics are closely related to the space charge behavior at the interface.

articleTitle: High- Temperature Characterization of a Novel Junction Barrier Schottky Diode with Multi-Step Trenched Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a Schottky diode with a new structure is introduced, and four other commercial devices with different structures are selected and compared by high-temperature static and dynamic characterization. Devices with new structures have outstanding advantages in static performance and have good high temperature stability.

articleTitle: Design Optimization of PMSM for Electric Vehicles Based on an Intelligent Surrogate Model Selection Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To optimize the performance of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM), a multidisciplinary design optimization (MDO) method is proposed which considers both motor structure and controller design. Surrogate models are constructs to save computing resources and accelerate the optimization process. In order to solve the problem that the selection of surrogate model depends heavily on the experience of engineers, an intelligent surrogate model selection method (ISMSM) is proposed to obtain a proper surrogate model. Based on ISMSM and the MDO method, the PMSM design parameters are optimized, and the results show a significant improvement in overall performance.

articleTitle: Research on Dynamic Control Model of Multi-Scenario Synchronization in Aircraft Suspension Lifting System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The airborne suspension lifting system is a typical rigid-flexible coupling system. The coupling effect is easily generated by the excitation of the rigid transmission mechanism on the flexible cable composed of steel wire ropes. Meanwhile, the multi-operating conditions and unbalanced characteristics of the load further exacerbate the complexity of synchronous control. In this paper, aiming at the synchronous control problem under multiple operating conditions, a multi-body dynamics model of the airborne suspension lifting system based on the generalized Hamiltonian principle is established. Differential equations of the tension of steel wire ropes are proposed, and dynamic analysis under multiple operating conditions is conducted in combination with experimental data. The influence of unbalanced loads on the tension of the cable is studied, and the variation law of cable tension response during the lifting process of the system is obtained, providing data support and theoretical basis for the design of synchronous control of the lifting system.

articleTitle: Hyperopia Optimization of Electric Vehicle Charging and Discharging Considering Discontinuous Parking Patterns
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have been widely recognized as demand-side controllable loads, exhibiting substantial flexibility potential for demand response. However, challenges arise when controlling EVs to deliver ancillary services to the grid, primarily due to the uncertain temporal and energy consumption requirements imposed by the stochastic and discontinuous EV parking patterns. To address this issue, this paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based optimization method for EV charging and discharging control, taking into consideration of the inherent fluences of flexibility dispatchment between current and adjacent parking epochs. Firstly, the paper proposes a stochastic parking model through simulating daily parking sequences with time and energy requirements. Secondly, a flexibility feasible region model is formulated to quantitatively describe the time availability and energy demand constraints for each parking epochs. Finally, a DRL-based framework is established for hyperopia optimization of EV flexibility dispatchment under real-time pricing mechanisms. The results demonstrate that the proposed approach not only fine-tunes EV scheduling within individual parking epochs, but also enhances the demand response performance in adjacent parking epoch by proactively deploying charging and discharging behaviors.

articleTitle: Parasitic Parameters Identification of High-Frequency Transformers Including Both Inductive and Capacitive Effects
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the parasitic parameters identification of the high-frequency transformers (HFTs), namely the magnetization inductance. With the rapid increase of the operating frequency of the power electronic switches, parasitic effects are getting more and more important as well as the displacement current which is unreasonable to be neglected in the high-frequency range. Unlike the traditional way to identify these parameters by solving the electro-quasistatic or the magneto-quasistatic Maxwell models respectively, the A- V model coupling with the electric circuit in the frequency domain is employed to consider the displacement current. Then, the electric field and magnetic field can be solved simultaneously to study the capacitive and inductive effects. The parasitic parameters of a 2-dimensional HFT changing with the frequency are studied by involving the displacement current, and results are compared with those solved by the magneto-quasistatic models in the paper. It is shown that the parasitic parameters extracted by using the A- V model show quite a different characteristic compared with the traditional method. It is helpful for the design and better understanding of the performance analysis of HFT.

articleTitle: Intantaneous Complex Frequency of Three-Phase AC Systems: Concept and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In modern three-phase AC systems with high penetration of power electronic converters, the amplitudes and frequencies of electrical quantities such as voltage and current change dynamically over time. The increasing use of new energy sources threatens the stability of system, thereby increasing the demand for dynamic analysis. The traditional frequency concept could be insufficient to accurately describe the dynamic behavior of a strongly time-varying system. Besides, the differential equations derived in stationary or synchronous reference frames are inconvenient to characterize the dynamic behavior of instantaneous amplitude and frequency. Therefore, this paper develops the concept of instantaneous complex frequency (ICF), from the complex phase angle concept, offering a new mathematical tool for analyzing the dynamic behavior of the three-phase AC systems. The ICF characteristics of passive components are analyzed based on the definition of ICF, and are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of a Long Distance and Multi-Load WPT System with Hybrid Coil Forms
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the long-distance multi-coil wireless power transfer (WPT) system, excessive cross-coupling between coils may cause a current increase in the coils. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a WPT system with a combination of unipolar and bipolar coils, which effectively reduces the cross-coupling and suppresses coil currents. Based on the proposed coil structure, a multi-load WPT system with a power transmission distance of more than 5m was simulated, achieving a transmission efficiency of 64.6% and an output power of over 1kW

articleTitle: An Enhanced Harmonic Current Suppression Scheme for VSG Grid-Tied Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The slight distortion of the grid voltage will form a harmonic loop through the low harmonic impedance of the virtual synchronizer, causing distortion of the grid current. To address these problems, the existing harmonic current suppression schemes for virtual synchronous machines are based on the compensation of the harmonic voltage of the parallel network, which is limited by the line impedance and the size of the feedback gain, resulting in a limited harmonic suppression effect. In this paper, we propose a harmonic current suppression method for virtual synchronous machine with parallel branch and feedforward, which effectively improves the harmonic current suppression capability of virtual synchronous machine. By sampling the net-side output current of VSG, the proposed digital second-order fundamental trap is used to remove the fundamental component of the net-side current and feed forward to the input of the current inner loop of the virtual synchronous machine; at the same time, a parallel branch consisting of a second-order digital high-gain phase compensator is added to the current inner loop of the virtual synchronous machine, and the harmonic component in the input of the current inner loop of the virtual synchronous machine is fed forward for closed-loop control, thus This scheme achieves the suppression of harmonic currents on the network side of the virtual synchronous machine. Compared with the existing scheme, this scheme converts the open-loop suppression of harmonic currents common to the existing method into a more direct closed-loop control of harmonic currents, which is an effective way to realize the suppression of harmonic currents on the network side of the virtual synchronous machine.

articleTitle: Parameter design method for active damping of inverter with LC filter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: There is a resonance problem in the inverter with LC filter, and the common solution is the active damping control method based on differential feedback of the output capacitor voltage. The traditional active damping parameter design method is easy to make the system unstable due to the control delay. Aiming at the problem, an active damping parameter design method based on capacitor voltage feedback is proposed in this paper. The method improves the stability of the system through accurate parameter design, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are confirmed simulation and experimental results.

articleTitle: Analysis of Electric Field Characteristics and Defect Diagnosis for Local Cable Breakage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Frequency domain reflectometry (FDR) is an effective method for diagnosing cable defects. The simulation models of FDR are built based on the distributed parameters of cables. Different types and severities of defects exhibit distinct distributed parameters. However, current studies have yet to conduct a quantitative analysis on how various defects influence the distributed parameters. Consequently, the parameters in simulation models are often determined subjectively, relying on empirical judgment. That leads to inaccurate correspondence between the simulation models and the actual defect conditions. This paper investigates the electric field distribution characteristics of local cable breakage defects with different severities, calculates the distributed parameters and analyzes their evolution rules. Subsequently, these calculated parameters are introduced into the FDR models, enabling successful location and identification of the cable breakage defects. This paper holds significant importance for the quantitative analysis of breakage defect characteristics and advances the theoretical and simulation researches in FDR.

articleTitle: Analysis of Load Impedance Characteristics and Design of Compensation Parameters for IPT System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rectifier causes the load-equivalent AC impedance of the load to be inductive or capacitive. In severe cases, there will be a loss of duty cycle, which will not only reduce the system efficiency, but also limit the range of load changes, and also increase the difficulty of closed-loop control and system modeling. This paper analyzes the characteristics of the energy transmission system and presents the equivalent circuit in continuous conduction mode. For C-filter rectifier, load AC impedance is resistive load parallel inductanc. For LC-filter rectifier, load AC impedance is resistance series capacitor. Based on the system equivalent circuit, the parameter design methods of different compensation topologies are summarized to solve the problems of output voltage fluctuation and reactive power increase caused by non-resistive load.

articleTitle: Coupling Effects of Internal Circulating Current on AC-Side of MMC-Based Multiport Energy Router
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Utilizing the power transfer capability of sub-modules (SMs) of modular multilevel converter (MMC), multi-types of distributed energy resources (DERs), such as photovoltaics and batteries, could be distributed integrated into MMC in combination or individual mode, forming the MMC-based multiport energy router (MMC-MER). The components of internal circulating current are determined by the power distribution of DERs, and are coupled with the harmonic components of MMC-MER AC-side. This paper first analyzes the relationship between power distribution of DERs and the internal circulating current components. Then, considering the internal circulating current control, this paper reveals the coupling effects of internal circulating current on the harmonic components of MMC-MER AC-side. To fulfill the harmonic criterion of grid-connected inverter and improve the power quality, this paper develops a harmonic current suppression control to mitigate the harmonic currents. Finally, the simulation model is established in Matlab/Simulink environment and verifies the effectiveness of proposed control.

articleTitle: Comparison of broadband performance of Current measurement technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Current measuring devices are widely used in electric power systems, In this paper, the current measurement devices are divided into five categories: shunt, current transformer, Rogowski coil, magnetic sensor and new type current sensor. The structural characteristics, performance parameters and measurement performance optimization scheme of various high current sensing devices are analyzed in this paper. Finally, the development trend and application prospect of current measurement technology in the context of renewable energy grid-connection are outlooked.

articleTitle: Investigation on the Transient Performance Improvement of Dual-Active-Bridge Converters Based on Optimal Current Stress Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dual-active-bridge (DAB) converters are widely used in DC microgrids, electric vehicle charging, and other fields due to the excellent performance in bidirectional power transmission. In recent years, the transient performance improvement and steady-state optimization strategies of DAB have been widely discussed and studied. In terms of steady-state optimization, optimal control strategies targeting different optimization obj ectives have been proposed. In terms of transient performance improvement, there are already many effective control strategies for DAB converters under single-phase-shift (SPS) control. However, for the optimal current stress (OCS) control, there are still few corresponding transient performance improvement strategies to coordinate with it. Aiming at improving transient performance, this paper first investigates the impact of PI parameters on the DAB converter under SPS control and provides a reference for PI parameter adjustment based on the conclusion. For optimal current stress control based on triple-phase-shift (TPS) control with complex transient processes, virtual resistance feedforward (VRF) control is proposed to improve the transient performance of the DAB converter. Finally, the correctness of the analysis conclusion and the effectiveness of the proposed VRF control are verified via MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Active Voltage Support Control Method for Static Var Generator in Distribution Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Distribution grid static var generator (SVG) is an effective means to improve power quality problems such as voltage offset and reactive power. Most of the existing SVG use phase-locked-loop based grid synchronous control technology, which has weak dynamic voltage support capability due to the reasons such as phase-locked-loop bandwidth and response speed of AC voltage control. To address this problem, an active voltage support method for SVG is proposed, which uses power synchronization control and is able to quickly support and grid voltage stabilization when grid voltage fluctuation occurs. MATLAB/Simulink simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: An Electric-Field Coupled Power and Data Simultaneous Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a single-wire electric-field coupled power and signal transmission system based on shared channel. The two-plate electric-field coupled system using a single-wire structure could transfer power in seawater. Firstly, the parameters of double-sided T-LCL compensation network are calculated by using the integral double T method. The power transmission channel with easy expandability for signal loading is built, and both of output and anti-frequency offset characteristics of the system are analyzed. Secondly, a signal transmission branch based on shared channel is designed, and the models of power and signal channels are established to analyze the feasibility of parallel transmission of power and signal. Finally, through experimental verification, the system could achieve power transmission of 83.1W in seawater at over 84% efficiency with anti-frequency offset characteristics, and the duplex signal transmission speed is 100kbps.

articleTitle: SAPF-Based AC Chopper Converter with Enhanced Input and Load Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: AC chopper converter has drawn lots of attention because of high conversion efficiency and economical excellency. However, due to lack of adaptability for input distortion, nonlinear load and output filter perturbation, the output quality faces severe risk in practical. Fortunately, series active power filter (SAPF) offers a solution because of its power quality improvement capability for user side. In this paper, DC-capacitor-based SAPF is chosen and bandpass filter is adopted for harmonic detection. A dual-loop control is used to maintain its input DC voltage and track the output reference. Rolling-RMS (root mean square)-based control is designed for AC chopper converter as well as AC-DC-AC converter for comparison. Simulation verification indicates that AC chopper converter with SAPF possesses obvious advantage when facing nonlinear load, input harmonic, input DC component and output filter perturbation. In economical analysis, it is reasonable to apply SAPF to AC chopper converter.

articleTitle: A Simplified Calculation Method for Induced Lightning Overvoltage of 10 kV Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In China, 10 kV distribution network lightning accidents are mainly caused by induced lightning. In the process of 10 kV overhead line lightning protection research, the most important point is the induced lightning overvoltage calculation. At present, the differential numerical calculation method based on FDTD is mainly used. However, the simulation model building process based on this method is complicated, and the computational efficiency is low, which cannot meet the needs of designers and operators for power grid. In this paper, by analyzing the main influencing factors and influencing laws, a simplified calculation method of induced lightning overvoltage based on the differential numerical calculation method of FDTD is proposed, which can quickly obtain the magnitude of the induced lightning overvoltage of the 10 kV overhead line, avoiding the complex physical simulation modeling and numerical calculation process, and greatly improving the work efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Modifiers on the Microscopic Properties of Nanoscale ZrO2 Modified Vegetable Transformer Oil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Vegetable transformer oil represents a novel form of eco-friendly insulation material. Nano modification has the capability to enhance its insulation performance. In this research, molecular simulation techniques were utilized to investigate how nano ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> affects the microscopic attributes of vegetable-based transformer oil. Additionally, the study evaluated the influence of different surface modifiers on the performance of transformer oil modified with nanoparticles. Use Material Studio software to establish models of unmodified vegetable transformer oil, modified vegetable transformer oil, and nano ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> transformer oil modified with two surface modifiers: oleic acid and aminopropyltriethoxysilane(APTES). Analyse the interface properties between nano ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> modified with different surfactants and insulating oil molecules from a microscopic perspective. The results indicate that compared to unmodified transformer oil, the vegetable transformer oil model modified with nano ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> has higher adsorption energy, more hydrogen bonds, more electron traps, and a smaller diffusion coefficient of water molecules. It shows that ZrO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> nanoparticles can improve the thermal stability, breakdown voltage and anti-aging performance of vegetable transformer oil. Comparison of two surface modifiers reveals that APTES is more advantageous than oleic acid in improving the insulation performance of nano modified vegetable transformer oil.

articleTitle: Integrated Wind-Energy Storage Primary Frequency Regulation Method Considering Wind Power Frequency Regulation Capability and Fatigue Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This study proposes a novel approach to address the issues of inadequate frequency regulation capabilities and increased fatigue loads in wind turbines operating below rated wind speeds. The limitations of conventional primary frequency regulation in wind turbines are initially analyzed. The research reveals that, below rated wind speeds, the output power fluctuations of wind turbines with high wind power penetration have a significant impact on system frequency deviation. Additionally, insufficient output power affects the frequency regulation capability of wind turbines. Furthermore, primary frequency regulation contributes to a substantial increase in fatigue loads on wind turbines. To overcome these challenges, we present a wind-energy storage coordinated primary frequency regulation method that integrates wind power prediction and model predictive control. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through simulation studies.

articleTitle: Hysteresis-Based Mechanism Analysis of Iron Loss Increment Caused by PWM Harmonics in Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pulse width modulation (PWM) is commonly utilized in voltage-source inverters for driving motors, but it leads to various harmonics components in the voltage and current of the motor, resulting in the loss increment. This paper reveals the mechanism of iron loss increment in motors caused by PWM harmonics based on the hysteresis phenomenon of soft magnetic materials. The voltage and current harmonics induced by the SVPWM supply are analyzed in detail and verified through simulation and experiments. An iron loss calculation method based on a dynamic hysteresis model is proposed. The effect of the excitation harmonics on the magnetic field and hysteresis property is analyzed by combining finite element analysis with the hysteresis-based iron loss calculation method. Taking a 5.5 kW, 3000 rpm PMSM as an example, the hysteresis distortion and iron loss increment mechanism caused by the magnetic field harmonics are discussed in detail. The effects of SVPWM parameters on motor current, magnetic field, hysteresis characteristics, and iron loss are investigated and verified by experiments. The conclusions of this paper can provide a reliable guide for the performance optimization of motors and their control systems.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Energy Consumption and Quality of Plasma Synergistic Drying of Codonopsis Pilosulae
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Drying as a key link in the processing of Chinese herbal medicines, drying quality directly affects the finished products of Chinese herbal medicines. Traditional hot air drying technology has the disadvantages of high energy consumption and easy browning of heat-sensitive components. Plasma drying is characterized by low energy consumption, low pollution, and high retention of medicinal ingredients, and is regarded as a non-thermal drying technology with application prospects. In this paper, plasma technology was applied to the drying treatment of slices of Radix et Rhizoma Ginseng, comparing the drying effects of different drying methods, analyzing the differences in the color and luster of Radix et Rhizoma Ginseng after hot-air drying and synergistic drying with plasma, determining the specific energy consumption of the different drying methods, and determining the content of kynurenine of Radix et Rhizoma Ginseng in the dried samples by using high performance liquid chromatography. The results showed that the plasma drying of the slices belonged to the descending-rate drying process, and there were obvious differences in the drying rate and final moisture content between the different synergistic drying methods; compared with the hot-air-dried herbs, the plasma-dried slices of Codonopsis pilosula were lighter in color and had no obvious browning. The plasma and synergistic drying processes significantly increased the content of ginsenosides in the herbs, while the energy consumption was significantly reduced.

articleTitle: Motion Blurred Image Restoration Network Based on Insulator Defect Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Motion blur generated during aerial photography by UAVs can lead to distortion of the target portion of the captured insulator image, which is not conducive to the subsequent positioning and defect detection of insulators. The motion blur caused by the relative motion between the aerial photography UAV and insulators is usually directional and non-uniform, and is optimized based on the Transformer model in terms of structure and objective function. The self-attention in the Transformer model is improved and combined with convolutional neural network to achieve efficient blurred insulator image restoration without relying on a large amount of training data. Contrast learning is introduced in the objective function part to fully utilize the correlation information between sharp and blurred insulator images. The motion blurred insulator image dataset is constructed for image restoration and defect detection experiments, and the results show that the proposed method outperforms the algorithms such as DeblurGAN-v2 and MIMO-UNet in terms of PSNR and SSIM, and the image quality is greatly improved.

articleTitle: Overvoltage Absorption of Sparse Modular Multilevel Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A topology is presented that is designed to address overvoltage occurrences when the Sparse Modular Multilevel Converter (SMMC) changes voltage polarity. The proposed topology mitigates overvoltage induced by abrupt changes in bridge arm inductance current during voltage commutation. This is achieved by incorporating dual RCD buffer circuits connected in parallel at both ends of the SMMC bridge arm inductance. Additionally, design formulas for the capacitance and resistance in the dual RCD buffer circuits are derived based on the voltage commutation process and operating conditions of the SMMC. The effectiveness of the proposed topology and the design formulas for RCD parameters were validated through simulation.

articleTitle: High Robustness Current Measurement Error Compensation of SPMSM Drives Based on Discrete Fourier Transform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate measurement of current feedback is an important prerequisite for high performance permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drive systems. For the actual control system, due to the thermal drift, aging, nonlinearity and some other factors of the current sensors and the corresponding conditioning circuits, current measurement error will occur and correspondingly will result in torque and speed ripples. To overcome this issue, an online current measurement error compensation (CMEC) method for PMSM drive system is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the influence of different kinds of current measurement errors, the offset error and scaling error, is analyzed from the perspective of open loop control. Secondly, a Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) based CMEC method is proposed. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is validated on a 1kW commercialized servo motor test rig, results show that the proposed method can reduce 80% of the current ripple.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Bond Wire Aging on Junction Temperature Estimation in IGBT Modules
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Insulated Gate Bipolar Transistor (IGBT) is a core component in power electronic systems. The inevitable trend towards higher power density and reliability in future power electronic systems places greater demands on the reliability research of IGBT devices. Accurate junction temperature measurement is fundamental to the health management and reliability assessment of IGBT devices, playing a crucial role in the evaluation of their reliability and health management. However, junction temperature monitoring is susceptible to the influence of module aging, leading to inaccurate temperature measurements. This paper focuses on the junction temperature measurement of IGBT modules and builds on the existing method based on temperature-sensitive electrical parameters (V<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">ee_on</inf>). By conducting an in-depth analysis of IGBT module packaging aging and establishing an equivalent circuit for the parasitic parameters of the IGBT module packaging, this study simulates the aging of IGBT bond wires and investigates its impact on the junction temperature monitoring method based on on-state voltage drop. This provides a research foundation for subsequent accurate junction temperature monitoring that decouples the effects of aging.

articleTitle: Research on 270V High Power Solid State Power Controller for Aircraft Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The emerging aircraft high voltage direct current (HVDC) electric network requires improved interruption performance characteristics, and this motivates the fast development of solid-state power controller (SSPC). This article presents comprehensive design procedure of a 270V 300A SSPC using discrete SiC Cascode devices. Due to the high fault current and limited power of a single switch, parallel SiC FETs are necessary for the interruption of high fault current in SSPCs, thus corresponding current balancing challenge are addressed by only adopting passive current balancing strategy. Considering the high peak-to-average clamping voltage ratio during the interruption of fault current, a RC- TVS based transient voltage mitigation circuit is proposed to suppress the peak voltage caused by Ldi/dt in both power loop and transient voltage mitigation circuit. Finally, a prototype of 270V/300A SSPC is built to validate the key characteristics of the proposed high power SSPC.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Test Scheme of Microcomputer Protection Based on Off-Line Simulation Software
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a closed-loop test method of microcomputer protection based on off-line simulation software. The method obtains the sampling data of power system under various operating conditions by using off-line simulation software, utilizes the data formats obtained by the simulation software by using a special data format conversion tool, and obtains the real and synchronous electricity consumption by means of the digital-analog conversion device. On the basis of considering the setting of the protection device, the inherent action delay and the circuit breaker action delay, the closed-loop test can be realized by reasonably controlling the duration of various running states in the simulation software. This method can realize the test function similar to the real-time digital simulation system, has good flexibility, high precision and low cost, and is suitable for the digital simulation test in the situation where there is no real-time digital simulation system.

articleTitle: Study on the Electric Field Distortion Caused by Interface Defects in the XLPE Insulation of One 20 Hz Cable
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The low-frequency (LF) cable system is expected to have wide applications in medium- to long-distance wind power transmission due to its economic and technical advantages. So far however, there is barely any relevant research performed on both the dielectric properties of the insulation materials and electric field characteristics in the cable insulations under low-frequency voltages. The electric field in the cable insulation will be distorted by defects, especially those located at the insulation-screen interfaces. In this paper, a simulation model is established according to a 35 kV XLPE submarine cable which is used in Taizhou 20 Hz LF demonstration project. Several typical interface defects are introduced into the model, and the electric field distortion of the XLPE insulation caused by the defects are simulated. Then, based on the comparison of dielectric parameters and electric field properties between XLPE cable insulations under 20 Hz and 50 Hz, the allowable defect sizes for LF cable XLPE insulation are deduced.

articleTitle: A P2P Electricity Carbon Joint Trading Strategy for Multiple Virtual Power Plants Based on ADMM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to achieve low-carbon economic operation of VPP, this article proposes a P2P electricity carbon joint trading model to address the issue of neglecting carbon emission benefits while solely focusing on economic considerations in the trading process of multiple VPP. The model takes into account the transaction costs brought about by both VPP energy trading and carbon quota trading, thereby further achieving low-carbon operation of VPP. Firstly, a single VPP model including distributed photovoltaics and energy storage systems was established, and a cost function for the operation of the VPP was constructed. Secondly, a multi VPP electricity trading and carbon quota trading efficiency model was established, and a multi VPP electricity carbon joint trading rule was constructed. Then, the alternating direction multiplier method is used to achieve multi VPP electricity carbon joint trading, effectively protecting the privacy of each VPP. And through case analysis based on IEEE node system, it was verified that the proposed method can effectively support the integration of economic benefits and low-carbon benefits in multi VPP transactions.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control of PMSM In A Gravity Energy Storage System Accounting for Nonlinear Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to achieve precise sensorless control of permanent magnet synchronous motors(PMSM) in the gravity energy storage technology, a control method based on sliding mode observer and compensation measures accounting for inverter dead time effect is proposed in this paper. Firstly, sliding mode observer is integrated into the control model of PMSM. Secondly, considering the control system of PMSM with dead time effect, an adaptive notch filter(ANF) with orthogonal phase-locked loop is put in for dead time compensation. Finally, taking PMSM system with/without dead time compensation as an example, simulation comparisons were conducted on two models. The results show that the compensation method based on ANF with orthogonal phase-locked loop has a good compensation effect and is more conducive to the optimization design of PMSM.

articleTitle: Capacity Value Assessment of PV Power Plants Based on ELCC Index
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The capacity value of photovoltaic (PV) power generation measures its contribution to the capacity adequacy of the power system. This paper employs the credible capacity of PV power generation to express its capacity value. Firstly, a probability-based model for photovoltaic power plants is proposed to account for weather uncertainty. Secondly, we evaluate the power correlation between PV power plants using the Pearson's correlation coefficient and propose a copula function-based power model for PV power plant groups. This model considers the time-variation of radiation and the power correlation. Finally, we utilize the effective load carrying capability (ELCC) index to assess the capacity value of PV power generation. The results demonstrate that this method evaluates the capacity value in a more practical way than traditional methods.

articleTitle: IPMSMs Sensorless MTPA Control Based on Virtual q-Axis Inductance and Triple Frequency Notch Fliter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the traditional virtual injection based maximum-torque-per-ampere(MTP A)sensorless control method, the current vector angle is extracted by using the strategy of combining a band-pass filter(BPF) and a low-pass filter(LPF), and the filtering accuracy and dynamic performance of the observation loop of this strategy are not both available. Moreover, the MTPA and the tracking of rotor position are two separate processes in the traditional method. The proposed algorithm utilizes triple-frequency notch trap(TFNF) filter cascaded with a LPF to improve the dynamic performance and harmonic rejection of the MTPA observation loop, and then constructs a virtual q-axis inductance to complete MTPA control during the process of rotor position estimation. In this method, a virtual high-frequency signal injection is used to obtain the virtual torque response, and then a notch filter and a LPF are used to extract the virtual inductance information, and after obtaining the accurate virtual inductance, it is substituted into the sensorless control algorithm to perform rotor position observation and MTPA control at the same time.

articleTitle: A Feedback Control Strategy for Power Transmission in Dual-Active-Bridge
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dual-active-bridge (DAB) dc/dc converter can be used to achieve power transmission and has been increasingly adopted for dc-dc power conversion systems. In some cases, bi-directional power transmission is requested and a fast, accurate control strategy should be put forward. Feedforward control is not precise enough for interference and the dynamic performance of traditional feedback control with PI controller greatly dependents on the gains of controller. In this paper, a feedback control strategy is proposed to avoid the use of PI controller by analyzing the relationship between output power and phase-shift. And its advantages in steady and dynamic response are proved by theorical analysis and simulation, even when parameter mismatches occur.

articleTitle: Bi-Level Planning for Distributed Power Supply Using the Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Optimizing distributed power supply planning is essential to enhancing the impact of distributed power supply on the secure and cost-effective operation of the distribution network. This study establishes a two-layer programming model and selects wind power, solar, and micro-gas turbines as distributed power sources to be scheduled. This study aims to improve the whale algorithm by utilizing tent mapping, inertial weight, and nonlinear shrinkage factor to address issues like slow convergence and delayed jumping out of local solutions. This study solves the proposed model on the IEEE-33 node system using the enhanced whale algorithm and compares the outcome with other techniques. The enhanced whale algorithm offers the most noticeable improvement in node voltage and the lowest annual comprehensive cost, according to the data.

articleTitle: Fundamental Analysis of Underwater Wireless Power Transfer Based on Ball-Joint Connector
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel ball-joint connector system for wireless underwater autonomous vehicle (AUV) charging. The ball-joint connector comprises a ball head and a tee, where transmitting coils and receiving coils respectively are equipped. Different types of coils-solid, litz, and tubular coils, are analyzed across different operating frequencies and diameters. All design parameters are optimized to achieve maximum transmission efficiency based on the size limitations of the ball-joint connector. Meanwhile, SS and LCC compensation topologies are analyzed under various mutual inductance and load alteration conditions for underwater environment. The proposed system was both verified in simulation and experiments, ensuring reliable wireless power transmission. The ball-joint connector equipped with litz coils and LCC compensation exhibits high transmission efficiency and disturbance resistance. The transmission efficiency can reach 94% in the simulation environment, while the output current remains essentially constant within a 20% range of load variation.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Photovoltaic Utilization Potential on Building Rooftops based on Image Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the face of escalating global energy shortages and the pressing issue of climate change, nations are increasingly prioritizing the protection of the ecological environment and the transition to sustainable renewable energy. Promoting the sustainable development of renewable resources has become a common goal. Among these resources., solar energy stands out as a pristine and sustainable option with promising prospects. Rooftop photovoltaic (PV) installations, leveraging their unrestricted geographical applicability and minimal land resource requirements, emerge as the forefront choice for harnessing solar energy. In this work, we propose an improved SegFormer model to identify different types of building roofs and assess the PV potential of these roofs, integrating solar radiation data from the targeted region. Our experiments in N anjing reveal compelling results: 412,106 building roofs are deemed suitable, covering an area of 170.6 square kilometers, with an installed capacity of 23,521.19 megawatts. The annual PV power generation capacity reaches an impressive 25,391.22 gigawatt-hours, and the annual carbon reduction potential is 14.48 million tons, indicating substantial potential for PV installations, power generation and carbon reduction. Importantly, the method proposed herein has the capacity to swiftly evaluate city-scale PV potential, offering essential data support for PV system planning within the power grid.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis Study of Magnetic Leakage Prevention Based on DD Coil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: DD coil coupler is widely used in wireless power transfer system, which can improve the magnetic field in the middle of coupler. However, the edge leakage of the DD coil is always happened. This paper investigates the design of DD coils which are based on the antielectromagnetic leakage effect and analyzes the traditional DD coil model. Two solution methods are proposed for the electromagnetic leakage problem: change the edge turn-to-turn moments of the DD coil and add excited coils on both sides of the DD coil. By comparing these two design methods, the excited coils model has the best effect to solve the electromagnetic leakage problem.

articleTitle: Magnetically Integrated Low-Voltage High-Current Converter with CDR and TLVR for Data Center
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of emerging information technologies such as blockchain, artificial intelligence and cloud computing, many large-scale data centers have been established. These data centers have high power requirements to drive CPUs and GPUs. Due to the low supply voltage, high current, and fast power change of CPUs and GPUs, data center power solutions face the challenges of high conversion rate, high current, and fast transient response. In this paper, we propose a low-voltage high-current converter based on half-bridge and current-doubler rectifiers, where coupled inductors and trans-inductors will be used on the output side to improve the dynamic response. A novel core structure is proposed where the transformers, coupled inductors and trans-inductors are integrated into a single core structure. A prototype of the proposed topology and magnetically integrated design was fabricated with an input voltage of 48 V and an output voltage of 0.75 V. The results were tested for output currents ranging from 10A to 120A.

articleTitle: Minimizing Copper Loss Via Optimizing Current Distribution in Doubly Salient Electromagnetic Machine
