The design process of the sliding mode controller is described in detail Finally, the proposed online optimization strategy is validated in the Simulink simulation platform. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed STNFTSM control method can significantly reduce the dynamic response overshoot of the system and eliminate the steady-state chattering problem of traditional sliding mode controllers.

articleTitle: Pioneering Field Test and Performance Analysis of Photovoltaic Self-Synchronous Voltage Source
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Photovoltaic self-synchronizing voltage source (PV-SVS) is a promising grid-forming control strategy. By utilizing the reserved power capacity, the energy-storage-free PV-SVS can actively contribute both active and reactive power to the grid. Moreover, under specific conditions, it can work independently, providing stable voltage and frequency to critical loads. This paper introduces a control strategy of the energy-storage-free PV-SVS. Leveraging the national wind and solar energy storage demonstration base, a demonstration operation of the PV-SVS was conducted. Pioneering experiments included active grid support, grid mode to island mode switching, independent black start, and multi-unit parallel grid connection. The results demonstrate that compared to traditional PQ-source photovoltaic inverters, PV-SVS exhibits significant advantages in enhancing renewable energy grid-friendliness and voltage/frequency independent support capability. It provides a viable technical solution for large-scale renewable energy integration, especially in scenarios without conventional power source support.

articleTitle: High Impedance Fault Detection in Distribution Network Using Knowledge Reasoning and ANFIS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The paper proposes a high impedance fault (HIF) detection method in distribution network using knowledge reasoning and adaptive-network-based fuzzy inference system (ANFIS). First, a number of characteristic quantities are list based on the zero-sequence current (ZSC) of HIF. Second, a subset that best reflects the fault characteristics is filtered out from alternative feature quantities based on theoretical analysis and practical testing. Then, feature quantity vectors calculated from each sample are used to train the HIF inference model based on the adaptive fuzzy neural network. The test result shows that, the third harmonic content, fifth harmonic content, total harmonic content, root mean square, peaking factor of ZSC better reflect the HIF fault information. The accuracy of the obtained fault inference model for the identification of high resistance grounding faults in distribution networks reaches 98.72%.

articleTitle: Research of interleaved hysteresis control based on soft-switching power amplifier
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper delves into the interleaved hysteresis control method based on soft-switching power amplifiers. Firstly, through modeling and analysis, the basic topology and mode transition of the soft-switching power amplifier are clearly defined, revealing the conditions for implementing soft-switching. Secondly, a strategy for interleaved soft-switching hysteresis control is proposed, detailing its working principle, and the frequency range of the interleaved hysteresis loop is obtained through analysis. In order to optimize the design of the filter, this paper also deeply analyzes the design methods and parameter selection of the filter inductance, providing a theoretical foundation for the implementation of the power amplifier. The research results show that the proposed interleaved soft-switching hysteresis control method can reduce switch losses and electromagnetic interference, thereby improving the efficiency and reliability of the power amplifier. This study provides beneficial theoretical support and practical guidance for the application of high-performance motor drive systems.

articleTitle: Comparison and Analysis of Electromagnetic Characteristics of Hybrid Excitation Generator with Staggered Poles Under Different Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the topology structure, operation principle and the ability of magnetization and demagnetization of two kinds of hybrid excitation staggered pole machine are compared and analyzed. The difference between the two structures lies in the different positions of the ferromagnetic pole, permanent magnet and DC excitation winding. The two structures can be divided into two section and three section structures. In this paper, the three-dimensional equivalent magnetic circuit method is used for fast analytical modeling of the motor, and the three-dimensional finite element method and the three-dimensional equivalent magnetic circuit are used to analyze the two structures. The ability of increasing and demagnetizing of two sections and three sections staggered pole motor under no-load is analyzed and compared. It is concluded that the magnetizing ability of the two segment structure motor is better than that of the three segment structure motor, while the opposite is true when demagnetizing. Finally, a 10kW two-stage hybrid excitation generator is analyzed for no-load demagnetization results, which verifies the correctness of the equivalent magnetic circuit model.

articleTitle: Study on Characteristics of Surface Pulsed Discharge Over Carbon Foil in Water
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the phenomenon of liquid-solid interfacial discharge along a carbon foil immersed in water medium has been investigated. Based on the multi-physical diagnoses and high-speed photography, the pulsed discharges were performed under different charging voltages and electrode spacing. Compared with the traditional water-gap breakdown, it is found that introducing a carbon foil can significantly diminish the breakdown delay (less than 1 µs) and lower the requirement of applied voltage (kV/cm level). Charging voltage and electrode spacing affect the discharge load voltage, loop current and load power. When the charging voltage increases from 4.5 kV to 6.3 kV, the current peak increases from 2.352 kA to 3.583 kA, the voltage peak increases from 0.690 kV to 1.692 kV, and the power peak increases nearly two times. In addition, the discharge will produce light radiation, and an increase in charging voltage from 4.5 kV to 6.3 kV can increase the intensity of light radiation by 2.39 times. The discharge can also produce pressure waves lasting tens of microseconds and has a bubble effect. When the charging voltage increases from 4.5 kV to 8.9 kV, the maximum radial diameter of the bubble increases from 9.15 mm to 15.35 mm. This study not only enriches the fundamental research problems of liquid-solid interface discharge but also gives an alternative scheme of water gap discharge in technology, which improves the controllability and efficiency of underwater discharge.

articleTitle: Condition Recognition of High-Voltage Circuit Breakers Using Data Augmentation Vision Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: An improved data augmentation vision transformer-based method for the recognition of the High Voltage Circuit Breaker (HVCB) condition is proposed in this paper. The method utilizes the vision transformer approach to differentiate states by enhancing the time-frequency domain features of vibration signals through Continuous Wavelet Transform (CWT). A novel vision transformer network is constructed to enhance local feature extraction capabilities. In the performance verification phase, vibration data from HVCB in four different states were collected for comparison. The results demonstrate that the average condition recognition rate of the proposed method reaches 98.91 %showcasing a significant improvement over conventional vision transformer methods. Moreover, it outperforms current mainstream CNN models, providing evidence of the effectiveness of the vision transformer approach.

articleTitle: Spectral Detection of Decomposition Products of C4F7N/CO2/O2 Mixed Gas
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Perfluoroisobutyronitrile (molecular formula C4F7N) is currently one of the best-known alternative environmentally friendly insulating gases for SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6.</inf> Due to the high liquefaction temperature of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N gas, it needs to be mixed with N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and dry air for use. GIS equipment using C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> ternary mixture gas as insulation and arc extinguishing medium has been promoted and applied. However, the C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture gas will decompose under partial discharge and overheating faults, generating characteristic decomposition products such as CO, carbon-fluorine gas, fluoronitrile (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">y</inf>CN), COF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, and CNCN. Qualitative and quantitative analysis of decomposition products can be used for gas decomposition state evaluation, equipment state diagnosis, and other fields. In this paper, Raman spectra of C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</inf>N/CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>/O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> mixture gas and decomposition products under different electric fields were obtained through quantum chemical calculations. This provides basic data for the qualitative detection of C4F7N mixed gas and its decomposition products. The research results indicate that the Raman spectra of gas molecules under different electric fields exhibit characteristic peak shifts, which can be used for the simultaneous qualitative detection of multiple decomposition products. This study provides a new approach for the potential application of Raman spectroscopy in the detection of C4F7N mixed gas decomposition products.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Auxiliary Power Module Using GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The auxiliary power module (APM) of electric vehicles (EV s) provides power for the 12 V battery system. Since the EV s are becoming more intelligent and versatile, the increasing load requires a compact size, lightweight, and high-efficiency APM. Gallium nitride (GaN), as a kind of wide bandgap power device, has the advantages of low loss, zero reverse recovery current, etc. The aforementioned features enable GaN HEMTs to be a good solution for next-generation EV auxiliary power modules. This paper aims to design and optimize a 2.5 kW, 400/12 V APM using GaN HEMTs. It employs a dual active bridge DC-DC converter as the topology. The hardware and the magnetic components are optimized via theoretical analysis and simulation. Due to the large output current., extended phase-shift control is employed to minimize the current stress on the power devices. The experimental results have validated the theoretical analysis and the hardware optimization.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of AC Loss in Variable-section Hairpin Windings for Traction Motors of Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In electric vehicles, hairpin windings are used to increase the torque and power density of motors. The main disadvantage of hairpin windings is the high AC loss incurred during high-frequency operation. Hairpin windings with variable section conductors can overcome this problem, but there is a lack of analytical models for AC losses in such unconventional windings and an analysis of the manufacturing complexity of unconventional windings. In this paper, the mechanisms of AC loss generation in hairpin windings are firstly analyzed and its expression is derived. Then, based on the field-circuit coupled finite element method, the AC loss analysis model of four kinds of variable-section hairpin winding topologies is established, aiming at summarizing the variation rule of AC loss with motor parameters in such windings. Finally, to verify the feasibility of additive manufacturing of windings, the most suitable material for the current application is selected based on the loss properties.

articleTitle: Current Harmonic Suppression at Low Switching Frequency of High-Speed Permanent Magnet Motor Based on Decoupling Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to a variety of issues, such as high switching device losses and unstable operation induced by high inverter operating frequencies during operation, high-speed permanent magnet motors are frequently run in environments with low inverter switching frequencies. This paper investigates the problems of severe dq-axis current coupling and high harmonic current content when high-speed permanent magnet synchronous motor operates at low switching frequency. In the current loop, a feedforward decoupling control technique is used to achieve dynamic decoupling of dq-axis currents. In addition, a harmonic suppression algorithm based on harmonic voltage injection is proposed, which extracts the stator harmonic currents under the 5th and 7th harmonics synchronous rotating coordinate system and derives the harmonic voltage expression to calculate the harmonic voltages, and finally injects the harmonic voltages into the voltage feedback link of the system to achieve the effect of current harmonic suppression. Simulation proves that this control method can effectively realize dq-axis current decoupling and suppress stator current distortion, indicating that the control algorithm adopted in this paper can achieve the research purpose.

articleTitle: Review of the Development of Innovative Wind Power Generation Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, the global offshore wind power is accelerating its expansion from near sea to deep sea. The application scenarios of wind power are becoming more diverse. However, the large-scale production of conventional wind turbines faces significant challenges such as large size and heavy weight, and difficulties in transportation and installation. Deep offshore high-power wind turbines and diversified application scenarios pose an urgent need for innovative wind power technologies. The article investigates the development status of new wind power generation technologies at home and abroad, summarizes the development status of different new technology paths such as multi-rotor wind turbines, new vertical axis wind turbines, and airborne wind power generation, and analyzes the industrialization development trend of different technology paths, in order to provide reference for promoting wind power innovation solutions from laboratory research to industrial development.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of Three-Phase Grid-Tied Inverter With Reduced Common-Mode Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Common-mode voltage is a key performance index when evaluating modulation methods in grid-tied converters, since it threatens specific loads, like motors, and introduces severe electromagnetic interference to power grid. Though many proposed methods decrease common mode voltage through not using zero voltage vectors, they bring more current distortion due to limited voltage vectors can be chosen. In this paper, a new method combining model prediction with NSPWM to realize low common mode voltage and less load current harmonic distortion is proposed. This paper predicts the current trajectories according to circuit and decides the optimal duration time of each voltage vector. The proposed method considers the tracking error at every conjunction time of adjacent vectors rather than only the end time of a period to reduce load current distortion and uses constraint high level time to avoid the appearance of zero voltage vector.

articleTitle: Thermal Resistance Modeling to Analyze and Simulate of Quad Flat No-Leads Packaging on Printed Circuit Board by Using ANSYS
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern electrical and electronic technology, there is a growing challenge for traditional quad flat no-leads (QFN) packaging to face the demands of high voltage and current in power systems. Despite its popularity for microelectronic devices due to high integration and excellent thermal performance, QFN packaging is susceptible to significant power loss and heat generation during operation, potentially leading to chip damage and device failure. Therefore, ensuring temperature stability within QFN packaging is crucial. This article presents a thermal resistance network model that analyzes the heat dissipation path from the QFN packaging to the surrounding environment. Utilizing the commercial simulation software ANSYS, this model serves as a valuable tool for evaluating the thermal performance of QFN packaging. The data obtained from the simulations demonstrate the effectiveness of accurately calculating the temperature distribution of QFN packaging. Ultimately, this analysis model can offer valuable insights for optimizing the layout design and material selection of QFN packaging.

articleTitle: The Design Optimization of the High-Frequency Planar Transformers for Electric Vehicle Chargers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric vehicle chargers can be divided into high-voltage DC (HVDC) system for charging power battery and low-voltage DC (LVDC) system for supplying low-voltage battery. Since the next generation EVs is getting smarter, they calls for chargers with higher power rating, higher power density and reduced loss which poses challenges for the LVDC systems design. In this paper, LLC resonant DC/DC converter is selected for HVDC system and two-stage converter with a Buck/Boost converter and an SRC converter is used for LVDC system. Circuit parameter design and high frequency (HF) planar transformer design are conducted for the aforementioned two kinds of converters respectively. For HVDC system, a transformer integrating resonant inductance and magnetizing inductance on a core is designed, and for LVDC system, a quarter-turn transformer is designed. The rationality and high efficiency of the two high HF planar transformer designs are verified by simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: A Reversible Degradation Adaptive Avoidance-Driven Echo State Network: Application to Fuel Cell Prognostics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Inadequate stack durability limits the wide commercialization of fuel cell vehicles. A crucial prerequisite in enhancing fuel cell stack durability is the accurate prediction of their remaining useful life. During long-term operation, fuel cell stacks may encounter reversible degradation, which poses challenges to prediction accuracy and undermines remaining useful life estimation. This work attempts to isolate reversible degradation using diagnostic techniques to improve prognostic performance. The proposed prognostic strategy is tested on a dynamic working condition dataset. The results show that the proposed method reduces the symmetric mean absolute percentage error and improves the relative accuracy.

articleTitle: Multi-Frequency Impedance Measurement Method for DC Link Capacitor of Flexible DC Converter Valve
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The DC Link capacitor is a crucial component of the sub-module in the flexible DC converter valve. Its electrical performance directly impacts the operation of the valve. Due to the complex operating conditions of the converter valve, the capacitor is susceptible to deterioration during long-term operation, leading to changes in its electrical parameters. Therefore, it is essential to find an effective multi-frequency impedance measurement method for the capacitor. This paper presents the construction of three capacitor electrical parameter measurement test platforms. The test results indicate that the offline measurement method, which uses high-voltage bridge measurement, has high accuracy. On the other hand, the online monitoring algorithm has lower cost and higher flexibility. These findings provide a research basis for the capacitor condition monitoring method.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Frequency Diversion Phase Shift Hybrid Control LLC Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing attention to environmental problems, the field of clean energy such as electric energy has ushered in a good period of its development. The LLC resonant converter that can achieve a primary-side zero voltage switch and secondary-side zero current switch in the full load range can meet the current situation of a wide output range of clean energy. This paper first introduces the principle of the converter. Then, the two commonly used control methods of the LLC converter, namely, frequency conversion and phase shift control, are introduced. In addition, this paper analyzes the converter through the first harmonic approximation, derives its mathematical model, and uses it to design the converter parameters in the following introduction. Finally, the simulation is carried out, and the two control modes are combined at the output voltage equal to the power supply voltage to realize the hybrid control function of frequency conversion step-up and phase shift step-down.

articleTitle: Review of Electric Vehicles Supporting Reliable Operation of New Power Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The construction of a new energy-based power system is an essential measure to achieve China's goal of “double carbon”. Finding strategies to support the safe and dependable functioning of the power grid is crucial since the intermittent and unpredictable nature of new energy power generation increases the risk to the system's ability to operate safely and steadily. This paper first introduces the power system security., reliability and related concepts; Secondly., the flexibility of electric vehicles., their participation in distribution network operation and their impact on system operation are evaluated. Finally., the safe and stable operation of electric vehicle supporting new power systems is prospected.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Partial Power Systems Based on Impedance Remodeling
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In a battery energy storage system based on partial power conversion, the battery series end and the bus end are coupled to each other. After fully considering this effect, this paper performs impedance modeling for this topology. Aiming at the system instability under the battery discharge condition, an impedance remodeling control strategy is proposed by equivalent transformation of the system control block diagram. This method adjusts the intersection range between the output impedance of the source converter and the input impedance of the load converter in a small frequency range to meet the stabilization requirement of matching the system impedance. Finally, the effectiveness and practicability of the proposed battery energy storage converter scheme and control method are verified by completing the system simulation and building an experimental platform.

articleTitle: Analysis of Transformer Vibration Caused by Stray Currents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale construction and operation of the metro, the urban power grid has seen the intrusion of metro stray currents causing transformer DC paramagnetism, resulting in increased transformer vibration and noise, and increased probability of failure. This paper firstly introduces the propagation path of transformer vibration, theoretically analyses the vibration spectral characteristics of transformer DC bias operation, and then through the vibration measurement of a 500kV transformer, the measured data will be subjected to spectral analysis, time-domain analysis, as well as the analysis of acceleration in different positions and different axial directions of the transformer, and obtains the influence law of stray currents on the vibration of the transformer.

articleTitle: Reserach on 3rd-Order PLL for Sensorless Control of Electrical Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The real-time position information of the rotor is necessary for vector control. Sensorless vector-controlled electrical machines are widely used in modern industry. Phase locked loop (PLL) can be used to extract the position and speed information after the fluxes or back electromotive forces (BEMFs) are estimated by the observer. Several third-order PLLs have been introduced to improve the dynamics compared with conventional second-order PLL. This paper aims at discussing the parameter selection approach. In this paper, the conventional PLL method is analyzed at first. Secondly, the pole assignment method of conventional PLL is discussed. Thirdly, the parameter selection technique for third-order PLL is analyzed. The overshoot phenomenon of 3rd-order PLL is discussed. Lastly, the feasibility of 3rd-order PLL is demonstrated by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Configuration Optimization of Hybrid Electrolyzer for Wind-Based Green Hydrogen Production System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As the development of renewable energy progresses, the prospects for the application of green hydrogen are gradually expanding, with countries strengthening the construction of industries related to green hydrogen. This paper investigates the hybrid electrolytic hydrogen production system and its configuration optimization problem, considering wind power decomposition and multiple types of electrolyzers. Firstly, a model for wind power redistribution is established based on the characteristics of different types of electrolyzers to determine the power loads of each type. Subsequently, based on the solution results of the redistribution model, a hybrid electrolyzer system configuration optimization model with the objective of maximizing annual revenue is proposed. Finally, case studies show that Hybrid electrolyzer system offers advantages in terms of energy efficiency, reliability and economy. Compared to alkaline electrolyzer system, hybrid system can improve the efficiency and stability of energy utilization and better cope with the uncertainty of renewable energy sources. The hybrid system can significantly reduce the initial capital investment and number of configurations compared to proton exchange membrane electrolyzer system, thereby lowering the operating cost of the overall energy system.

articleTitle: Research on Nonlinear Observer Sensorless Algorithm Based on Parameter Identification Under Field Weakening Control for SPMSMs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous motor(SPMSM) is in the stage of high-speed weak magnetism, the parameters such as flux linkage and resistance will be perturbed. In order to improve the accuracy and reliability of the observation position of the nonlinear flux linkage observer, this paper has designed a nonlinear observer sensorless algorithm based on parameter identification under field weakening control. The algorithm has high observation accuracy, good dynamic performance and strong robustness, and for the problem of high-speed field weakening parameter variation of the motor, the system can update the motor parameters through parameter identification, and still accurately observe the rotor position of the motor, which further improves the accuracy and reliability of the system. The simulation results prove the correctness of this algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on Power System and Energy Management Strategy of Fuel Cell Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the power and economy of fuel cell vehicles, a fuzzy control strategy optimized by genetic algorithm is proposed. Traditional fuel cells have some evident shortcomings, such as soft output voltage and current characteri-stics, slow dynamic response speed, slow starting speed and inability to absorb braking energy. The auxiliary energy is added in the power system of fuel cell vehicle to achieve peak and valley reduction of fuel cell output power, so that the fuel cell can only meet the vehicle performance requirements under normal conditions. The fuzzy control strategy optimized by genetic algorithm can distribute the output power of fuel cell and battery effectively and rationally, and give full play to the advantages of power system. The design principle of the method is introduced in detail, and the vehicle model is established. The results show that the proposed control scheme is well controlled, the vehicle power meets the design requirements, and its economy is also improved.

articleTitle: Research on Control Strategy of Participating in Frequency Regulation for the System of DFIG-Based Wind Farm Connected to the Grid via Fractional Frequency Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Fractional frequency transmission., as a new type of wind power grid-connection method., is suitable for large-capacity and long-distance transmission of electric power. However., the access of large-scale wind power will lead to the reduction of power system inertia and frequency stability. For the fractional-frequency doubly-fed wind power system., this paper utilizes the static electric energy stored in the capacitance of the modular multi-level matrix converter (M3C) submodule., as well as the kinetic energy and spare power in the wind turbine., to design the M3C virtual inertia control strategy., the doubly-fed wind turbine frequency control strategy and the joint frequency control strategy. The corresponding simulation model is established in the PSCAD/EMTDC. And the simulation results show that the proposed control strategy can improve the nadir frequency (NF) of once-drop., slows down the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF)., and effectively enhances the stability of the industrial frequency (IF) system.

Author Keywords: Modular Multilevel Matrix Converter (M3C);Doubly-Fed Induction Generator (DFIG)

articleTitle: An Adaptive Modulation Technique for Power Quality Improvement in Standalone Single-Phase Current Source Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The presence of low-frequency power oscillations on the DC link and overlap-time both degrade the output power quality of single-phase current source inverters. This paper proposes a novel modulation technique that simultaneously mitigates the effects of both low-frequency power oscillations and overlap-time. By simultaneously addressing these issues, the proposed adaptive modulation technique improves the output power quality of stand-alone single-phase current source inverters and enables a reduction in the size of the DC link inductor. The mathematical analysis and simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed modulation technique.

articleTitle: Sliding-Mode Speed Control based on Active-Disturbance-Rejection for Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the tracking performance of speed control system of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) for new energy vehicles, a novel sliding-mode speed control based on active disturbance rejection (ADR-SMSC) scheme for PMSM is proposed in this article. First, this paper investigates the super-twisting sliding modes to control the speed of PMSM and optimizes the super-twisting algorithm to further reduce chattering problem. Then, to improve the tracking performance and reduce disturbances, an extended state observer (ESO) is designed to estimate the disturbance in real time without the need for an accurate mathematical model of the PMSM. The resulting ADR-SMSC has improved stead-state and transient speed tracking performance and enhanced robustness to disturbance. It also achieved smoother acceleration and deceleration. The simulation results show that the ADR-SMSC improves the response speed and anti-disturbance ability.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of Surface Charge Between Epoxy Impregnated Paper and Epoxy Resin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy impregnated paper composite material is the main insulating material of ultra-high voltage wall bushing capacitor core. Its surface charge accumulation causes electric field distortion, which has an important influence on the safety and stability of bushing operation. The effect of epoxy impregnated paper composite insulation material and epoxy resin on surface charge accumulation under different polarization time, different voltage levels and different voltage polarity was studied in this paper. It is found that the volume conductivity of epoxy impregnated paper composite insulation material is much higher than that of epoxy resin, which makes the surface charge accumulation of epoxy impregnated paper easier, the maximum surface charge density of epoxy impregnated paper is significantly higher than epoxy resin during the polarization process. Under DC voltage, the surface charge increases with the increase of voltage level and the extension of polarization time, and tends to be stable at 90min, without obvious polarity effect.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Remote Control UAV in Transmission Line Inspection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article aims to study the application of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) based on remote control technology in rapid inspection of power transmission lines, and to verify its feasibility and practicality through experiments. First, the background and purpose of remote control technology for UAVs are introduced, and then the technical principles, experimental design and implementation, verification conditions, and promotion plan are elaborated. Through field verification, the experimental results show that the rapid inspection of UAVs based on remote control technology has good reliability and stability, which can improve inspection efficiency and response time. Finally, the research results are summarized, and future research directions are proposed.

articleTitle: Load Restoration Strategy for Bulk Power Systems Considering Worst Contingencies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The load restoration scheme of bulk power systems suffering outages faces significant challenges due to the aftermath of natural disasters. The probability of transmission lines tripping again in the load restoration process after disasters is notably higher than that under normal operating conditions. This aspect, however, has not been thoroughly explored in existing research. This paper proposes a load restoration strategy for bulk power systems considering worst-case contingencies. The proposed strategy comprises a master problem and a bi-level based subproblem. In the master problem, a load restoration model is introduced to minimize outage losses based on the worst contingencies identified by the subproblem. The subproblem is modeled as a bi-level second-order cone programming (SOCP) model and its objective is to minimize load shedding costs to identify the worst contingency. By using duality theory, we reformulate the bi-level model into a single-level one, rendering the subproblem solvable. The IEEE 30-bus system is employed to verify the effectiveness of the developed models and strategy.

articleTitle: The Impact of the Length Ratio of Long and Short Sides of Metal Mesh on the Damage Area
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The technological components of lightning protection for wind turbines are the first topic covered in this essay. It talks about the issues that lightning strikes can pose, particularly for wind turbine blades. The efficient use of metal nets for lightning protection is examined by constructing intricate simulation models. The study's main goal is to investigate how the metal nets' design, size, and composition affect their capacity to block lightning. In particular, the importance of square mesh holes in improving the efficacy of lightning protection is emphasized, along with the size of the mesh holes. The article also talks about how to optimize this process by changing the mesh sizes so that lightning does not damage the wind turbine blades as much. There is value in this research for practical applications.

articleTitle: Influence of Slot Flux Leakage on the Current Distribution in Axial Flux Machine Windings
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The uneven distribution of current will increase the equivalent resistance, which will lead to the increase of copper loss. Therefore, the influence of different flux leakage components on the current distribution of axial-flux motor is studied in this paper. The finite element software is used to separate the permanent flux leakage and armature flux leakage by freezing the permeability, analyze their distribution patterns, and further explain how the axial and tangential components of flux leakage affect the current distribution. Finally, two effective methods to reduce AC copper loss are proposed, and the two methods are compared.

articleTitle: Torque Enhancement for a Novel Dual Flux Modulation Machine with Non-Uniformly Distributed Stator PM and Trapezoidal Rotor PM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper has proposed a novel dual flux modulation machine(DFMM) with non-uniformly distributed stator PM and trapezoidal consequent-pole(TCP) rotor. The DFMM is a typical topology of multiple-working-magnetomotive-force(MMF) flux modulation machines(MWM-FMMs), working on the dual field modulation effect. The air-gap field harmonics are further enriched by non-uniformly distributed stator PM. Meanwhile, the fundamental working-MMF is increased by TCP rotor design, all facilitating to higher output torque. The topology and operating principle are introduced from the perspective of MMF-permeance model. Then, the field harmonics excited by stator/rotor sided PM are investigated respectively. The critical parameters including shifting ratio <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{k}$</tex> and tilt angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}$</tex> are optimized to obtain the best torque quality at lower volume of magnets. Finite element analysis demonstrates that with same overall size, materials and copper loss, the proposed machine can offer 10% higher torque capability and 7.62% smaller PM usage than regular consequent-pole DFMM counterpart.

articleTitle: Analysis of High-Resistance Connection Fault of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-resistance connection fault (HRC) is a common and typical electrical fault of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). At present, there are few analyses of high-resistance connection fault. Therefore, this article is based on ANSYS simulation software and analyzes different levels of high-resistance connection faults of permanent magnet synchronous motors in terms of current, magnetic field, electromagnetic force, vibration and temperature field. And this article provides sufficient theoretical basis for the diagnosis of high-resistance connection faults of permanent magnet synchronous motors.

articleTitle: Virtual Oscillator Grid-Forming Inverter Stability Analysis Based on Impedance Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Grid-forming (GFM) inverters are DC-AC converters that regulate their AC terminal frequency and voltage in response to real-time measurements. Virtual oscillator control (VOC) is an emerging strategy of grid-forming controllers. Unlike conventional phasor-based control methods such as droop control and virtual synchronous machine control, VOC is a time-domain controller that global convergence can be almost guaranteed by adding a nonlinear element. In this article, the state space model of a VOC-based inverter system connected to an infinite bus is established to access the steady-state values. In order to study the effect of nonlinear terms on the system stability, a detailed impedance model of the VOC controller is proposed. Numerical simulations validate the impedance model. Through the impedance-based method, how the nonlinear term can influence system stability is analyzed.

articleTitle: Portfolio Strategy for Electricity Purchasing Agent Service Considering Medium- and Long-Term Coupling with Spot Markets
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the market-oriented reform of electric power developing in depth, China promotes the participation of all industrial and commercial users in the power market, and power grid enterprises have become the core subject of the transactions involving users who have not entered the power market for the time being. rid enterprise agent purchasing power bear the multiple responsibilities of ensuring supply, stabilizing cost and promoting consumption, rational allocation of the proportion of purchasing power in multi-time scale, multi-market type of transaction, and effectively reduce the comprehensive cost of purchasing power is the core strategy to improve its marketing service ability. However, at this stage, most of the domestic provinces' electricity spot market has not yet operated practically, and the combination of medium- and long-term and spot market power purchase technology is still immature and lacks a reasonable volume and price declaration strategy. Accordingly, this paper firstly designs the coupling mechanism between medium- and long-term transactions with curves and spot transactions. Secondly, portfolio strategy for electricity purchasing agent service that minimizes the market-based power purchase cost is proposed by taking into account the target value of volume and price, deviation value and other factors. Finally, the analysis of the examples shows that the proposed portfolio strategy for electricity purchasing agent service can significantly reduce the comprehensive power purchase cost of the system.

articleTitle: Blind Phase Current Reconstruction Strategy of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on SVPWM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The development of motor control application technology to today mainly focuses on two points of continuous improvement, one is to improve efficiency, and the other is to reduce system costs. These are also the two main factors driving the improvement of existing motor control technology. In this paper, the three-phase current of PMSM is reconstructed based on the space vector pulse width modulation technology and the current information on the DC bus, aiming at the error and high cost caused by the multi-current sensor during phase current sampling. At the same time, in order to solve the problem of blind area, pulse shift method is used to reconstruct the current in the blind area (sector switching area and low modulation area) under the linear modulation area. In the overmodulation region, because the pulse shift method is no longer applicable, the reconstruction method is improved, and the current sampling method of the lower bridge arm is adopted. The proposed method is simulated in the simulation software, and the reliability and effectiveness of the proposed current sampling technique are verified by comparing the simulation results.

articleTitle: Hybird Integral Sliding Mode Tracking Control of Cable-Driven Parallel Robots
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a hybird integral sliding mode control scheme for cable-driven parallel robots, to improve the tracking accuracy and reduce the chattering problem. Firstly, an equivalent control law for suppressing chattering phenomenon is proposed, based on the hybird integral sliding surface, which consists of the integral sliding mode and tracking error. Secondly, to accelerate the convergence of the system, a quasi-terminal-sliding-mode switching control law is introduced, combining with equivalent control law to form the hybird integral sliding mode control scheme. Moreover, the asymptotic convergence of tracking error is ensured by the proposed hybird integral sliding mode controller, as proved by using the Lyapunov theory. Finally, The experimental results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed hybird integral sliding mode controller, indicating the higher accuracy and smaller chattering in a reference trajectory compared with traditional controllers.

articleTitle: An Improved Rotor Position Estimation Method in PMSM Drives with Low-Resolution Hall Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a rotor position estimation method based on low-resolution Hall sensors for permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) drives. In this paper, existing Taylor series expansion estimation are analyzed exhaustively firstly. Then targeting the existing problems, the proposed method compensates the Lagrange remainder of the first-order Taylor series expansion and provides a better dynamic performance, which takes previous methods a step further. Finally, The method is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of Hybrid Wireless Power Transfer with Enhanced and Constant Output Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a compact hybrid coupler for hybrid wireless power transfer (HWPT) system, and this system can achieve a constant and enhanced voltage output with zero phase angle (ZPA). In the HWPT system, an additional inductive coupled channel is formed by the compensation inductors of the CPT system, thus both the capacitive and inductive channels are used to transfer power leading to a constant and enhanced power transmission. In the hybrid coupler, the inductive coupler is placed between the vertical capacitive coupler, where coils are solenoid to avoid coupling loss and eddy-current loss. Compared with other hybrid coupler, this structure is more compact and does not reduce transmission distance. Simulation results show that the hybrid coupler can designed more compact, and that the HWPT system can achieve a constant and double-times output voltage.

articleTitle: Study on magnetic field characteristics of typical wireless power transfer systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: At present, wireless power transfer systems based on magnetic resonance, parity-time symmetry, and fractional order have received more and more attention, especially in wireless charging applications of mobile phones, electric vehicles, and other products. However, the consequent electromagnetic radiation safety issues are becoming increasingly prominent. Therefore, this paper compares and studies the magnetic field distribution of magnetic resonance, parity-time symmetric and fractional-order wireless power transfer systems, and uses ANSYS simulation software to simulate and comparative analyze. The simulation results show that under the condition of equal output power, the magnetic field distribution of the parity-time symmetric wireless power transfer system is more concentrated when the coupling coefficient is small, while the magnetic field distribution of the magnetic resonance wireless power transfer system is more concentrated when the coupling coefficient is large, but it is significantly smaller than that of the fractional-order wireless power transfer system. In addition, the safety range of the parity-time symmetric wireless power transfer system is significantly larger than that of the magnetic resonance and the fractional-order wireless power transfer system at different output power. Remarkably, the magnetic field distribution of fractional-order wireless power transfer system will also change with different order, which implies that the safety range of the fractional-order wireless power transfer system can be designed according to the requirements to achieve the ideal safety range.

articleTitle: Study on Electromagnetic Safety Performance of Vehicle Discharging System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The electric vehicle (EV) is equipped with a large-capacity electric energy storage device. When the EV has discharging function, the vehicle can be regarded as a mobile energy storage power source. Vehicles with external discharging function, which can provide electrical energy for home or emergency rescue loads, which can be divided as V2L (Vehicle to load), V2V(vehicle to vehicle), V2G(vehicle to grid)namely V2L. At present, the relevant standards for the discharging interface safety requirements are stipulated, but there is no electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) or electromagnetic field (EMF) requirements. This paper focuses on these two aspects” by analyzing the radiation frequency (RF) conduction emission (CE) and EMF performance of the vehicle to study the electromagnetic safety of vehicle discharging conditions. The results show that the RF CE test results of the vehicle obviously exceed the limit requirements of the charging condition, and the EMC radiation value in the working band is higher.

articleTitle: A Concise Controller Design of Three-Phase Voltage Source Inverter with High Bandwidth and Zero Overshoot Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The voltage control plays a critical role in the hierarchical control structure of grid-forming inverters. In this paper, a concise controller design is studied for the three-phase voltage-controlled inverter equipped with an LC filter in the continuous-time domain. A compact control structure is designed to include the inner loop state feedback and the outer loop proportional-integral (PI) control. Thanks to the designed control structure, the dynamic and steady-state performance are both guaranteed. The transfer function of the closed-loop system is built and the objective closed-loop transfer function with desired performance is designed. The control parameters are calculated by comparing the two transfer functions in an easy way. The simulation results show that high bandwidth and zero overshoot performance are achieved during reference step. Moreover, certain robustness to parameter variation is also achieved.

articleTitle: The Impact of Grid Harmonics on Commutation Failure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Commutation failure is a common fault in Line Commutated Converter High Voltage Direct Current (LCC-HVDC) systems. LCC-HVDC relies on the AC power grid to provide reverse voltage to naturally turn off thyristors. Faults in the AC system on the inverter side can lead to commutation failures. In practical engineering applications, AC network harmonics also affect the commutation of thyristors. This paper further elucidates the impact of AC network harmonics on commutation failure and validates the effect of non-characteristic harmonics of different orders on LCC-HVDC commutation failure using the PSCAD/EMTDC simulation platform.

articleTitle: Simulation and Calculation of Three-Phase Common Mode Inductance Considering Biased Magnetic Effects
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the magnetic density distribution of three-phase common-mode inductors under different magnetic bias is obtained by finite element simulation of electromagnetic field, and the segmental reluctance model of the vertical core is established. The dynamic permeability distribution of three-phase common-mode choke is obtained by combining the characteristic curve of the material, so as to calculate the dynamic inductance under different magnetic bias. The establishment of the model provides design guidance for the optimization design of the common mode choke, reducing the volume and improving the noise suppression ability. The simulation results agree well with the experimental results, which shows that the proposed calculation method for the dynamic inductance of the common mode choke is effective.

articleTitle: Particle-in-Cell Simulation of Nanosecond Pulsed Breakdown Process of Nitrogen Spark Switch at Atmospheric Pressure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To study the nitrogen particle breakdown process of nanosecond pulses at atmospheric pressure, the discharge process in the gap is simulated using the particle-in-cell method and the photos of transient streamer propagation are obtained. The results are as follows. Firstly, the breakdown process of nanosecond pulses includes the formation stage and fast propagation stage of the streamer. Secondly, runaway electrons may generate in the head of the streamer and the branches of streamer channel form for the photoionization during the fast propagation stage. Finally, the average propagation velocity of the streamer channel during the streamer fast propagation stage is larger than that during the streamer formation stage.

articleTitle: Surface Distributions of ROS on Model Tissue Treated by a He+Ar+O2 Plasma Jet
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Mixing helium and argon as the working gas of cold plasma jet is expected to combine the advantages of helium plasma jet and argon plasma jet. Surface distributions of ROS on model tissue treated by a He+Ar+O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> plasma jet were investigated in this study. The results show that the effective treatment area of He+Ar+O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> plasma jet on model tissue increases with the argon volume fraction in the working gas. When the argon volume fraction was 60%, the effective treatment area of the He+Ar+O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> plasma jet is 9 times greater than that of the He+O2 plasma jet, and the surface distribution uniformity of ROS on model tissue is even greater than that of Ar+O2 plasma jet. Furthermore, mixing helium and argon as the working gas of the plasma jet diminishes the effect caused by variations in the treatment angle of the plasma jet, maintaining the effective treatment area of the plasma jet directly below the jet nozzle. These results suggest that He+Ar+O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> plasma jet is advantageous for precisely controlling the dosage of ROS in clinical applications.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Synergistic Planning of Multiple New Energy Capacities Considering Flexibility and Complementarity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Rational planning of new energy power plant capacity is an important part of ensuring the stable operation of a new energy power system. However, the current capacity planning method lacks the synergistic advantage of source network, load, and storage. Therefore, this paper analyzes the capacity planning optimization process of flexible and complementary multiple new energy sources. On this basis, it proposes a flexible and complementary wide-area capacity planning model for multiple new energy sources based on time-series production simulation. Finally, empirical analyses are carried out with the data from the new energy base in Qinghai. The research in this paper fully exploits the synergistic advantages of flexible and complementary multiple new energy sources and provides a new optimization method for capacity synergistic planning of multiple new energy sources.

articleTitle: A Frequency-Based Inductor Current Optimization Control for Four-Switch Buck-Boost Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The four-switch buck-boost (FSBB) converter with the four-segment inductor current waveform achieves zero-voltage-switching (ZVS) over a wide input and output voltage and full load range, making it an ideal choice for high-efficiency step-up/step-down DC-DC applications. In conventional control schemes, the four control time intervals are optimally selected to minimize the root mean square (rms) inductor current. However, the switching frequency is not considered, resulting in relatively low efficiency when the input and output voltages differ significantly. In this paper, a pseudo-boundary conduction mode (PBCM) control strategy is proposed to further reduce the rms inductor current by optimizing the frequency. This allows the converter efficiency to be increased over a wide range of input and output voltages. A 300 W FSBB prototype with input and output voltage ranges of 20–40 V is built to verify the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: Induced Voltage and Current in Overhead Ground Wire Considering Arc Sag and Study of Ground Wire Electricity Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Carbon emissions from the power industry account for a large proportion of carbon emissions from the energy industry. The line loss rate of overhead ground wire is low, but the absolute amount should not be ignored, and it is necessary to further reduce the loss of ground wire. The analysis of induced voltage, current, and loss under the conditions of complex overhead wires is the basis of the research on loss reduction of ground wire. However, the existing studies are mostly focused on the simulation level, with less research on the calculation method, and there are often problems such as ignoring the arc sag and the spatial structure of the wire. The main contributions of this paper are: 1) it proposes the calculation method of electromagnetically induced voltage and current of ground wire considering the arc sag; 2) A method for calculating the current along the ground wire and loss of ground wire considering the distribution parameters and spatial structure of the wires is proposed by combining the operations of indefinite conductance matrix blocking and parallel termination. It can be verified that the accuracy of the induced voltage and current calculation is not less than 95.26%; the accuracy of the calculation of the current along the ground wire is not less than 92.31%; the accuracy of ground wire loss calculation is not less than 92.30%. The proposed method provides a useful reference for the analysis of key influencing factors of ground wire loss and the research of ground wire loss reduction strategy.

articleTitle: Thermal Field Simulation of High Voltage Shunt Capacitor Based on Electrothermal Coupling in Harmonic Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high voltage shunt capacitor is rated to work at power frequency voltage and current. Due to the existence of harmonic current in power system, the temperature rise of the high voltage shunt capacitor is different from the power frequency condition during stable operation. In order to study the heating characteristics of high voltage shunt capacitors under harmonic conditions, this paper constructs a series equivalent model of high voltage shunt capacitors considering the influence of frequency, and proposes the construction method of solving the electric and thermal field models of capacitors under harmonic conditions. According to the series model, the internal heat source distribution of capacitors is refined, and a full equivalent simulation model of the capacitor thermal field based on electrothermal coupling is built. The simulation model can calculate the capacitor temperature distribution under various current excitation conditions. The heating characteristics of capacitor under power frequency current, single harmonic current and power frequency superimposed single harmonic excitation are simulated and analyzed, and the influence of harmonic on the heating characteristics of capacitor is summarized.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of a Novel Self-Excitation and Discharge Separated Type Air-Core Pulsed Alternator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to advance the further improvement of the air-core pulsed alternator's performance and accelerate the process of its practical application in the field of electromagnetic launching, this paper proposes a novel self-excitation and discharge separated type air-core pulsed alternator and designs a typical scheme, establishes a co-simulation model for pulsed alternator and control circuit, researches around the working principles and parameter selection principles of the three working stages of self-excitation, discharge and energy reclaim, and focuses on the influence of the eddy current phenomenon of armature winding and field winding on the pulsed alternator's working performance.

articleTitle: Review on the Thermal Parameters Applications in the Reliability of Power Semiconductor Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The power semiconductor device plays a key role in the energy conversion and management, and the failure of device usually makes great economic losses. To improve the reliability of device, many methods have been proposed, including the condition monitoring, junction temperature estimation, lifetime prediction and thermal control. All above techniques are closely related to the thermal parameters of device. Therefore, this paper reviews these studies and analyzes their relationships from the aspect of thermal parameters. Different kinds of thermal network models are also presented. In addition, the limitations and potential of existing reliability improvement methods based on the thermal parameters are discussed and summarized.

articleTitle: Assessment and Management of Metal Path Stray Current Intrusion in Urban Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The dynamic stray current of the subway invades the urban power grid, resulting in the DC bias hazard of the transformer. In order to explore the distribution law and influencing factors of metro leakage current metal path intrusion into urban power grid, a DC bias analysis calculation model considering the direct coupling relationship of the field and road is established, the distribution characteristics of stray current in the urban power grid are solved, and a method is proposed to determine the bias risk of track stray current by using the shunt coefficient of the neutral point loop of the main transformer. In this paper, the simulation of DC current and low-frequency measured stray current is used to verify that the method has reliable practical value. On this basis, the simulation analysis of the influence law and characteristics of the main variable shunt coefficient by different system parameters shows that the DC bias calculation model proposed in this paper can effectively warn the risk of stray current bias. When the stray current of the subway propagates in the urban power grid, the smaller the grounding resistance of the substation, the larger the shunt coefficient of the neutral point loop of the main transformer, and the larger the shunt coefficient of the neutral point loop of the main transformer when the resistance of the grounding transformer and the transmission line is small (such as the number of returns of the transmission line is less or the line is shorter).

articleTitle: Study on Optimized Operation and Configuration of Energy Storage Promoting the Consumption of Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The global energy transition has witnessed a significant shift towards renewable energy sources like solar and wind. However, the intermittent and volatile nature of renewable energy poses challenges to the stability of power systems. Energy storage technology has emerged as a key solution, considering the growing demand for new energy consumption., proposing an optimal configuration model for energy storage capacity. The objective is to minimize the system's operating cost., including thermal power generation fuel cost and penalties for renewable energy abandonment. The unit commitment model incorporates economic and environmental considerations., with thermal power unit and renewable energy planned power as decision variables. The model addresses constraints related to power balance., thermal power generation output., renewable energy planning., and energy storage. Case analysis using a modified IEEE 30-node system demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed model. Three scenarios with different energy storage capacities were studied., revealing that optimal storage allocation significantly influences system operation and new energy consumption.

articleTitle: A Novel Mesh-Based Reluctance Network Model of Hybrid Excitation Magnetic Lead Screw for Wave Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Magnetic lead screw (MLS)., as a magnetic coupling and non-contact device, can convert low-speed linear motion into high-speed rotating motion, with high energy conversion efficiency, low friction, high operational reliability and low maintenance costs, and is suitable for wave energy converters (WEC). In this paper, a mesh-based reluctance network (MBRN) model is proposed to analyze the performance of a novel proposed hybrid excitation magnetic lead screw (HEMLS) for the WEC system. The proposed HEMLS not only can have enough maximum thrust through the PM is arranged on both sides of the rotor and mover, but also can be controllable through two-phase windings that carry opposite DC and placed in slots on the mover. The MBRN model divides the internal magnetic field of the MLS into several uniform mesh elements. The proposed model can be used to predict the performance of the HEMLS, including the air-gap flux density and thrust force. The proposed MBRN model is verified by finite element analysis (FEA) under both load and no-load conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Underwater Nanosecond Surface Discharge Driven by Magnetic-switch-based Repetitive Pulsed Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, compact and small-scale pulsed power driving sources have been increasingly developed, providing more flexible and controllable physical effects such as acoustic and electromagnetic waves generated by underwater pulsed discharge. This paper presents a platform for achieving underwater low-energy, high-repetition-rate discharges. It utilizes a magnetic-switch-based circuit and a multi-stage charging adjustable pulsed power source to drive nanosecond discharges in water. A surface discharge load employs thin copper sheets as electrodes, with discharge materials sprayed or adhered to the substrate. The surface discharge characteristics of the load under this power source are analyzed through a combination of electrical and high-speed shadowgraph images diagnostics. The results show that the voltage transformation ratio of the power module can reach 1:27. When the load is not discharged, the ratio of the second-stage charging voltage to the first-stage charging voltage can reach 6:5. The rising edges of the load voltage and circuit current within 100 ns, the discharge period is within ~1 us. The circuit current is in 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> A level, with discharge power reaching the 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</sup> W level. Significant bubble effects are observed from the surface discharge, and the discharge exhibits good repeatability. These results lay the groundwork for further generating underwater low-energy multi-physical field sources and provide insights into exploring high-repetition-rate discharge loads in water.

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Inference Taguchi Method for Multiobjective Design Optimization of Wide Speed Range High Power Density Axial Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The Taguchi method is an efficient method for motor design optimization. Unfortunately, the conventional Taguchi optimization is hard to obtain a complete set of nondominated solutions due to the restriction of the number of objectives. To alleviate the problem, this paper describes a fuzzy inference Taguchi method, which introduces the fuzzy inference system to translate the multiple optimization target to a single target on the basis of orthogonal design of experiments established by the Taguchi method for obtaining the complete set of nondominated solutions. The proposed approach is applied to the design optimization of the wide speed range high power density axial motor. After the optimal selection analysis, the best combination of the motor structure parameters is obtained. By comparing the optimization result of the proposed method with that of the conventional Taguchi method, the superiority and validity of the proposed method are certified.

articleTitle: Current Measurement Error Compensation Method for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Drive System Based on Current Ripple Information Extraction
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The accurate measurement of current feedback is a key factor for the optimal operation of permanent magnet synchronous motor ( PMSM ) drive system. In the actual control system. The temperature drift, aging, nonlinearity and other factors of the sensor and the related regulating circuit will produce errors in the current measurement. When the current frequency is equal to the power frequency, the current measurement deviation will lead to torque and speed ripple, which will affect the control performance of the permanent magnet synchronous motor. In this paper, the influence of current measurement offset error is analyzed, and the influence of closed-loop control on current ripple amplitude is further studied. It should be emphasized that the traditional derivation may not be valid when considering the influence of closed-loop control. Aiming at this problem, a current measurement error compensation method for permanent magnet synchronous motor drive system based on current pulsation information extraction is proposed. This method can actively identify and compensate the current ripple generated during the operation of the motor, and use the closed-loop control strategy to reduce the torque and speed ripple caused by the current measurement error. It is worth noting that, unlike the traditional method, the scheme proposed in this paper eliminates the requirements for motor shaft inertia or stator resistance parameters. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is finally verified by experiments on permanent magnet synchronous motors in CNC machine tools.

articleTitle: Numerical Study on the Performance of Fuel Cell with a Radial Serpentine Flow Field
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The flow field structure of bipolar plates has an important impact on the performance of proton exchange membrane fuel cells (PEMFCs). Ideal flow field design improves water management capabilities and mass and heat transfer, thereby enhancing the overall performance of the fuel cell. This article combines the traditional serpentine flow channel (TSFF) and the radial flow channel to design the radial serpentine flow field (RSFF). CFD simulation shows that the current density of RSFF is increased by a maximum of 31.2% and the power density is increased by a maximum of 21.5% compared with TSFF. Moreover, due to the higher pressure drop, the water management capability of the flow field is improved.

articleTitle: Simulation and Rapid Performance Evaluation of Temperature Rise Distribution in High-Voltage Switchgear
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage switchgear is widely used in power transmission and distribution networks, and its temperature rise performance under long-term electrification is directly related to the safety and reliability of power supply. The finite element model for high-voltage switchgear is established to simulate and analyze its temperature rise distribution and voltage distribution, as well as the change law of temperature rise with structural material parameters and environmental parameters in the paper. The weak points of excessive temperature rise in switchgear and critical temperature rise parameters are analyzed. A rapid evaluation method for temperature rise performance is proposed based on the simulation results of temperature rise and the change law of temperature rise time. The evaluation effect of contact temperature rise under different measured times is compared, and the influence of environmental parameters on the temperature rise of switchgear is verified by experimenting.

articleTitle: Enhancement of Charge Dissipation Capacity on the Surface of Insulators Induced by the SiC/Epoxy Composite Coating with Alignment Additives
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Coating the insulator surface in DC insulation equipment with SiC/Epoxy composite is an effective method to suppress the accumulation of gas-solid interface charges and promote charge dissipation. However, with the development of the power grid, the conventional composite coating's ability to regulate charges will no longer be able to meet the increasing demand for equipment voltage levels. Therefore, in this paper, the dielectrophoresis deposition technique was employed to apply a uniform AC electric field during the curing process of the composite coating, aiming to enhance its charge dissipation capability. Firstly, the chain formation dynamics of additives in SiC/Epoxy suspension during curing process under AC electric field were observed. Subsequently, two different types of coatings were prepared: one with aligned additives (A-Sample), and the other with randomly distributed additives (R-Sample). Surface charge dissipation experiments were then conducted, and the corresponding DC conductivity characteristics were measured for both types of samples. The experiments showed that aligned SiC particles contribute to the formation of conductive pathways, thereby increasing the conductivity along the chain direction and promoting rapid charge dissipation. Compared to the R-Sample, the A-Sample exhibited a 79.68% reduction in the rate of surface residual charge after 60 minutes of charge dissipation. The proposed coating preparation method in this paper hopes to provide a new perspective for the fabrication of insulation coatings.

articleTitle: Real-Time Energy Balance Control for DC Microgrids with Multi Sources and Multi Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In a microgrid architecture with a common DC bus, output fluctuations of generating units and sudden load changes lead to transient power imbalances in the system, resulting in fluctuations in the DC bus voltage and causing over-voltage or under-voltage protection of individual power converters.
