However, existing schemes are limited by how to capture the transient power deficit across multiple generating units and loads as well as the limited current control bandwidth. This paper first analyses the existing microgrid architectures with common DC bus and establishes a simplified microgrid model. Further, this paper proposes a new real-time energy balance control strategy for microgrids with multiple source load nodes under common DC bus. Firstly, the DC bus voltage is sampled and taken as raw data to predict the voltage variation in the next control cycle. Then, the predicted voltage fluctuation value serves as a power compensation feed-forward command. Finally, the compensation takes place using a deadbeat current predictive algorithm. This scheme enables the overall feed-forward of power deficit among multiple source loads, and effectively solves the problem of transient power imbalance. The effectiveness of the proposed scheme is finally verified by simulation in this paper.

articleTitle: Experimental Study on Partial Discharge Radiation Characteristics of Conductors at the Head of Electric Poles of Insulated Distribution Overhead Lines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Non-contact partial discharge (PD) detection is an effective supplement to equipment condition assessment, which can provide more accurate positioning information and more discharge data. In view of the influence factors such as different forms of wire insulation layer, porcelain insulator and wire surface pollution, this paper carried out experiments on the spatial radiation characteristics of electromagnetic wave generated by partial discharge, measured the radiation electromagnetic wave signal at multiple points, analyzed the influence of different factors on electromagnetic wave signal in time domain and frequency domain, and extracted electromagnetic wave characteristics and propagation rules. The characteristics of partial discharge radiation at the pole head of overhead insulated line are systematically studied.

articleTitle: Analytical Modeling of Forced-Air Cooling Heatsink by Considering Air Temperature Rise in Channel and Coupling of Multiple Heat Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of renewable energy, data center, new energy vehicle and so on, the power density of power electronics converters is continuously increasing. Higher power density means higher requirements for thermal dissipation system design. Thus, the design of cooling system is the key step to improve the power density of the power converters. Because of its simplicity and efficiency, the rectangular extruded-fin air cooling heat sink is the most common cooling system design in converters. This paper proposed an analytical model for air cooling heat sink which can help to better estimate chip temperature and design cooling system in an efficient way. Based on computational fluid dynamics (CFD)-based simulation, the thermal resistance network accuracy is verified.

articleTitle: Energy Management and Control Strategy for Aircraft Power Supply System with Pulse Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aircraft power supply is an independent power supply system with low immunity. When the high power pulse load is working, the instantaneous power demand easily cause the fluctuation of the bus voltage, which will affect the stability of the system. In order to improve the stability of the system, an energy management and control strategy is proposed. Considering the state of charge (SOC) of energy storage unites, a fuzzy control strategy based adaptive low-pass filtering is used for energy management system (EMS). For the controller, accurate direct power control (ADPC) method and model predictive control (MPC) method are respectively used for the battery (BA) and supercapacitor (SC) to achieve fast pulse power control. Simulation results verify the good dynamic performance of the proposed the energy management and control strategy.

articleTitle: An Improved Finite Control Set Model Predictive Control with Complete Control of Flying-Capacitor Voltages for Four-Level Nested Neutral-Point Clamped Inverters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article introduces an enhanced FCS-MPC technique that allows for full control of flying capacitor (FC) voltages in a four-level inverter. This method reduces the computational burden, decreases harmonic currents, and ensures balanced FC voltage levels. Firstly, the vector in the a-b-c coordinate system is converted to the g-h coordinate system. Then determine the region where the reference voltage vector is located, and the four-level vectors are converted into a two-level sector for calculation. Next, the influence of the switching state corresponding to the redundancy vector on the FC is analyzed, and the switching states which makes the FC voltage balance are selected. Finally, the duty cycle of the three basic voltage vectors is computed by the distance between the reference vector and the fixed vectors in the space vector diagram. The steady-state and the dynamic simulations are conducted to verify the effectiveness of the proposed FCS-MPC method.

Author Keywords: finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC)

articleTitle: Comparison of Dead-Time Compensation Based on Model Predictive Current Control Schemes for Nine-Phase Open-End Winding Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To suppress the dead-time effect of multiphase open-end winding (OW) motor drive systems, two compensation strategies based on model predictive control are applied and compared in this paper. Firstly, the multi harmonic space of the multiphase OW drive system is analyzed. Taking a nine-phase OW motor as an example, the dead-time results in significant third harmonic currents. Secondly, based on conventional model predictive current control (MPCC), two dead-time compensation methods have been proposed, namely additional vector method and harmonic space closed-loop control method. Finally, the experimental results prove that harmonic space closed-loop control by three harmonic virtual voltage vectors presented better compensation performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Anti-Radiation Performance for a Domestic Satellite Borne Power Device
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The research object of this paper is a high-power thick-film anti-radiation DC/DC power module, which can convert 70V~120V input voltage into 5V/120W rated output in a small size. On this basis, the module electrical performance parameters are tested and verified, and the total dose radiation testing of low dose rate and single-event radiation testing are carried out. Results show that the tested device main parameters are good and different numbered circuits datas highly coincidental, its anti-total dose radiation reaches 100krad(Si), single-event functional failure threshold LET value greater than or equal to <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{75}\mathbf{MeV}\cdot \mathbf{cm}^{\mathbf{2}}/\mathbf{mg}$</tex>, and it has good anti-single-event transient ability, which can work stably and efficiently in satellite borne environment.

articleTitle: Improved Torque Performance of SynRM Based on Multiple Resonat and Cascade Extended State Observer Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The control performance of synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM) deteriorates because of the non-uniform reluctance of motor, magnetic saturation and cross-coupling effect, leading to torque ripple. To improve the torque performance, a composite control method based on multi-resonant speed control and the ultra-local model-based deadbeat predictive current (ULM-DPCC) control is proposed. First, multi-resonant controller (MRC) is proposed to suppress torque harmonics. Second, the cascade extended state observer (CESO) is proposed to predict the currents and estimate the disturbances when inductance mismatch occurs. Then ULM-DPCC is used to improve the performance of conventional DPCC. On the whole, torque harmonics are significantly decreased while the anti-interference performance of the current loop is improved. Finally, torque performance is improved based on multiple resonat and cascade extended state observer control by the simulation.

articleTitle: Torque Performance Improvement of a Permanent Magnet In-Wheel Motor from Perspective of Field Modulation Permeance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces the incorporation of flux modulation in the design of an in-wheel motor, proposing a permanent magnet in-wheel motor. The primary focus lies in the analysis of permeance modulation harmonics through the application of flux modulation. Based on this, the waveform of the permanent magnet magnetomotive force (PM-MMF) is examined after modulation, followed by a thorough investigation of the associated harmonics. The objective is to discern the impact on each harmonic on the performance of the motor. The effective improvement of the output torque of a PM-IW motor is achieved through the enhancement of positive harmonics and the suppression of negative harmonics. Additionally, this study investigates the impact of design parameters associated with the stator and rotor slot on the harmonic characteristics. Finally, the performance of motors with and without a rotor-shaped design is analyzed and compared. The results provide verification of the effectiveness of the rotor-shaped design, which takes into consideration the harmonics of permeance modulation.

articleTitle: The Effect of a High Proportion of Distributed Photovoltaic Access on Distribution Network Voltage Power Flow
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The voltage and current of the distribution network will be impacted to some extent by a large percentage of distributed solar power supply access. It can cause problems such as voltage overruns and current reversals. This research studies the power flow change law of the distribution network after PV access theoretically and through simulation in order to tackle this problem. The impact of PV access on distribution network voltage and network loss under different access locations, capacities, power factors and other parameters is investigated. Furthermore, the effect of distributed PV access on distribution network trend is examined in less than a day, taking into account the PV daily output and load characteristics in the Qinghai region. The findings indicate that the lifting impact on the distribution network's voltage is more pronounced the higher the distributed solar power supply's access capacity and the later the access location. At the same time, PV power access also reduces the line power flow and thus reduces the network loss. When the PV access position is at the end of the line, there is a noticeable decrease in line losses. In addition, the PV output is insufficient when the load peaks during the daytime. This phenomenon causes an increase in network losses and a decrease in voltage. This study can lay the foundation for reasonable access of distributed PV to effectively support line voltage and reduce network losses. The influence of distributed PV access on the distribution network current law is made clear in this paper, which can serve as a theoretical guide for research on distributed PV power access to the grid.

articleTitle: Position Synchronization Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Based on an Improved Cross-Coupling Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper aims to explore the control method and optimization strategy of dual permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) position linkage. The paper first expounds the research background and significance of multi-motor synchronous cooperative work, analyzes the performance characteristics and application advantages of PMSM, and the technical challenges of dual PMSM position linkage. Then, the paper compares the series control and parallel control schemes of multi-axis linkage of PMSM, points out the advantages and difficulties of parallel control, and focuses on the influence mechanism of communication delay on system synchronization performance. Next, the paper integrates the existing control structures of multi-motor synchronous control, and proposes an improved position synchronous control algorithm based on position traditional cross-coupling and torque deviation feedback, which achieves the compensation effect of communication delay from the perspective of torque. Finally, the paper designs the hardware and software of the system, and verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed algorithm through experiments. The results show that compared with the master command position control under the same communication delay condition, the proposed algorithm can improve the system synchronization performance by 20%, and is suitable for high-precision multi-axis synchronous control scenarios such as robots.

articleTitle: Insulation Lifetime Evaluation of Electrical Machines Under Electrical Aging and Thermal Overload Transient
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The insulation system of electrical machines (EMs) might be subject to electrical stress caused by partial discharge due to higher DC bus voltage and fast switching devices. Moreover, EM for some typical aerospace applications (i.e., landing gear actuators) might operate under short thermal overload transient and the insulation system is subjected to severe thermal aging. As a result, an accurate estimation of insulation lifetime under combined thermal and electrical stress is demanded for proper reliability assessment. In this paper, accelerated electrical aging tests under extremely high temperatures are performed to derive the lifetime model and then the insulation endurance under electro-thermal stress could be estimated.

articleTitle: Three-Level Non-Isolated Buck Converter With ZVS and Self-Balance Features Used for Underwater Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The underwater wireless charging system used the Buck converter to increase the control degrees of freedom and achieve voltage matching and the Buck converter is required to has with small size and high efficiency. In this paper, a three-level non-isolated Buck converter (TLNBC) with soft switching and self-balance features is proposed. The main switch of the proposed TLNBC realized zero voltage turned on and the auxiliary switch realized zero current turned on. With the proposed auxiliary circuit, the auxiliary current is built in a very short time this will result in low conduction loss. The auxiliary current will realize the zero-voltage turn on of the main switch and the realize the voltage balance of the input capacitor automatically. The correctness of the proposed TLNBC is verified by experimental results, the prototype converter realizes ZVS and voltage self-balance, and the efficiency of the proposed TLNBC is higher than the hard switching TLNBC. The proposed TLNBC has high efficiency and small size and is suitable for the underwater wireless charging system.

articleTitle: Considering Approaches to Enhancing Power System Flexibility Through Distributed Energy Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In pursuit of the goal of reducing the wastage of renewable energy resources and enhancing the flexibility of the power system, this paper introduces a coordinated optimization scheduling strategy, incorporating distributed energy storage systems as a key component. This strategy comprehensively considers the real-time supply and demand dynamics of the power system, the energy storage status of distributed energy storage stations, and the generation forecasts of renewable energy. Based on these factors, a scheduling model for distributed energy storage systems is constructed. In the proposed scheduling strategy, optimize the allocation of energy resources to meet power demand by utilizing the operational costs of generating units, energy storage station operations, and load as objective functions. The primary aim of the model is to enhance power system flexibility through peak-shifting of renewable energy generation. To validate the effectiveness of the model, utilized MATLAB for its solution and, through practical case studies, verified the model's performance. The case study results demonstrate that the proposed distributed energy storage system strategy effectively reduces wind curtailment rates while simultaneously enhancing the flexibility of power system scheduling.

articleTitle: A Robust Optimization Approach to Enhance Frequency Stability by Renewable Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With increasing penetration of renewable energy sources (RESs) and the consequent displacement of synchronous generators (SGs), the frequency stability of power systems has been challenged since RESs generally do not provide inertial response (IR), primary frequency response (PFR), and are non-dispatch able. This paper focuses on enhancing frequency stability by incorporating RESs into the active power and frequency control framework in AC systems. First, we modify uncertain RES generation into dispatchable and stochastic portions. Second, the constraints corresponding to the required system inertia and droop parameters synthesized by the modified RESs and SGs are derived. Third, a security-constrained economic dispatch model is proposed containing the frequency regulation and reserve provision constraints. The proposed model is tested by the modified 39-bus system. The results show that frequency regulation performance is promoted.

articleTitle: A Two-stage DCX-based High Step-down Converter for Green Hydrogen Production
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the process of green hydrogen production, the PEM electrolyzer plays a crucial role as the key link. The dc/dc converter connects the electrolyzer with the dc bus, directly impacting its performance. High step-down conversion ratio and low current ripple are important considerations in designing power supply for electrolyzers. This paper proposes a two-stage dc/dc converter based on DCX, which offers advantages such as high step-down gain, zero voltage switch, and low switching stress. Moreover, the overall control system is simplified without requiring high-precision sampling or high-speed communication. An optimized interleaved buck converter with improved voltage waveform serves as the output stage to significantly reduce inductor current ripple while minimizing losses. Finally, simulations are conducted to validate the effectiveness of this proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Spoke-Type Permanent Magnet Machine for Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a multi-objective optimization method based on the Kriging model is proposed to improve the torque density and reduce the torque ripple of the spoke-type permanent magnet (STPM) machine. First, the sensitivity analysis of the parameters is conducted to determine the optimization variables. Then, the datasets are obtained by finite element analysis (FEA). In addition, the Kriging model is employed to improve the optimization efficiency, and the response relationship between the variables and the optimization objectives is established. Moreover, the optimal solution sets are obtained based on the non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm-II (NSGA-II). Finally, the electromagnetic performances of the initial and optimal machines are analyzed and compared by FEA, including average torque, torque ripple, no-load air gap flux density, and back electromotive force (back-EMF). The results show that the performance of the optimized machine is improved, confirming the effectiveness of the optimization method.

articleTitle: An Integrated Converter for Rail Vehicles Based on Silicon Carbide
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to realize the miniaturization and weight reduction of the traction drive system of rail vehicles and reduce the motor current distortion caused by the low switching frequency of the traditional converter during high-speed operation of the vehicle, an integrated converter consisting of a power electronic transformer and a sine wave traction inverter based on silicon carbide (SiC) is proposed. The system implementation scheme based on SiC MOSFETs, the design scheme of high-frequency, high-power and high-insulation voltage-resistant magnetic isolation, and the communication design scheme of low-latency system are given, and the input and output characteristics of the system are analyzed by simulation. The results show that the total harmonic distortion rate (THD) of the input current is less than 1 %, the power factor is greater than 0.99, and the output voltage THD is less than 3.50% when the rated power is 3.25 MVA. The system efficiency is greater than 97.5%, which is higher than the efficiency of the traditional traction drive system by 3 % ∼ 5%.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Novel High Power-Density Spoke-Type Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine with Inset Halbach PM Array
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A novel interior permanent magnet Synchronous machine (IPMSM) combining the merits of both Halbach PM array and spoke-type magnet configuration is proposed in this paper. The proposed rotor topology can enhance the power-density and torque-density by implementing parallel magnetic flux path for Halbach magnets and spoke-type magnets and reducing the inner rotor magnetic flux leakage. Moreover, the magnetization direction of the assisted PM array can be optimized to obtain a sinusoidal airgap flux density distribution for further torque ripple reduction of the machine. The dimensional parameters of a 12s/10p fractional slot concentrated winding PMSM with proposed rotor topology are optimized by global optimization. The electromagnetic performances of a conventional spoke-type IPMSM and the proposed machine are compared including airgap flux density distribution, open-circuit phase back-EMFs, torque characteristics as well as inductance characteristics using finite element analysis.

articleTitle: A Switched Capacitor Based Single-Switch Ultrahigh Step-Up DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a switched capacitor based step-up DC-DC converter with the advantages of single-switch, continuously adjustable ultrahigh voltage gain and low input current ripple. To achieve high gain characteristics, the converter utilizes a quadratic boost converter on the input side to ensure continuous input current. Additionally, it implants the second winding of a coupled inductor within it, connecting it to the first winding of the coupled inductor and a voltage multiplier. The analysis includes a discussion of the operating principle, the derivation of the steady-state key equations, the voltage and current stress on the components, and the boundary condition. A functional prototype is built to confirm the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis and Design of a High-Speed Permanent Magnet Machine with Toroidal Windings for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-speed permanent magnet (HSPM) machines are promising candidates for electric propulsion systems. This paper investigates design considerations for the HSPM machines, including slot/pole combinations, materials, rotor eddy current loss and stator iron loss calculation, magnets magnetization method. Finally, a 100kW 24-slot/2-pole prototype with toroidal windings at a rotation speed of 35krpm has been designed. Its electromagnetic performance, including electromagnetic losses, efficiency, and torque, is examined and evaluated. Finally, a 3-D model of the rotor system is established and the rotor dynamic performance has been evaluated and analyzed based on the finite element analysis (FEA).

articleTitle: Analysis of Abnormal Temperature Rise of Bridge Arm Reactor Under AC/DC Superposition Condition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Bridge arm reactor is an important part of DC converter station. It can reduce the content of current ripple and restrain short circuit current to ensure the stable operation of power system. However, abnormal temperature rise is an important cause of reactor failure, which can be caused by factors such as product design defects or foreign matter entry. The reactor must withstand AC-DC complex current with a large amplitude during operation. The distribution of AC current and DC current follows different laws, resulting in a more complex distribution of the space magnetic field of the reactor. This can cause local overheating, which may significantly impact the safe operation of the bridge arm reactor. This paper uses simulation software to construct a model under both DC working conditions and AC-DC superimposed conditions. Using the finite element method, we conducted a multi-physical field coupling analysis of the flow field-temperature field of the bridge arm reactor. This allowed us to calculate the spatial magnetic field distribution and loss under different working conditions. We then studied the temperature field distribution of the reactor under different working conditions. The analysis examines the temperature rise of the bridge arm reactor under DC and AC-DC superposition conditions, and identifies the temperature rise mechanism of the bridge arm reactor under these conditions.

articleTitle: Research on Active and Reactive Power Cooperative Optimization of Distribution Network Including Photovoltaic, Energy Storage and EV
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, an active power and reactive power cooperative optimal control algorithm for distribution network with photovoltaic - EV-energy storage is proposed. The algorithm not only realizes the active power leveling of photovoltaic, but also realizes the reactive power multi-objective optimization of distribution network. This strategy uses multi-objective niching particle swarm optimization (NPAMOPSO) to ensure the diversity of solutions and prevent the algorithm from converging prematurely. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by IEEE33 node simulation.

articleTitle: Sensorless Operation of Permanent Magnet Machine with Low Saliency Ratio Utilizing Orthogonal High-Frequency Voltage Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rim-driven permanent magnet synchronous machine(PMSM) is integrated with the propeller blade, which makes the air gap length larger and the saturation saliency effect lower, resulting in the traditional high-frequency(HF) voltage injection method at zero-low speed difficult to ensure operation. In order to achieve reliable control at zero-low speed, an orthogonal HF voltage injection method and a position signal demodulation strategy are proposed to achieve high signal-to-noise ratio rotor position error information feedback. On this basis, in order to optimize HF signal processing, a rotor position extraction strategy based on second-order generalized integrator(SOGI) combined with PLL is proposed to ensure the improvement of dynamic performance of position observation loop under high filtering accuracy. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified on a rim-driven PMSM platform.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic calculation and analysis of five-phase induction motor with composite winding
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The winding connection method is closely related to the motor performance, and this paper constructs a new type of star-pentagonal composite winding based on the present single winding structure of a five-phase induction motor. Firstly, an analytical method is used to derive the expression for the magnetic potential of the composite winding and to analyse the harmonic distributions of the air gap densities of the two single and composite winding motors at no-load. The currents of five-phase induction motors with star-pentagonal composite windings are then calculated under normal operating conditions as well as under typical fault conditions of the windings. The currents of five-phase induction motors with star-pentagonal composite windings are then calculated for normal operating conditions and for typical fault conditions of the windings. The influence law of different operating conditions on the motor performance of the new composite winding five-phase induction motor is obtained. The results of the study provide a certain reference for ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the motor, as well as further fault tolerant control and fault detection.

articleTitle: Output Fluctuation Reduction in Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Wireless Charging through Sine-Cosine Mutual Inductance Overlay
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Wireless power transfer (WPT) has developed substantially in the field of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) in recent years. In order to achieve stable power supply performance under misalignment, a series of studies have been carried out in this paper to reduce the output current fluctuation. First, a magnetical matching coupler is constructed. The designed receiver is able to capture both the horizontal and vertical transmitting magnetic flux in a complementary way, thereby enhancing the anti-misalignment capability. Specifically, the receivers comprise two sets of orthogonally placed coils. Second, by optimizing the structure parameters of the coupler, a standard sine-cosine curve can be obtained to describe the variation of mutual inductance with misalignment. The absolute value addition of the sine-cosine can reduce the curve fluctuation. Finally, a parallel topology is designed for multiple receiving coils to facilitate twice curves overlay. The system delivers an output power of 146.6W with a DC-DC efficiency of 82.2%. Within the misalignment range of [−90mm, 90mm], the output current can be maintained around 6.2A, with a current fluctuation range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm \mathbf{0.3}\mathbf{A}$</tex>. The DC-DC efficiency can be maintained around 83%, with an efficiency fluctuation range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pm \mathbf{2.3}\%$</tex>.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Affecting the Adhesion of 220kV Vertical Double Split Conductors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the adhesion problem of 220kV vertical double-split conductors, a critical load calculation model for double-split conductor adhesion was established, and the effects of gear distance, conductor split spacing, wind speed, wind vibration, conductor temperature difference, etc. on conductor adhesion were studied. The results show that the main cause of conductor adhesion is that the distance between the sub-conductors is too small due to wind vibration, construction errors, temperature differences between the upper and lower sub-conductors, etc. Under large load current conditions, the electromagnetic attraction between the sub-conductors causes adhesion. For a 220kV conductor-bonded line in Inner Mongolia, treatment measures were proposed to replace suspension clamps and increase the distance between conductor splits. The actual engineering treatment cases have achieved good results and provide reference for preventing similar problems.

articleTitle: A Novel Distributed Secondary Voltage Control Strategy in Islanded Microgrids Using Finite Time Extended State Observer and Sliding Mode Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article presents a novel strategy for distributed secondary voltage control in islanded microgrids (MGs). The proposed approach integrates Finite Time Extended State Observer (FTESO) and Sliding Mode Control (SMC). Initially, we establish the nonlinear mathematical model for distributed generators (DGs). Subsequently, the feedback linearization method is employed to formulate a second-order linear system, with voltage as the output and the secondary control signal as the input. To handle immeasurable variables within second-order linear systems, we design an FTESO to observe the system states. Finally, leveraging the observed states, we develop a distributed secondary voltage control method based on SMC. Simulation results conducted using MATLAB/SIMULINK validate the effectiveness of the proposed approach presented in this article.

articleTitle: Modulation Strategy of DAB Converter Based on Grid-Connected Electric Methanol System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Nowadays, the integration of energy storage systems into the grid has become an important way to solve the problems of smoothing the fluctuation of wind and solar power generation and abandoning wind and light, and in order to solve the problem of carbon emissions, the integration of electric methanol systems has become an economical and environmentally friendly reliable way. In order to make the electric methanol system efficient and stable grid connection, this paper proposes an extended phase shift modulation strategy based on frequency domain analysis for the dual active bridge converter, the core device of the electric methanol system, which solves the problem that the modulation strategy based on time domain analysis of the dual active bridge converter cannot cope with the complex mode of the electric methanol system, which can effectively improve the product concentration and improve the system efficiency after grid connection.

Author Keywords: Grid connection of energy storage system

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors and Optimization Strategy for Transient Power Angle Stability of VSG-DFIG
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Transient power angle stability issue of VSG-DFIG may occur when the grid voltage dips slightly in three phases, similar to the synchronous machine. Based on the equal area criterion (EAC), the influences of the grid-side converter and changing active power reference are analyzed when the grid voltage undergoes a three-phase symmetrical dip. On the basis of changing active power reference strategy, a stability optimization method based on transient power angle feedforward is proposed. First, the transient power angle steady-state point considering the slip power is calculated, and then the feedforward coefficient range is determined by the relationship of the acceleration and deceleration areas of the transient power angle feedforward strategy. By compensating the unbalanced torque with the transient power angle feedforward strategy, the DFIG can achieve the maximum power output capacity during the transient period while ensuring the power angle convergence. Finally, the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the optimization method are verified by simulation and hardware-in-the-loop experiment platform.

articleTitle: Vibration Characteristics of GIS Under Multi-Frequency Sinusoidal Steady Current
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When the new source and load are connected to the grid, many harmonic components are generated, and the harmonics will affect the vibration characteristics of the gas insulated switchgear (GIS). Firstly, the types and components of the harmonics generated when the new sources or loads are connected to the grid are analyzed and summarized. Then the vibration mechanism of the GIS busbar shell is analyzed and the relationship between vibration-related physical quantities and excitation current is investigated. Finally, the simulation model is established based on the existing GIS single-phase busbar shell in the laboratory as a prototype, and the vibration characteristics of GIS under the excitation of multi-frequency sinusoidal current are simulated. Through simulation calculations, it is found that the vibration amplitude of the GIS shell is roughly symmetrically distributed in the axial direction. And the electromagnetic force on GIS is proportional to the frequency of excitation current and the square of the excitation current amplitude. The vibration acceleration frequency of GIS is twice the frequency of the excitation current. When there are multiple harmonic currents, its vibration frequencies are richer and it is easier to cause mechanical resonance. The vibration under current excitation of 50 Hz, 100 Hz, 150 Hz, 200 Hz and 300 Hz is relatively weak, and the maximum vibration acceleration under these five excitation frequencies is 0.58 mm/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. But under the excitation of the 5th harmonic (250 Hz) current, the vibration acceleration of the GIS busbar shell is about 80 mm/s<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, which is much greater than the results under other frequency excitations.

articleTitle: A novel self-healing anti-algae RTV coating for external insulation surfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the humid environment, the external insulation surface of some outdoor equipment is easy to grow algae, and it grows again after removal, which affects the safe of the equipment. In this paper, a self-healing anti-algae RTV coating suitable for external insulation of power equipment was prepared. The coating has excellent anti-algae properties because of the effect of slow release of anti-algae agent and self-healing of microcracks, which can inhibit the adhesion of algae on the surface. At the same time, it also has the dielectric, electrical, mechanical and thermal properties of conventional RTV coatings.

articleTitle: A Non-Redundant Fault-Tolerant Control of Parallel Wind Power Conversion Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Owing to the extreme offshore environment and high maintenance costs, offshore wind power conversion systems typically adopt a parallel topology structure to enhance power capacity. However, in conventional control schemes, the offshore wind power conversion system lacks fault tolerance. Once a converter fails, the system will immediately disconnect the whole converter. And if all parallel converters fail, the wind turbine will be shut down. In this paper, a non-redundant fault-tolerant control method is proposed for parallel wind power conversion systems. The method does not require additional redundant hardware and just modify control instructions according to grid-side three-phase current flows. With this strategy, only faulty switches need to be disconnected while all healthy switches can still be fully utilized to improve efficiency and feasibility. The proposed method is confirmed via simulation data.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization Analysis of High-power Dual Three-phase Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Dual three-phase generator is a generator with two sets of three-phase windings on the stator. It usually has the characteristics of high power output with the medium and low voltage occasion and strong fault tolerance, so it is especially suitable for high safety requirements such as electric ship propulsion, aerospace and other occasions. In this paper, a high-power electric excitation dual three-phase generator is designed based on the ship. Firstly, the dual three-phase generator is preliminarily designed by the motor design principle, and then using multi-objective method to optimize of electromagnetic weight and efficiency for the preliminarily designed dual three-phase generator. The simulation is carried out by finite element software, and then compared with the data before and after optimization. The results show that after multi-objective optimization, the efficiency of the generator is improved, and the electromagnetic weight is reduced at the same time.

articleTitle: Thermal Network Analysis of High-Frequency High-Voltage Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Temperature is an important influence factor to the safe and stable operation of high-frequency high-voltage transformer. Overheating of high-frequency high-voltage transformers will reduce the withstand voltage and mechanical strength of the insulating material, and accelerate the aging of the insulation system. Existing methods are difficult to take into account the accuracy and speed of the transformer temperature field calculation, so this paper proposes an accurate thermal network model of the transformer, which takes into account the three heat transfer modes of conduction, convection, and radiation. This model analyzes the heat flow with the actual structure of the transformer, and finely delineates the core region of the transformer, so that the temperature distribution of the transformer can be obtained quickly and accurately. This paper takes the high-ratio honeycomb transformer as an example, constructs the thermal network model based on MATLAB/Simulink, and the results are compared with the results of ANSYS software, which proves the calculation accuracy and speed of the thermal network model and provides a new idea for the reliability evaluation and optimization design of the transformer.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Wind Speed Prediction Based on ICEEMDAN and SSA-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Accurate ultra-short-term wind speed prediction plays a pivotal role in the operational efficiency, reliability and safety of wind power systems. But the complexity of wind speed makes it difficult to predict. In order to accurately predict the wind speed, an ultra-short-term wind speed prediction model is proposed. First, the original wind speed data are decomposed into a series of modal components from high frequency to low frequency using improved complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise (ICEEMDAN), which effectively reduces the complexity of the wind speed sequence. Second, for the large number of hyperparameters in the long short-term memory (LSTM), the sparrow search algorithm (SSA) is used to find the optimum. Then LSTM is used to make the prediction. Next, the predicted sequences are superimposed and reconstructed to get the predicted data of wind speed. Finally, the improved model is compared with a single LSTM model as well as the ICEEMDAN-LSTM model. The comparison results show that the improved model predicts significantly better than the other models, and has better results for ultra-short-term wind speed prediction.

Author Keywords: improved complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise

articleTitle: Analysis and Suppression of Harmonic Current for NPC Three-Level Inverter Based on a Minimun Harmonic Current Modulation Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The high-frequency harmonic current is of great difference based on the modulation strategy selected. The current harmonics will lead to the loss, electromagnetic noise, and torque ripple of the permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM). Therefore, this article proposed an improved modulation strategy to suppress the current harmonics. The proposed method is based on the frequency-domain model of three popular modulation strategies in the NPC three-level inverter. With the quantification of the current harmonics modulated by difference strategy, a modulation selection method for minimizing the current harmonics of PMSM is proposed. Finally, the current harmonics of the three strategies and the proposed modulation strategy in different operating conditions are simulated. The proposed method can obtain minimum output current harmonics under all operating conditions.

articleTitle: FPGA Implementation of High-Bandwidth Fast Current Control Without Computational Delay
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the field of PMSM control, the current loop bandwidth represents the dynamic performance of the servo system. In this paper, based on the mathematical model, it is proved that the effective way to widen the current loop bandwidth under the condition of constant switching frequency is to reduce the computational delay of the current loop. In this paper, an improved piecewise and instant PWM duty cycle update method based on FPGA is proposed to reduce the complexity of the current loop computation when multi-sampling and multi-update are performed, which can effectively reduce the Computational delay, and the method can also improve the system DC bus voltage utilization. The feasibility of this method has been verified by experiments under different current conditions in permanent magnet synchronous motor.

articleTitle: High Temperature Trailing Phenomenon of Sliding Electrical Contact in Pantograph-catenary System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To further understand the high temperature tailing phenomenon in the contact area of the pantograph-catenary system, the influence of contact current, sliding speed, the material of contact wire and rain environment on the phenomenon were analyzed by simulation. Peak distance and trailing temperature difference were used to reflect the intensity of the high temperature tailing phenomenon. When the contact area moves from one end of the slide surface to the other end, the peak distance increases and then decreases obviously, and the trailing temperature difference shows the opposite variation law. Sliding speed, contact current and the material of contact wire have little influence on the peak distance. Under the same conditions, the peak distance in rainfall environment is larger than that in no-rain environment. Contact current has little influence on the trailing temperature difference. When other conditions are the same, the trailing temperature difference increases with the increase of sliding speed. The trailing temperature difference of CuMg contact wire is slightly larger than that of pure copper and CuSn contact wire. The trailing temperature difference is larger in no-rain environment than that in rainfall environment. It has a certain reference value for understanding the sliding electrical contact performance of pantograph-catenary system.

articleTitle: On Internal Stable Modes of Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Learning from two-level voltage source converters (TL- VSCs), tremendous efforts have been addressed on the impedance-based stability analysis for modular multilevel converters (MMCs), with a focus on the external stable modes regarding the AC/DC subsystem interconnection. Such a tendency is an ignorance of the observability of stability analysis using transfer functions (TFs) instead of state spaces. To this end, this paper starts by listing three scenarios in which the system stability analysis involving TL- VSCs is insufficient to assess using a single TF. A critical method to inspect the internal stable modes of MMCs is proposed, by first establishing the loop impedance model of the AC circulating circuit and then applying the logarithmic derivative-based criterion. It is revealed that the too-fast response of circulating current control with the non-negligible control delay tends to deteriorate the system stability. Therefore, considering the existence of circulating current with the dedicated control dynamics, the internal stable modes analysis using a separate TF is essential for MMCs.

articleTitle: Frequency support control strategy of permanent magnet direct-driven wind turbine with inertial synchronization
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of the proportion of new energy wind power connected to the grid, a large number of wind turbines lack inertial support and frequency modulation functions, which leads to a series of grid-connected stability problems such as harmonic oscillation, sub-synchronous oscillation and low frequency oscillation. It brings great hidden trouble to the safe and stable operation of the power grid. This paper presents an inertial synchronous control method for a single permanent magnet synchronous generator. The grid-side converter is synchronized with the grid according to the DC capacitor voltage amplitude, and the phase-locked loop is omitted. Inertia response control is added to the control loop to realize the inertia response function of the wind turbine to the power grid. The frequency modulation strategy adopts the additional power control, and the battery energy storage is configured on the DC bus side of the back-to-back converter, so that the permanent magnet direct-driven wind turbine has the function of one-time frequency modulation.

articleTitle: Research on One-Key Sequence Control Intelligent Acceptance Technology of Substation in the Context of New Power System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous application of grid digitalization technology to the front line of production such as grid operation and maintenance and overhaul, the one-key sequence control technology, as a new technology for grid outage and power delivery reverse operation, can realize the safe, convenient and fast carrying out of grid outage, power delivery as well as fault isolation and other scenarios. However, it is a technical bottleneck to ensure that the one-key sequence control function is safely and orderly put into the grid safety production operation, so the acceptance of one-key sequence control is crucial. This paper proposes a method to realize fast and efficient acceptance of one-key sequence control based on the background database of substation monitoring host and the semantic recognition of field text of typical operation ticket. By comparing the text to be verified according to the characteristics and rules of the field information of the operation instruction, the respective hash mapping of the operation tasks and operation steps in the two texts is extracted. And based on natural language processing, the key-value pairs of hash mapping data cleaning, text standardization, word splitting, feature extraction, and ultimately realize the format unity of the messy data between two different databases, and ultimately in accordance with the different fields of word splitting information to complete the rapid checking and matching of all the one-key sequence control acceptance work.

articleTitle: A Novel Electric Field Coupling Mechanism With Dynamic Tolerance for Rail WPT Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A common dynamic energy transfer method in electric field coupled wireless power transfer technology is the dynamic track coupler. This article designs a dynamic track type coupler, which is more suitable for track type transportation equipment with relatively fixed structures. Compared with traditional long rail couplers, it increases coupling capacitance and improves the stability of dynamic energy transmission. By designing couplers, the ability to shield leakage electric fields has been improved while significantly saving materials. A bidirectional LC topology CPT system has been designed, and when the transmission power is greater than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$1{\text{\ kW}}$</tex>, the transmission efficiency can reach <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$80{{\% }}$</tex>, improving the power density of the transmission structure. In addition, when offset occurs, transmission efficiency and power can fluctuate within a small range.

Author Keywords: Electric field coupled wireless power transfer

articleTitle: Aging Assessment Methods Based on Dyed Area Extraction for Composite Insulator Cores
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The aging phenomenon of insulating materials is very easy to lead to line failure, affecting the stable operation of the power system, and even causing huge economic losses, so the research on the aging degree of insulating materials is becoming more and more important. In this paper, after profiling an abnormally hot composite insulator and carrying out a dye penetration test on the aging epoxy resin core, the dyed portion of the core image was extracted by the dyed area extraction method based on the binary method and the RGB trichromatic method, and it was found that the results obtained were consistent with the dyed of the core after the penetration test. It shows that the two dyed area extraction methods have certain accuracy and can achieve the effect of quantitatively describing the aging degree at different locations of the core. It is speculated that the electric field stress point of the high-voltage side of the composite insulator is the starting point of the aging of the core.

articleTitle: Research on External Capacitor-Less Low Drop-Out Regulator for Power Integrated Circuits
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel high voltage low drop-out regulator (LDO) topology without external capacitor for power integrated circuits (PICs) applications. The circuit is designed for reliable performance with rapid setting time and high stability margin by innovating the conventional source follower buffer stage and error amplifier. Theoretical analysis and simulation results show that the external capacitor-less LDO designed in this paper significantly enhances frequency stability and transient response within the system, while concurrently preserving high integration level.

articleTitle: Analysis of Heating Causes of Composite Insulator of 500kV Transmission Line
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, various electrical and mechanical tests have been carried out on the abnormally heated composite insulators of 500kV transmission lines. It is found that the shielding depth of the voltage equalizing ring of the heating insulators is not enough, and the internal defects of the insulators are detected by tomograph. The research content of this paper provides a reference for analyzing the heating of composite insulators under similar circumstances.

articleTitle: Electric Field Coupled Wireless Power Transmission Based on Three-Phase System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For the common capacitive coupling mechanism of single-phase quadrupole plate, an equivalent method is often used to simplify the six-capacitor into four-capacitor, which has become the most widely used capacitance equivalent model. Compared with the single-phase electric field coupled wireless power transmission system, in order to improve the output power, this paper refers to this method to design a three-phase input three-pair plate wireless power transmission system. By making every two pairs of plates take an equivalent method, the expression of the equivalent coupling capacitance value of the three pairs of plates is obtained. Then the equivalent three-phase system is simplified to a single-phase network, and the characteristics of the system with constant voltage and constant current output are derived. And the output power expression is obtained. It is proposed to control the system by controlling the system frequency to make the reactive power 0. Through the finite element simulation software Maxwell, the equivalent coupling capacitance values of the three pairs of plates are simulated and calculated. The three capacitance values are approximately equal, which verifies the feasibility of the equivalent method. After that, the proposed system is modeled and simulated. The two results verify each other, which proves the constant voltage output characteristics of the system and the characteristics of the resonant output at constant voltage, and also verifies the correctness of the formula derivation.

articleTitle: Kinetic study of pyrolysis of typical high-voltage power cable
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Cable sheath pyrolysis plays an important part of the cable combustion process. In order to evaluate the pyrolysis performance of high-voltage power cables, thermogravimetric (TG) experiments are performed on a typical high voltage cable sheath in a nitrogen atmosphere. The pyrolysis kinetic parameters are calculated by FAS, FWO, Starink, and the pyrolytic stability is analyzed. The results show that cable pyrolysis is mainly divide into two stages. The apparent activation energies are 61.89 kJ/mol, 59.84 kJ/mol, and 60.73 kJ/mol in first stage those of the second stage are 120.69 kJ/mol, 117.11 kJ/mol, 118.44 kJ/mol, which means that the sheath material is more difficult to pyrolyze in the second stage.

articleTitle: Fractional-Order Equivalent Model for Dynamic On-Resistance of GaN HEMTs
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: GaN high electron mobility transistors (HEMTs) have been widely used due to their high withstand voltage characteristic and low parasitic parameters. However, these devices always face power losses caused by electron trapping effects, which perform in the form of the on-resistance of the devices. In this work, a fractional-order equivalent model is proposed for characterizing the dynamic on-resistance of GaN HEMTs, in which a fractional-order capacitor is introduced to describe the long-tailed distribution of time constants of electron detrapping effects. A cuckoo search algorithm-based parameter identification scheme is developed for extracting the parameters of the proposed model. The comparison between the prediction of the proposed model and experiments shows that, the dynamic on-resistance of GaN HEMTs can be characterized concisely and effectively.

articleTitle: Model Reference Adaptive Position Control of the Double-Sided Linear Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To enhance the position accuracy of the linear switched reluctance motor (LSRM), a model reference adaptive position control method of the double-sided LSRM (DLSRM) is proposed in this paper. A DLSRM developed in the laboratory is taken as an object. A reference model is first constructed based on the dynamic model of the DLSRM. A feedforward control action gain and a state feedback control action consist of the control law. Following that, adaptive laws are derived based on Lyapunov stability theory and model reference adaptive control theory. The adaptive laws are employed to dynamically modify the controller parameters in real-time. Subsequently, simulation of the proposed model reference adaptive position control for the DLSRM is performed. The simulation results demonstrate that the DLSRM system using the proposed model reference adaptive control method, achieves high-precision and robust position tracking. These results verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis of motor bearing based on the SCNGO-ICEEMDAN method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The fault signal of motor rolling bearing is easy to be covered by strong background noise due to its nonlinear and non-stationary characteristics, which leads to a decrease in fault diagnosis accuracy. With the Subtraction Average Based Optimizer and Cauchy variation strategy's Northern Goshawk Optimization (SCNGO), this paper proposes a SCNGO-ICEEMDAN method. Firstly, the SCNGO provides the optimal white noise amplitude weight and fault signal decomposition times, and again, the ICEEMDAN (improvement complete ensemble empirical mode decomposition with adaptive noise) is used to diagnose the motor rolling bearing fault. Finally, the effectiveness of the conventional Northern Goshawk Optimization (NGO) and SCNGO proposed in this paper are compared by using the HUST -bearing open dataset. The results show that the SCNGO-ICEEMDAN method achieves higher fault characteristic frequency and lower noise interference frequency than the NGO-ICEEMDAN method, which can significantly improve the accuracy of the motor rolling bearing fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Quadratic Step-Up DC-DC Converter Based on Switched Capacitor and Coupled Inductor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a cascaded high gain DC-DC converter based on the switched capacitor and coupled inductor with merits of high voltage-boost capability, low voltage stress and only one active switch. The combination of the coupled inductor and switched capacitor cell not only improves the voltage gain, but also decreases voltage stress on semiconductor devices. The quadratic structure makes the converter to have a wide voltage-gain range. Theoretical analysis of steady-state operation, voltage-gain derivation and component stress is conducted, and an experimental prototype was built to verify the theoretical analysis and feasibility of the converter.

articleTitle: A Battery-Ultracapacitor Hybrid Energy Storage System Based on a Bidirectional Hybrid Z-Source DC-DC Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Deploying energy storage systems (ESSs) is an effective way to maintain the reliability and robustness of power systems with renewable energy sources (RESs). This paper proposes a battery-ultracapacitor (UC) hybrid energy storage system (HESS) based on a bidirectional hybrid Z-source converter, which can be applied to mitigate the impact of dynamic power fluctuations and prolong the service life of battery cells. Compared with the conventional non-isolated bi-directional converters that have been used as the power interfacing circuit of energy storage systems, such as bi-directional dc-dc boost converter, Z-source converter, quasi-Z-source converter, and hybrid switched capacitor/quasi-Z-source converter, the outstanding advantage of this scheme lies in its relatively high voltage conversion ratio in bidirectional energy flows. This characteristic is beneficial to reducing the cost and size of ESSs, because the energy-storage components with a smaller rated voltage can be employed in the design. The detailed operation mode derivation of the proposed hybrid Z-source based HESS (HZS-HESS) is presented in the work along with characteristic analysis and energy-management strategy design. Two test scenarios of short-term power fluctuations are conducted for the proposed HZS-HESS. The simulation and comparison results show the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed scheme. In addition, an experiment prototype is developed to validate the characteristics and the analysis of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Open Winding - Permanent Magnet/Magnet Reluctance Hybrid Rotor Double Stator Synchronous Motor Fault-tolerant Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Coal mine conveyor belt and other low-speed large torque system, the stability of the motor requires high, Permanent Magnet/Magnet Reluctance Hybrid Rotor Double Stator Synchronous Motor (PM/MRHRDSSM) is just suitable for this requirement, however, the working environment of the mine is more complex and harsh, when the motor's controller fails is not easy to replace. Permanent Magnet/Magnet Reluctance Hybrid Rotor Double Stator Synchronous Motor (OW-PM/MRHRDSSM) dual-inverter fault-tolerant control strategy with three-phase four-bridge arms and three-phase shared bridge arm are proposed. The analyses are also carried out in terms of topology, space voltage vectors and switching states for the fault-tolerant control possibilities of the two open winding dual-inverter, and at the end of the paper, simulations are carried out to verify the correctness of the control method proposed.

articleTitle: A Novel Bidirectional Low-Loss Solid-State Circuit Breaker for More Electric Aircraft HVDC Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: HVDC power supply system has become the preferred power supply scheme for more electric aircraft (MEA) because of its high efficiency, low weight, and excellent output power quality. The Z-source solid-state circuit breaker (ZSCB) holds a unique position in airborne HVDC power supply systems, especially when it comes to isolating short-circuit faults. To improve some defects of the existing ZSCBs, such as high on-state loss, reflecting fault current to the source, and lack of hot start function, a novel ZSCB topology based on two-winding coupled inductors is proposed in this paper. The novel ZSCB is characterized by bidirectional power flow in the steady state and forced commutation under the short-circuit state due to the anti-parallel thyristor structure and the magnetic coupling effect of the coupled inductor. Firstly, the topological structure of the novel ZSCB is described. Subsequently, a comprehensive analysis of the operating principle of the novel ZSCB is conducted.-Finally, the effectiveness of the novel structure was confirmed through simulation results obtained from Saber.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Instantaneous Voltage Support Capability Under Voltage and Current Dual-Loop Control and Single-Loop Voltage Magnitude Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The grid-forming (GFM) energy storage power plant is essential for future power systems with a high share of renewables. Grids in different scenarios have different requirements for the capabilities of GFM energy storage systems. This paper aims to maximize the instantaneous voltage support capabilities of GFM control during voltage sags. The performances of two widely used GFM controls in terms of instantaneous response to voltage sag are compared. The similarities and differences between voltage and current dual-loop control and single-loop voltage magnitude (SLVM) control are discovered by dividing the GFM control into inner-loop control and outer-loop control. The dynamic response speeds are then compared by using the bandwidths. Through simulation experiments, the dynamic performances and influencing factors are analyzed. The results indicate that SLVM control exhibits better performance in terms of instantaneous response to voltage sag. This study provides useful references for the stable operation of power systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of The Impact of Non Ideal Grid Conditions on The Pre-Synchronization Strategy of Microgrids
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pre-synchronization is a key step in the transition of microgrids from off grid to grid connected mode, and its synchronization stability and anti-interference ability are important guarantees for the integration of distributed new energy into the grid. Propose a pre-synchronization strategy similar to reactive power calculation in αβ coordinate system, and explain its control principle. By establishing a nonlinear dynamic model to analyze its mathematical essence, and thereby analyzing the impact mechanism on its control when the power grid voltage contains asymmetry, low order harmonics, and DC component interference. Finally, the correctness of the analysis was verified through MATLAB/Simulink simulation and experiment.

articleTitle: Analysis of Air-Gap Field Harmonics and Torque Production Mechanism in Dual-Armature Flux-Switching Permanent Magnet Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the air-gap field harmonics in dual-armature flux-switching permanent magnet (DA-FSPM) machines with different stator core shapes are investigated from the perspective of flux modulation principle. Firstly, the pole-pair numbers and rotating speed of the air-gap field harmonics in the 12-stator-pole/10-rotor-tooth U-core DA-FSPM machine and its E-core counterpart machine are deduced based on the magnetomotive force model and air-gap permeance model. Then, the production mechanism in DA-FSPM machines is revealed and the contribution of the air-gap field harmonics to the electromagnetic torque are analyzed. It shows that the DA-FSPM machines exhibit abundant air-gap field harmonics including PM field, stator armature reaction field, and rotor armature reaction field harmonics. The stator and rotor saliency function as the modulators of the PM and armature reaction fields to make them have the same pole-pair number and rotating speed so as to produce steady electromagnetic torque. The dominating air-gap field harmonics contributing to the electromagnetic torque are identified and verified by finite element analysis.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of a High-Gain DC-DC Converter Under Partial Device Failure Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the development of DC grid transmission and distribution systems, DC microgrid busbars are showing a trend towards multi-voltage levels, and the interconnection and energy transmission between buses at different voltage levels has become urgent. With the promotion of photovoltaic panels and energy storage batteries, the load side in microgrids is trending towards low voltage. Based on the background, this paper proposes an isolated bidirectional DC/DC converter with high voltage gain and multi-port output characteristics. The proposed circuit can be regarded as a combination of constant voltage source and constant current source, featuring flexible power adjustment capabilities. This paper analyses the operation process under steady-state conditions and discusses the system stability under partial device failure conditions. The models of output power, current stress and soft switching range under a typical operation mode are established. Simulation experiments have demonstrated the stability of the designed converter under partial component failures. And the steady-state characteristics of the circuit were verified through an experimental prototype.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization Research Status of Metal Particle Traps in High Voltage AC GIL
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Metal particles affect the surface insulation of gas insulated transmission line (GIL) post insulators, which can be effectively suppressed by placing particle traps. The effectiveness of the particle trap depends mostly on its structural parameters and placement. This paper reviews the representative researches of last five years on the particle traps. Firstly, structural parameters of typical particle traps in AC GIL are summarized and the effects of different structural parameters such as slot width and slot thickness on the capture capacity of particle traps are analyzed. Furthermore, common strategies for particle traps placements in AC GIL are summarized and the particle-capturing performance of different trap placement is analyzed. Finally, the shortcomings of the existing studies on the structural parameters and placements of particle traps are summarized and the future research directions are pointed out. This paper can provide a reference for the design and optimization of particle traps in AC GIL.

articleTitle: Investigation of Partitioned-Stator PM Machines Equipped with Open-Winding Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper comparatively investigates the electromagnetic performances of the partitioned-stator field modulated permanent magnet machines (PS-PMMs) having different inner PM-stator configurations when the open-winding is utilized. With the open-winding inverter, the sinusoidal phase current with DC-bias, i.e., the hybrid excitation concept, can be applied into the phase winding. As such, the additional DC current component can be effective for the torque density and field-regulation capability improvement for the investigated four PS-PMMs. The results show that there is an optimum DC current ratio (k) for achieving the maximum torque when the RMS value of the phase current is fixed. Besides, due to flux-concentrating phenomenon, the PS-Spoke machine features higher torque than others while the PS-I machine exhibits higher torque adjustment ratio, i.e., excellent flux-regulation capability, albeit with the lowest torque capability among these machines.

articleTitle: Structure Comparison and Performance Analysis of Multi-Layer Flux-Barrier Hybrid-Pole Permanent-Magnet Synchronous Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As its numerous excellent performances., multi-layer flux-barrier hybrid-pole permanent magnet synchronous machine (MLFB-HP-PMSM) is applied in a lot of fields., for example electric vehicles., aerospace., home appliances and so on. In this paper., the comparison of structure and performances of MLFB-HP-PMSM are investigated. First of all., two structures of different PM arrangements of two layers hybrid poles are established and recommended. Then., on the premise of ensuring consistent use of permanent magnets of two structures., the electromagnetic performances of two motor structures are compared. After that., the better performing motor structures have been used for further research., involving the influence of motor structural parameters (flux-barrier angles) on electromagnetic torque.

articleTitle: Research on Ultrasonic-UHF Interdigital Structure Single Sensor for Partial Discharge Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In view of the complex electric field, the internal field of power equipment will have different degrees of distortion, so that the local electric field outburst will be strengthened, and partial discharge (PD) will occur, which will affect the stable operation of power equipment. In order to realize simple and reliable PD joint detection of power equipment under complex electric field, based on the sensing principle of piezoelectric ultrasonic method and the sensing principle of two-dimensional planar ultra-high frequency (UHF), a structure model of lead zirconate titanate substrate sensor with the function of simultaneously sensing PD ultrasonic signal and electromagnetic wave signal is constructed by using omnidirectional annular interdigital electrode structure. The three-dimensional acoustic and electromagnetic simulation optimization of the sensor is constructed by COMSOL and ANSYS HFSS respectively. The simulation results show that: The average ultrasonic sensing sensitivity of the ultrasonic- UHF interdigital structure single sensor designed in this manuscript is 20.5dB in the frequency band of 20kHz~200kHz; the electromagnetic wave sensing VSWR<5 in the 0.33GHz~2.5GHz band. This manuscript solves the problem that the ultrasonic method and UHF method commonly used in PD detection of power equipment cannot use a single sensor to perceive two signals at the same time, and provides a new solution to the simple and reliable perception of PD in power field.

articleTitle: Calculation of Electric Field Distribution of 220 kV SF6 Current Transformer and Simulation Analysis of Bubble Defect Inside Basin-type Insulator
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In recent years, the accidents of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> current transformer occur frequently, which seriously threaten the safe and reliable operation of the power system. In order to study the electric field distribution of SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> current transformer and find out the weak point of insulation, this paper takes 220 kV SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> current transformer as the research object, using finite element simulation software, establishing a model according to the actual structure and size of the current transformer, then calculating and analyzing the electric field distribution, and finally making a simulation analysis of the situation when there is a micro-bubble defect inside the basin-type insulator. The results show that the electric field strength is larger on the surface of the primary winding, the arc surface at both ends of the secondary shielding cover and the arc surface inside the bottom end of the high-voltage shielding cylinder. The maximum electric field strength is 4.68 kV/mm, 4.09 kV/mm and 4.73 kV/mm, respectively. The electric field strength of the tri-dielectric junction, which consists of the baseplate, insulator and SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas, as well as the countersink nut head and the neck of the basin-type insulator, is larger. The maximum electric field strength is 3.12 kV/mm.
