According to the above results, the local electric field strength of the current transformer is larger, which will increase the risk of partial discharge. When there are defects in the insulation, partial discharge is more likely to occur, which affects the safety and stability of the device. Therefore, it is not only necessary to optimize the insulation structure, but also to continuously improve the production process to eliminate insulation defects at the source.

articleTitle: Adaptive Gain Sliding Mode Observer for Sensorless Control of Brushless DC Motors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Traditional sliding mode observers' fixed gain and sign function leads to system oscillations and stability issues. This paper proposes an improved novel sliding mode observer(SMO) strategy for brushless DC motor control. On the one hand, in order to reduce chattering caused by the discontinuity of the traditional sign function, a new approach law is designed on the basis of the traditional power-law approach law, which improves convergence speed while reducing chattering. On the other hand, A self-adaptive gain is proposed to replace the fixed gain of SMO based on current error, ensuring the stability of the control system in various situations and improving the accuracy of speed observation. Then, based on the observed linear back electromotive force, the motor speed and rotor position are obtained, achieving sensorless control. Finally, the effectiveness of this strategy was verified through simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Optimal Scheduling of Integrated Electricity and Natural Gas System Considering Demand Response
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the integrated electricity and natural gas system with power-to-gas equipment is taken as the research object, the resource adjustment on the source-load side is coordinated, and the optimal scheduling model taking into account the electricity price based demand response is constructed. With the minimum total cost of the system as the decision-making goal, the square terms in the constraint conditions are processed by piecewise function linearization method. A simulation example of an IEEE 30-node transmission network coupled with a Belgian 20-node natural gas network is built to solve the converted mixed integer linear model. The total cost, wind abandonment and electric load demand distribution under each scenario model are compared and analyzed, and the huge advantages of the power-to-gas equipment in enhancing the coupling of the integrated electricity and natural gas system and absorbing wind power output are verified. The addition of demand response further improves the economy of the system operation and plays the role of peak cutting and valley filling.

Author Keywords: integrated electricity and natural gas system

articleTitle: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Control System with Filterless High Frequency Square Wave Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To address the problems of limiting system bandwidth., reducing dynamic performance., and phase lag caused by the use of filters in the high-frequency injection method of permanent magnet synchronous motors under low-speed operating conditions., a filterless control method for high-frequency square-wave voltage injection is proposed. Firstly., a high-frequency square-wave voltage signal is injected into the d-axis observed rotor shaft., and the rotor position error is calculated by the filterless high-frequency response signal separation method. Then., the rotor position is observed by a modified Lomborg state observer with higher observation accuracy. Finally., the proposed filterless high-frequency square-wave voltage injection control strategy is simulated and experimentally verified using a IPMSM position sensorless vector control platform., both of which show that the improved control method reduces the rotor position estimation error., increases the accuracy of position estimation., and improves the system identification accuracy.

articleTitle: Discrete-time Current Regulator with Improved Rejection of DC Offset for PMSM Drives
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, a discrete-time current regulator is designed. The proposed current controller introduces an additional feedforward path to decouple dq-axes current, which could achieve the same transfer function as the conventional complex current controller. A weighting factor is applied to adjust the capability of rejecting DC offset which may exist in the current measurement. The design principle of the proposed current controller is introduced. And selection of the weighting factor is theoretically analyzed. Finally, the robustness of the proposed current controller against DC offset is experimentally verified under low sampling ratios.

articleTitle: A Novel Yokeless Permanent Magnet Vernier Machine with Compensated Rotor Structure
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper presents a novel yokeless Vernier permanent magnet (PM) machine for low-speed direct-drive systems. The key novelty is that the compensated rotor structure is integrated with the yokeless complementary rotor structure. The torque production between two rotors can be balanced, the stator yoke is no longer necessary, and therefore the machine space can be better utilized. In this paper, the machine structure and working principle are introduced under bidirectional flux modulation theory and magnetic flux path analysis, respectively. The electromagnetic performances of the proposed structure, including flux distribution, open-circuit back EMF and torque performances, are given under the proposed machine design. And the design suggestions are given accordingly.

articleTitle: A Low-Cost Transistor based Active EMI Filter for CM EMI Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the increasing application of various power electronic devices in industry and daily life, the electromagnetic interference (EMI) generated by higher di/dt and dv/dt during switching is exacerbated. Electromagnetic interference (EMI) not only jeopardizes the operational reliability of the device but also disrupts the normal functioning of other equipment. With the escalation of switching frequency and power density in power converters, the challenges and expenses associated with mitigating electromagnetic interference (EMI) also rise. Traditional EMI suppression methods mainly focus on passive EMI filters, which are large in size and weight. In order to solve this problem, a low-cost active EMI filter based on transistor circuits is proposed. In this paper, which can achieve common-mode EMI suppression while keeping its cost at a low level. The structure of the active EMI filter is simple and the volume can be kept small. The working principle of the active filter is analysed in detail. The active filter is fabricated and experimented, and the experimental results verify that this AEF can effectively suppress the common-mode EMI on the DC side.

articleTitle: Research on the Gradient Control Method of Electric Field Strength for Environmentally Friendly GIS Basin Insulators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the promotion of the dual carbon goal, the green and low-carbon transformation of the power system is imperative, and the replacement of fluorine containing switchgear is urgent. Green and environmentally friendly switchgear has become an urgent need for the construction of new power systems. This article establishes an electric-thermal-current multi field coupling simulation model for the accumulation of surface charges on insulators. A method for constructing composite gradient interface insulation of basin insulators is proposed by comparing the surface electric field distribution patterns and surface charge accumulation characteristics of insulators with different structures. The focus of geometric structure optimization is to achieve the reduction of surface normal electric field components and the suppression of surface charge accumulation. Reasonably optimizing the surface contour curve of insulators can simultaneously improve the tangential and normal electric field distribution of insulators, using particle swarm intelligence optimization algorithm. After optimization, the maximum field strength on the convex side of the spacer surface decreased to 3.27 kV/mm, and the maximum field strength on the concave side decreased to 3.67 kV/ mm.

articleTitle: A Quadrature-Coil-Based Simultaneous Power and Information Transfer System with Low Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to meet the demand of power supply and information feedback for autonomous underwater vehicles (AUV), this paper proposes a quadrature-coil-based simultaneous power and information transfer system. The power is transferred from the primary side to the secondary side through the DD coil, and the information is transferred by placing a circular coil in the low field intensity area of the DD coil to reduce the interference of the power channel on the information channel. It is found that the increase of the turn numbers and the current of the DD coil will reduce the area of the central low field strength, and the information coil has a good ability to resist axial misalignment. An experimental platform was built to realize the synchronous transmission of power and information with the information transmission rate of 20kbps.

articleTitle: Baseline Load Calculation Method Based on User Participation in Demand Side Response in Power Market
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The accurate calculation of baseline load is the basis for the implementation of demand side response. Based on multiple time scales, this paper uses a large number of power load data of users in different industries. Firstly, the mean square error and total average error of baseline load calculation results using weighted average method, quadratic exponential smoothing method and autoregressive moving average method at different time scales are compared. Secondly, the relative error method is used to determine whether the event day is a normal working day. Finally, the optimal calculation results are obtained by comparison. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively improve the accuracy and universality of baseline load calculation.

articleTitle: A Performance Comparison of Radial Flux SPM Machine and YASA Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The axial flux yokeless and segment armature (YASA) machine and the radial flux surface-mounted permanent magnet (SPM) machine are widely used in the electric aviation field as two kinds of high-power density motor topologies. This paper analyzes the effect of key geometrical parameters including air-gap area on the performance of the machine. Both motors' torque density, overload capacity, and efficiency are compared by the magnet equivalent circuit (MEC) method and finite element analysis (FEA) method. The results show that the YSAS machine has a smaller volume and higher overload capacity. The weight and efficiency of the two motors have their advantages, which depend on the size and working condition of the motor.

articleTitle: A Novel Bipolar Coil with Interoperability and Misalignment Tolerance for EVs Wireless Power Charging
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) wireless charging systems have several different coil types, and each coil type may not be compatible with the others, leading to interoperability issues. Additionally, misalignment may occur between the transmitter and receiver during parking. The interoperability and misalignment tolerance problems of wireless charging for EVs need to be addressed. To solve these problems, a novel asymmetrical bipolar coil structure with interoperability and misalignment tolerance is proposed. The proposed coil structure is further obtained by stacking the unipolar, horizontal bipolar, and vertical bipolar in positive position. The optimum parameters of the coupling structure were finalized by finite element analysis (FEA). An experimental prototype was also fabricated to validate this proposal. The effectiveness of the proposed coil is verified through calculations, simulations, and experiments. The final overall transmission efficiencies obtained are all higher than 90%, regardless of the unipolar, horizontal bipolar, and vertical bipolar coil structures were the receiving coils.

articleTitle: A Variable Frequency Device Based on BDFM and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Variable frequency transformers, as an energy conversion device, have important applications in wind power low-frequency transmission systems and isolated variable frequency power supply systems. At present, there is a brush slip ring structure in variable frequency transformers, which reduces the reliability of the motor. In order to solve the above problems, this paper proposes a frequency conversion device based on brushless doubly fed machine (BDFM) and its usage method, mainly including BDFM, driving motor, back-to-back converter, etc. The BDFM can be any form of wound rotor BDFM, salient pole rotor BDFM, permanent magnet field modulation BDFM, etc. The driving motor can be any form of permanent magnet synchronous motor, stator permanent magnet motor (including flux switching motor, flux reversing motor, doubly salient motor), homopolar inductor alternator, etc. The connection method between the drive motor rotor and the BDFM rotor can be radial coaxial connection or axial series connection according to the application scenario. The control winding of the BDFM is connected to the 50 Hz power grid through a back-to-back converter. The power winding and the winding of the driving motor are connected to a 50 Hz grid or low-frequency grid (or load) depending on the application scenario and the type of BDFM. The frequency conversion device based on BDFM proposed in this paper has the advantages of simple rotor structure and high reliability, and is very suitable for application in wind power low-frequency transmission systems and isolated frequency conversion power supply systems.

Author Keywords: isolated variable frequency power supply system

articleTitle: Research on Cost Optimization Model to Improve the Utilization Rate of Renewable Energy Unit Networking Project
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the process of large-scale renewable energy grid networking, the capacity of the networking line is designed according to the actual output capacity of the renewable energy, which will cause the low utilization rate of the networking line. Aiming at this problem, this paper puts forward a method to improve the utilization rate of renewable energy networking lines by installing energy storage system for renewable energy units. Firstly, the advantages of renewable energy unit operation with energy storage are analyzed. Secondly, considering the cost of renewable energy units, transmission line project cost, energy storage investment cost and other factors, a configuration method of energy storage system for transmission lines with the goal of maximizing economic benefits is proposed. Finally, taking a large renewable energy base in a province as an example, the correctness and rationality of the model and method are verified.

articleTitle: Typical Fault Simulation and Fault Diagnosis of High Voltage Circuit Breaker
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-voltage circuit breakers are among the most crucial equipment in power system. With the advancement of artificial intelligence, numerous advanced methods have been applied to identify fault types in high-voltage circuit breakers. This paper designs and acquires vibration waveform for common faults in circuit breaker operating mechanism, such as reduced spring pre-tightening force, excessively low operating voltage, loose bolts, and the stiction of iron core. Utilizing the denoising and feature extraction capabilities of the Channel-Wise Residual Shrinkage Module (DRSN-CW) with different thresholds in a deep residual neural network, a fault diagnosis model based on deep residual neural networks is proposed. This approach provides a novel perspective for advancing the application of fault localization in high-voltage circuit breakers.

articleTitle: Single Phase Ferroresonance Detection and Type Recognition in Solidly Grounded Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The nonlinear characteristics shown by ferroresonance are the basis for effective ferroresonance detection algorithm design. However, due to the lack of field recorded data and analytical solutions for the resonant circuit, it is difficult to quantitatively analyze the phenomena and thereby design the detection methods. What is more, there are faults that show similar waveform characteristics with ferroresonance in the field, mainly High Impedance Faults (HIF). Because of these reasons, reliability and accuracy of existing ferroresonance detection methods leave room to be improved. In this paper, the time domain analytical solution of Single-phase Series Ferroresonance (SSF) and HIF in solidly grounded power grid are obtained through piecewise linearization. The analytical solutions are quantitatively analyzed to retrieve fault signatures. The phase current mean envelope curve and phase voltage spectrum are then found to be dependable and accurate signatures for fault detection and they are utilized to construct the proposed detection method. The volt-ampere characteristics is found to be the signature to differentiate SSF with other faults, mainly HIF. The effectiveness of the detection algorithm is verified against simulation data, proving the algorithm's capability of protecting the grid against SSF and HIF.

articleTitle: A Value Set Approach for Stability Region Determination for Time Delayed Power Systems with Multiple Uncertain Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper develops a stability region computation method for time delayed power systems based on the value set method. It is designed to accommodate systems with multiple uncertain parameters and time delays. This method serves to analyze the small signal stability margin of power systems and offer guidance for system parameter design. Different from many previous works, this method achieves relatively high efficiency without any conservativeness. First, it processes polynomials with exponentials through polynomial transformations. Second, by continuously subdividing and discriminating the uncertain space, the parameter stability region of the system is obtained. Finally, the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method are validated through simulation examples in MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Thermal Analysis and In-Slot Cooling Design of Variable-Section Hairpin Winding Traction Motor for EV Based on Lumped Parameter Thermal Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the full-frequency domain efficiency of traction motor for EV and enhance the effect of heat dissipation in the slot, an in-slot cooling design of variable-section transposed hairpin winding permanent magnet synchronous motor is proposed. In this paper, the losses of four different variable-sections winding are first compared and analyzed. Subsequently, the lumped parameter thermal network model is constructed and its accuracy is verified. Then the effect of interstrand transposition of the windings on the winding losses and temperature is explored. Finally, a cooling scheme is proposed to replace a part of Litzpin conductors with cooling paths and the cooling effect is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Optimal Configuration Method of Regulated Power Sources Considering New Energy Accommodation Saturation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Configuration of regulated power sources can enhance the power system's ability to consume new energy. However, the current configuration of regulated power sources is less to consider the saturation effect of the capacity and power of the regulated power sources configuration on the new energy consumption capacity. There is the problem of high investment and system operation costs of regulated power sources due to the irrational configuration of the scale of regulated power sources for the purpose of enhancing the capacity of new energy consumption. Therefore, this paper proposes a method for optimizing the capacity and power configuration of regulated power sources that takes into account the saturation effect of new energy consumption capacity, establishes a weighted linear programming model that considers both the abandoned power rate and operating cost, and determines the optimal capacity and power configuration strategy of regulated power sources. By comparing and analyzing the simulation results of the three models, the effectiveness of the proposed model to improve the new energy consumption capacity and system operation economy is verified.

articleTitle: Voltage Control Strategy for Multi-Bus DC Micro-Grid with More Electric Aero Engines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increase of more electric aircraft loads it is imperative to increase power generation and improve bus voltage levels. DC micro-grids using multi-voltage level buses can be compatible with loads of different voltage levels and facilitating the parallel connection of multiple generators. A simulation with current-sharing control method based on power feedforward is implied. Results shows that this method can simply realize power distribution between generators of different capacities, and can effectively control the voltage of each bus within the normal operating range. By considering the multiple engines configuration in the control loop, the system is proved to make good transient and steady performance. The simulation verifies the control strategy.

articleTitle: Sub-Synchronous Oscillation Suppression in Series-Compensated Grid-Connected Doubly-Fed Wind Turbines Utilizing Virtual Inductance on the Rotor Side
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To tackle the issue of Sub-Synchronous Control Interaction (SSCI) in doubly fed wind turbines featuring series capacitor compensation, a novel approach is undertaken by creating an impedance model for the Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG). This model utilizes a power outer-loop control method for decoupling, in alignment with IEEE standards. The study extensively examines the genesis and underlying causes of sub-synchronous oscillations. A novel rotor-side suppression strategy, featuring the integration of virtual inductance into the DFIG's rotor control loop, is proposed to mitigate oscillations induced by series-compensated transmission line parameters. Comparative analysis indicates that the inclusion of virtual inductance effectively quells sub-synchronous oscillations. Additionally, a Simulink-based grid-connected DFIG model is constructed, and time-domain simulations are conducted to validate the model's accuracy in predicting grid-connected sub-synchronous oscillations and confirm the efficacy of the proposed suppression technique.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Superconducting Linear Motor Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Insufficient traction and large fluctuations are significant challenges for superconducting linear motors used in high-speed maglev trains, and the quality of traction is closely related to the motor's structural parameters. This paper proposes the utilization of multi-objective optimization genetic algorithms to optimize the motor parameters, employing NSGA-II, a non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm based on Pareto front solutions, for objective optimization. The optimized linear motor exhibits a significant increase in traction force coefficient, reduced fluctuation, and improved cost-effectiveness, providing a new approach for multi-objective optimization of superconducting linear motors.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Charge Storage Characteristic of Carbon Electrodes in Electric Double Layer Capacitors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Electrochemical capacitors (EC)., also known as supercapacitors (SC)., are widely utilized in energy storage technology., manifesting their superiority of high power density., long cycle life., and maintenance-free throughout entire life cycle. However., a certain degree of asymmetry has been found in the charge storage behavior of the same carbon material when being used as the positive and negative electrodes of electric double layer capacitors (EDLCs). Such a capacitive mismatch between positive and negative electrodes might have adverse effects on the performance of EDLC devices., resulting in the decrease in energy density and power density of the devices. In this work., a self-built EDLC was constructed to conduct cyclic voltammetry measurements for both positive and negative electrodes in various types of electrolytes. Then the influences of scan rate., ion species., and solvent on the asymmetry of carbon electrodes were investigated. These insights will provide rational directions for developing electrochemical capacitors with improved energy storage performance.

articleTitle: Effects of Wind Load on the Galloping Characteristics of 10 kV Overhead Insulated Conductors
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, based on the method of finite element simulation, the analytical model of 10kV single-file icing overhead insulated conductor is established in ANSYS. The aerodynamic and mechanical characteristics of the overhead line under different wind speeds are analyzed. The results show that, in a certain range of wind speed, the lift and resistance of the overhead line increase exponentially with the wind speed, but its aerodynamic coefficient does not change much. Moreover, the galloping amplitude of the overhead line grows slowly after reaching a certain wind speed and reaches the maximum amplitude corresponding to a wind speed of 5 m/s. However, the galloping frequency shows a tendency of increasing all the time with the increase of wind speed. The results could provide references for the monitor and prevention of the galloping of overhead transmission lines.

articleTitle: Lightning Impulse Flashover Characteristics of Glass Insulator String with RTV Coating
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Insulator plays the vital role in the high voltage transmission lines, including glass insulator, porcelain insulator, and silicone rubber (SR) based composite insulator. In addition, glass/porcelain insulator with SR coating is the most efficient approach to integrate the advantages of both organic and inorganic materials, and has been widely used worldwide. However, the significant performance degradation of steep-front impulse withstand ability of glass/porcelain insulator after coating has sparked widespread concern among researchers and engineers. Previous research has tried to illustrate the breakdown mechanism, while the tests are based on single pieces of insulators. Thus, in this paper, the lightning flashover tests on insulator strings with and without coating are carried out. The flashover processes are recorded and analyzed, which further verifies the influence of coating on the surface arc development. Then, based on the results, the recommending revisions towards the current test standards on coated insulators are proposed. It not only examines the possible defects in dielectrics, but also takes into account the distortion of flashover process introduced by the coating.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Subway Traction Reflux Distribution with AC Power Supply System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The outstanding advantages of single-phase AC traction power supply subway with power frequency make it put into operation more and more.CDEGS simulation software was used to simulate, HIFREQ module was used to build a subway tunnel reflux system model under single-phase power frequency AC power supply system, and after a series of assumptions and optimization, current was injected on the basis of direct power supply methods of bringing back streamline and overhead contact line, and the current in each reflux path was observed and its distribution ratio was obtained. The effect of train running position on return distribution ratio is discussed. The influence of the main site, soil resistivity and ground resistance on the distribution of traction reflux is discussed. The linear relationship is found. The farther the main site is from the line, the larger the proportion of ground reflux is, and the smaller the proportion of rail reflux is. Conversely, the larger the soil resistivity, the larger the rail reflux ratio, the smaller the ground reflux ratio. In addition, the greater the grounding resistance, the smaller the ground reflux.

articleTitle: Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Key Physical Properties of Cross-Linked Epoxy Resins Saturated with Water Absorption
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Epoxy resin is an important component of bridge arm reactors, but the invasion of a large number of water molecules into the epoxy system under a high humidity environment will have a certain effect on its various properties. In this paper, a model of cross-linked epoxy resin and a model of epoxy resin absorbing saturated water molecules are established, and the mechanical properties, dielectric properties and thermal conductivity of the two systems are calculated by molecular dynamics simulation. The mechanical and dielectric properties of the epoxy resin after water absorption were significantly degraded, in which the dielectric constant was enhanced by 23.02% compared with that of the epoxy composite, but the thermal conductivity of the model increased slightly after water absorption. The calculation also reveals the mechanism of water molecule invasion on the various properties of the material, which paves the way for the next step of modification and regulation for high humidity environment.

articleTitle: Impact of Nonlinear Parasitic Capacitance on Class-DE Inverters: Analysis and Research Methodologies
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Class-DE inverters with low voltage stress are highly efficient and compact. High-frequency resonance is commonly used for soft switching. However, at high frequencies, MOSFET nonlinear parasitic capacitance can disrupt soft-switching and reduce energy conversion efficiency. This study analyzes the effects of MOSFET parasitic capacitance on class-DE inverter parameters through simulations and analytical analysis. Two key findings emerge: Firstly, achieving soft switching in class-DE inverters depends on load variations and requires adjusting the duty cycle (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$D$</tex>). Secondly, the output voltage amplitude is proportional to the input voltage for a given duty cycle, indicating the dominant influence of MOSFET parasitic capacitance on soft-switching performance and energy conversion efficiency. This analysis contemplates a design methodology that accounts for nonlinear capacitance to identify the optimal duty cycle and resonance parameters within a class-DE inverter. Experimental validation confirms the impact of nonlinear capacitance, demonstrating the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Characterization Study on an Air-Core Rogowski Coil Based Current Transformer
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Advanced current transformer (CT) technologies have been motivated with the development of smart grids. Compared to traditional magnetic-core based CTs, air-core Rogowski Coil (RC) based low power current transformers (LPCTs) feature advantages of being lighter, more portable, and higher measurement accuracy in harmonic frequency range. In this paper, the characterization study of an air-core RC based LPCT is performed by utilizing numerical simulations. In specific, the influence of diverse parameters, for instance, the number of coils turns, harmonic frequency as well as the dimensions of the primary conductor are comprehensively investigated. The accuracy of the numerical model is then accordingly validated by comparing with theoretical computations. This study aims to deepen the understanding of the practical applications of the air-core RC based LPCT and provide insights for its widespread utilization in smart grids.

articleTitle: Oil-Filled Submarine Cable Leak Localization Method Based on Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This study focuses on the problem of leak localization in high-pressure oil-filled submarine cables. These cables employ oil-immersed insulation technology, which not only provides excellent insulating performance and high current-carrying capacity but also adapts to complex and harsh seabed conditions. Despite this, oil-filled submarine cables still face significant challenges in leak detection. Traditional methods involving manual inspection and underwater robots are costly and thus not widely applicable. Additionally, advanced sensor technologies are limited due to the unique structure of the cables. Existing leak detection methods mainly rely on analyzing the flow state of insulating oil, but the accuracy of this approach needs improvement, and it cannot determine the leak damping at the leak point. To address this, the study develops an efficient leak localization and leak damping identification model that combines a reduced-order leak flow model with deep neural networks. This model aims to quickly locate the leak points and digitally twin the leak conditions. Research results show that this identification model has high accuracy and feasibility, effectively reducing the cost of leak localization in oil-filled submarine cables.

articleTitle: A Low-stress High-gain Interleaved DC-DC Converter with Self-balancing Capacitor Voltage
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A low current ripple and low voltage stress interleaved high-gain boost converter is proposed in this paper. The proposed converter has two inductors in parallel at the input side and multiple capacitors in series at the output side, which reduces the ripple of the input current and the voltage stress on the output capacitor. In addition, the capacitor voltage at the output side of the proposed converter can be self-balancing. In this paper, the operating principle of the proposed converter is analyzed for different duty cycles (d> 0.5, d < 0.5), the small-signal model and the average model of the converter are derived, and the transfer function of the proposed converter is further obtained. To ensure the response speed and stability of the converter, the voltage and current double closed-loop control is adopted, with which classical PI regulators are utilized and designed. Finally, based on the theoretical analysis, a prototype with 150W, 30-70V input and 300V output is built, which controlled by a digital signal processor TMS320F28335. The proposed converter can be utilized in wide-scale fields such as electric vehicles, photovoltaic, and DC microgrid fields.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Misalignment Based on Wavelet and Attention Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Servo motor and transmission device are important equipment in modern industrial production. However, after long-term use, it is inevitable that faults will occur. Therefore, identifying faults in equipment holds significant importance in preventing unforeseen losses. In this paper, we present a data-driven intelligent fault diagnosis approach for parallel misalignment based on a novel continuous wavelet transform-attention convolutional neural network (CWT-ACNN) model. Firstly, the current signals are collected and labeled as 8 fault types, and then Morlet wavelet transform is used to convert the current signals of time series into time-frequency feature images. After changing the size of the images, they are fed into a convolutional neural network with an attention mechanism to identify fault types. Experimental results show that the CWT-ACNN proposed in this paper can achieve 99.79% accuracy, which is better than the existing methods for fault classification.

articleTitle: Improving High-Speed Switched Reluctance Motor by Amorphous Alloy and a New Winding Configuration for Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Switched reluctance motors (SRMs) have simple and robust structure, which is attractive for electric vehicles' (EVs) application. However, the torque densities of SRMs are much lower than those of permanent-magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs). A solution to obtain a comparable level of the power density with PMSMs is to run the SRMs to higher speeds. In this case, the core losses and the copper AC losses will be significantly high. In this paper, amorphous alloy is proposed to reduce the core losses. To increase the slot copper filling factor and the heat dissipation ability of the stator winding, the flat wire is used and a racetrack-type winding is proposed. The new winding configuration can reduce the eddy current losses to some extent. Meanwhile, the manufacturing and installation of the winding are simplified. To evaluate the benefits by using the amorphous alloy and the new winding, a SRM demonstrator of 30,000 r/min and 25 kW is designed.

articleTitle: The Optimization Design Method of Geogrid Slope Support System Based on Carbon Benefit Evaluation and AI Agent Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article presents an optimization design method for geogrid slope support system based on carbon benefit evaluation and artificial intelligence agent model. This method includes constructing a basic information list, performing finite element calculation and analysis of geogrid slope safety factor, applying ROA (Remora Optimization Algorithm) algorithm to optimize support vector machine regression model, and establishing a multi-objective optimization method that couples meta-heuristic algorithm LSO (Light Spectrum Optimizer) algorithm with surrogate model. This method aims to balance the total carbon emissions of the project and slope stability, and optimize the number of layers and length of geogrid arrangement.

articleTitle: Research on PD Type Identification Ability Test Method of GIS UHF On-Line Monitoring Equipment Based on PRPD Map Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: GIS equipment has now become the key equipment of power system, but in the process of its operation, internal discharge faults often occur due to metal particles, surface contamination and other reasons. The installation of GIS UHF partial discharge on-line detection equipment plays an important role in the early warning of GIS partial discharge. At present, the UHF on-line monitoring equipment still has insufficient ability to identify the type of partial discharge. There are still some UHF partial discharge on-line monitoring equipment used in UHV stations that cannot accurately identify the type of discharge, and there is currently no effective test method for the ability to identify the type of partial discharge of UHF on-line monitoring equipment. Therefore, it is of great significance to carry out the research on the test method of partial discharge type recognition ability of UHF on-line monitoring equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Recording Data Synchronization Algorithm Based on Prony Fitting and Zero Crossing
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the application of relay protection in active distribution network, data synchronization is of great significance to system protection. As the structure and composition of the power grid system become more and more complex, its fault characteristics also tend to be complicated. However, the traditional data self-synchronization algorithm ignores the start-up delay of the starting component, which will bring large synchronization errors in some complex fault conditions. Therefore, a zero-crossing point (ZCP) synchronization algorithm based on Prony fitting is proposed. The accurate fault time of the recorded signal on the load side is found by Prony fitting, and the fault time is used as the starting point of the load side to find the zero-crossing point, without considering the invalid zero-crossing point, so that the synchronization error is reduced to less than one sampling period. Through simulation verification, the algorithm in this paper can correctly identify the first zero-crossing point before fault under different fault types, different fault distances and different transition resistances, and achieve high-precision synchronization, which has good applicability and stability.

articleTitle: Open Circuit Fault Diagnosis of Five Phase Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Drive System Based on Hybrid Logic Dynamic Model
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In response to the problem of difficulty in locating faults in the inverter of a five-phase permanent magnet synchro-nous motor (PMSM) drive system after an open circuit fault, a fault diagnostic strategy based on mixed system state residual is proposed. By establishing a mixed logical dynamic (MLD) model that can represent the five-phase current, the output current of the dynamic model after a switch fault is derived, and the fault output current is compared with the normal current output of the drive system. The residual current is obtained for fault diag-nosis and localization, in order to enhance the stability of the diagnosis strategy, a threshold current determination method is researched. Three switching faults in the motor drive system are analyzed using simulation to verify the effectiveness of the diag-nostic strategy.

articleTitle: Prediction Error Compensation-based Model Predictive Position Control of Double-sided Linear Switched Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this paper, the model predictive control method based on prediction error compensation is proposed for the double-sided linear switched reluctance motor (DLSRM), to solve the negative effect of an inaccurate prediction model and to improve the precision of position control. Firstly, the structure and the discrete state space model of the DLSRM are given. Then, the position prediction model is established using the discrete state space model and the cost function is defined to develop the model predictive control (MPC) method for the DLSRM. In addition, two kinds of prediction error compensators based on the proportional-integral control method are constructed, where one uses the error between the actual and prediction positions as input, and the other applies the error between the reference and prediction positions as input. The outputs of the error compensation and the MPC comprise the control action of the DLSRM. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed methods is verified via simulation and experiment results.

articleTitle: Cost-Benefit Analysis (CBA) of Medium Voltage DC (MVDC) Systems for Offshore Wind Power Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Medium voltage DC (MVDC) systems have the potential to act as a key enabler for new offshore wind projects and have attracted increased attention, due to the significant advantages of less conversion stage and less power losses in MVDC collector. This paper performs cost benefit analysis (CBA) for OWFs connected with MVDC systems. Detailed configurations of a hypothetical OWFs are presented and the CBA results for the MVDC array topologies is provided and compared to that of conventional high-voltage AC (HVAC) solutions. It is demonstrated that MVDC systems are a promising technology for offshore wind energy transmission in the near future.

articleTitle: The Effect of Magnetic Field and Pressure on the Threshold Power for Entering Helicon Wave Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Helicon wave discharges exhibit high coupling efficiency and can effectively generate high-density, high-ionization plasma. However, the radio frequency power, magnetic field, and pressure conditions for achieving wave coupled modes in helicon plasma are not the same. In this work, we used a right-helical antenna to study the effects of magnetic field and gas pressure on the threshold input power for entering helicon wave mode. The results indicate that within a wider range of magnetic fields (300–900 Gauss) and pressures (0.1-1.6 Pa), the threshold power does not change monotonically with the magnetic field strength, but shows a trend of increase-decrease. While the threshold power decreases with the increased pressure. At higher pressure (>0.8 Pa), the discharge is more likely to enter directly higher-order wave modes.

articleTitle: Study on the Stress Distribution Characteristics of Dry- Type Bushing under Different Loads
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The elongated structure of dry-type bushings makes them susceptible to stress concentration under external loads. In this study, a three-dimensional force field analysis model of the transformer-dry-type bushing system was established to investigate the distribution of the primary stresses in the dry-type bushing. This aims to reveal the weak areas of the bushing under external forces. The results indicate that, under the influence of gravity alone, the maximum stress in the dry-type bushing occurs at the bottom. However, under cantilever loads of 1600 N and heavy loads of 3150 N, the maximum stress concentrates at the contact point between the flange and the epoxy core body. Analyzing the stress weak areas in dry-type bushings provides a research basis for optimizing the design of the bushing structure.

articleTitle: Review on Degradation Behaviors of Silicone Rubber Under Ultraviolet Radiation for Outdoor Insulators
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicone rubber composite insulators are widely used in high-altitude areas. The strong ultraviolet radiation in high-altitude areas can induce the photooxidation reaction of silicone rubber materials, degrade the service characteristics of silicone rubber materials, and seriously threaten the reliability of composite insulators. Many researchers have used various methods such as UV-A, UV-B, UV-C, xenon lamps, etc. to simulate ultraviolet radiation in high-altitude areas and artificially accelerate the aging of silicone rubber materials. Besides, extensive researches on the evolution behavior of the microstructure and macroscopic properties of silicone rubber materials under ultraviolet irradiation have also been conducted. However, gradient damage characteristics caused by UV aging in silicone rubber have not yet been studied. In addition, the used methods in previous reports cannot accurately detect uneven molecular structure information of silicone rubber under UV irradiation. Furthermore, the inherent relationship between the uneven aging state and key performance is still needed to investigated. Therefore, it is necessary to study the multi-scale non-uniformity of silicone rubber materials under UV irradiation and construct its inherent correlation with key performance in future researches, which can provide the theoretical foundation for the reliable operation of composite insulators in high-altitude areas.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis of Shear Strength Parameters on the Safety Coefficient of New Ecological Slope
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper aims to conduct detailed calculations, solving, and analysis on the collaborative slope protection of a new ecological concrete and geogrid, evaluating its feasibility, and proposing corresponding recommendations. Through a thorough investigation of geological conditions, geogrids, soil parameters, and other factors, reliable soil slope design and management suggestions are provided, combining with a specific engineering case. The paper analyzes the sensitivity of shear strength parameters to the safety factor of slopes, validating the feasibility of the collaborative slope protection using the new ecological concrete and geogrid.

articleTitle: Constant Voltage Output Control for Wireless Power Transfer System Based on BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel PID controller for constant voltage output control of wireless power transfer (WPT) system. The proposed PID controller uses Back-Propagation (BP) neural network for parameter tuning in order to adjusted proportion coefficient, integral coefficient and differential coefficient of PID controller dynamically and improve the stability and robustness of constant voltage control system. Firstly, the mathematical model of S-S compensation topology (series capacitance compensation at the transmitter and series capacitance compensation at the receiver) is derived and the structure of constant voltage output control is established. After that, the algorithm of BP neural network is introduced and then, the parameter tuning of PID controller based on BP neural network is proposed. The simulation results show that the proposed PID controller based on BP neural network realizes constant voltage output of WPT system better compared with the traditional PID controller.

articleTitle: General Identification Method of Dominant FRT Parameters of Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of poor accuracy with the default parameters in the simulation of large-scale power systems, based on the analysis of the fault ride-through(FRT) related control principles in the transient model of mainstream wind turbines, this paper proposes a generalized method of identifying the dominant parameters in the low-voltage ride-through(LVRT) process by using the measured fault response characteristic curves of actual wind turbines. Firstly, the ground impedance of the fault-generating device under each test condition is calculated by the equivalent circuit method to establish a standard fault test environment. Then, the relevant control parameters are identified by combining the least-squares method and the LVRT control principle. Afterward, a simulation model of the whole process for low-voltage ride-through in the wind turbine is established in the simulation software, and the results of identification are verified by simulation. The comparison of results with measured curves and subsequent error calculation demonstrates the high simulation accuracy of the identified model and parameters, providing a reliable basis for scheduling operations and simulation analyses of new-type power systems.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Ultrasonic Detection based on Sagnac Interferometer with High Noise Suppression
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Partial discharge detection is very important for the insulation properties evaluation of power equipment. As an ultrasonic detection method, the Sagnac interferometer has received extensive attention due to its many advantages. Because the partial discharge signal is very weak, it is easily affected by external low-frequency noise and the noise of the optical polarization. In order to overcome this problem, a high noise suppression Sagnac interferometer system for ultrasonic detection of partial discharge is proposed. Firstly, it summarizes the advantages and disadvantages in recent years of Sagnac interferometer in measurement of partial discharge, and the Fundamental of Sagnac interferometer and fabrication of the sensor probe. On this basis, the principle of high noise suppression Sagnac interferometer system is described in detail. The Faraday mirror is introduced to form a symmetrical structure to eliminate the noise in the Sagnac sensing system. The results show that the Sagnac sensing system has a good suppression effect on low frequency and polarization noise, in agreement with the theory.

articleTitle: A Mutual Inductance and Load Resistance Extraction Method for SiC-Driven Dynamic Wireless Power Transfer Systems with BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The mutual inductance estimation (MIE) and load resistance estimation (LRE) is a key step in the primary-side control methods for dynamic wireless power transfer (DWPT) systems. However, when the series-series(SS)-compensated DWPT systems are operated at resonant frequency, the varying mutual inductance and load resistance are coupled with each other, which brings challenges to the estimation accuracy. In this paper, an estimation method of mutual inductance and load resistance based on backpropagation neural network (BPNN) for SiC-driven DWPT system is proposed. When the resonant frequency and operating frequency of the secondary side are different, the mutual inductance and load resistance are decoupled. The estimation is implemented by collecting the primary voltage, current and their phase differences. Meanwhile, by changing mutual inductance and load resistance in the operation range, a large number of primary-side information is sampled to form a data set, which is then divided into training and verification data sets. A multiple-layer neural network is trained by BP method. Simulations and experiments are carried out on a DWPT prototype with the rated 100W rated power level. Both simulations and experiments prove that the proposed method can accurately estimate the mutual induction and load resistance, and the maximum relative error is 1.5%.

articleTitle: Low-Computational Model Predictive Control of T-Type Three-Level Inverter with Fixed Switching Frequency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Conventional Model Predictive Control (C-MPC) typically suffers from an unfixed switching frequency and requires significant computational power from the controller, which restricts its widespread industrial application. To overcome this limitation, this paper proposes a low-computational control strategy for achieving a fixed switching frequency in aT-type three-level inverter. In this strategy, the 27 vectors are initially grouped together, and the candidate vector group for optimized rolling is determined by evaluating the position of the reference voltage vector in space. Subsequently, the vectors are categorized into P-type vectors and N-type vectors based on their impact on the capacitance voltage of the DC side. By comparing the magnitude of the capacitance voltage and simultaneously balancing the neutral-point voltage of the DC side, the candidate vectors are further narrowed down. Importantly, the objective function no longer needs to consider neutral-point voltage balancing, thus simplifying the computational process. Lastly, the candidate vectors are evaluated, ranked according to the objective function, and assigned action times. Through simulation and experimentation, it is demonstrated that this approach enables the T -type inverter to achieve high performance while minimizing computational load.

articleTitle: Quantitative analysis method and its impact factor of high temperature vulcanized silicone rubber applied in outdoor insulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicone rubber have been applied as an excellent composite materials in outdoor insulation and play an important role in protecting the core and providing hydrophobicity. In the long-term field operation, it is suffered to the combined effect of natural environment, pollution accumulation and electric field, and thus there will be typical ageing phenomena such as housing erosion, shed tearing and hydrophobicity loss, which were closely related to the recipe of silicone rubber. Silicone rubber is mainly composed of PDMS (polydimethylsiloxane), ATH (Alumina trihydrate), SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>(silicon dioxide) three substances, and the proportion of each component is very important for the overall performance of silicone rubber. Thus it is crucial to quantitatively analyse the components and contents of high temperature vulcanized silicone rubber applied in outdoor insulation, and explain the effect of the impact factors.

articleTitle: A New Modulation Method for High-Frequency Series Resonant DC/DC Converters in Electrified Railway Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of wide-bandgap semiconductors such as GaN and SiC devices, high-frequency series resonant DC/DC converters becoming more and more competitive which have been widely used in various industrial applications such as on-board power system of railway vehicles. The existing commonly-used power regulation methods cannot ensure that the system always works in zero-voltage or zero-current switching state in full operating range, which increases the switching loss of power devices. In this paper, a modified series resonant DC/DC converter together with a fixed-pulse-width and frequency modulation are proposed, where the resonance period is set as the fixed pulse width, then the intermittent time is introduced to achieve zero-current switching of devices. Meanwhile, the output voltage can be regulated by adjusting the switching frequency. The principle and operating stages of the proposed circuit are analyzed, then the device stress as well as optimal parameters design are discussed. Simulation in MATLAB/Simulink is conducted to verify the correctness of the theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of realizing soft switching and output voltage regulation.

articleTitle: An Aggregation Strategy of Flexible Industrial Load Based on K-Means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In response to the “carbon peaking and carbon neutrality” goals, the energy structure in China has undergone a great transformation. Construction of the new power system has begun. The proportion of renewable generation has increased gradually. However, the operation and scheduling of the power system are influenced by the increasing renewable generation. This paper develops a multi-timescale flexible industrial load aggregation response method based on the K-means clustering analysis. First, the K-means method is used to cluster the daily load curves of different industries to obtain the typical electricity consumption behaviors. Second, the visual models of flexible industrial load are established based on the results of clustering analysis. Finally, the optimization model is constructed to generate the aggregation strategy in different timescales. The effectiveness of the developed method is verified via a load aggregator simulation case.

articleTitle: Low Current Ripple Model Predictive Control for Interleaved Parallel Boost with Novel Cost Function
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The interleaved parallel Boost model predictive control is generally used with current phase-shift control, where the inductor currents are phase-shifted by 360°In. This results in a large inductor current ripple. This paper presents a finite control set-model predictive current control with a novel cost function. The PI form of the inductor current error is added to the cost function, which increases the robustness of the control system. The magnitude of the inductor current and the reference current is compared before performing the prediction to reduce the amount of computation. Simulation results demonstrate that the inductor current of the proposed method has a smaller ripple compared to the conventional model prediction. It has good robustness under inductance parameter mismatch.

Author Keywords: Finite control set-model predictive current control(FCS-MPCC)

articleTitle: A control System and Method for Optimizing Hydrogen Production Efficiency based on ·simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: China confronts the dual challenges of transforming its energy structure and pursuing sustainable development. The employment of renewable energy sources for hydrogen production is regarded as a crucial stride towards establishing a sustainable hydrogen economy. Enhancing the efficiency of this process is paramount for the advancement of renewable energy technologies. This paper introduces a hydrogen production efficiency control system and method, utilizing a simulated annealing algorithm, to address the optimization issues encountered in large-scale, intermittent renewable energy hydrogen production systems. Initially, the study analyzes and models the pivotal parameters involved in the hydrogen production process, leading to the derivation of an efficiency optimization objective function and its corresponding constraints. Subsequently, the optimization is carried out using the simulated annealing algorithm to augment hydrogen production efficiency. The efficacy of the proposed control algorithm is validated through simulation in Matlab, where numerical analysis and comparison reveal its superiority in enhancing hydrogen production efficiency over both power sharing and standard simulated annealing algorithms.

articleTitle: Proof-of- Reliability Consensus Mechanism of Blockchain for Remote Operation of Relay Protection
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Remote operation of protective setting value can enhance the adaptability of protection to real-time operating conditions. As centralized solutions, existing models face information security risks. The decentralized nature of blockchain is advantageous for addressing reliability issues in remote operations. This paper treats the control center and protection relay system sub-stations as nodes in blockchain, proposing a Proof-of- Reliability (PoRel) consensus mechanism based on node reliability. The paper first defines sub-station node types and classification criteria, achieving optimal sub-station node grouping based on 0–1 integer programming. Next, it provides a method for evaluating sub-station node reliability and outlines the consensus mechanism process. Finally, using the IEEE 39-bus system as an example, a blockchain system with 27 sub-station nodes is built using Python software, and the proposed consensus mechanism is simulated and verified. The results indicate that the proposed consensus mechanism improves efficiency, achieves decentralization, and helps ensure reliable relay setting remote operations.

articleTitle: Control Strategies for a Load-side Virtual Control Unit Participating in Primary Frequency Regulation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing scale of the new energy connected to the power system, its uncertainty causes a security risk to the frequency stability of the power system. More and more load-side distributed resources are connected to the power system, which becomes a means to alleviate the above problems. In this paper, distributed resources are aggregated into a virtual control unit (VCU) to participate in primary frequency regulation (PFR) of the power system. The operation process of the VCU participating in the PFR of the power system and the optimized responsibility allocation method of distributed resources based on the price orientation are proposed. Based on the above methods, the control plan for distributed resources for each time step is obtained through real-time rolling optimization. It can be seen through the analysis of the case that the proposed operation process and the responsibility allocation method not only can improve the frequency stability of the power system but also maximize the income of the VCU, which ensures the stability of distributed resources participate in the PFR of the power system.

articleTitle: Dual Layer Master-Slave Game Guidance Strategy for Electric Vehicles Considering Wind and Solar Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the traditional time-of-use(TOU) price cannot effectively absorb the redundant power and easily lead to new load peaks, a dual-layer master-slave game charging and discharging guidance method for electric vehicles is proposed. Firstly, a dynamic TOU pricing model considering wind and solar power surplus is introduced to facilitate the integration of renewable energy sources. Secondly, a Dual layer master-slave game-based charging and discharging guidance mechanism for electric vehicles is established by comprehensively considering the interests of the power grid and charging stations, the wind-landscape redundancy and the charging demand of electric vehicles. In the upper-layer game, the power grid acts as the leader, while the charging stations act as the followers, aiming to achieve smooth fluctuations in the power grid load and maximize the integration of renewable energy sources. In the lower-layer game, the charging stations act as the master, while the EV users act as the slave, jointly considering the benefits of both the charging stations and the EV users. The simulation results ultimately confirm that the strategy successfully enhances the utilization of surplus wind and solar power, improves power grid stability, and simultaneously considers the benefits of charging stations and EV users.

Author Keywords: Integration of wind and solar power

articleTitle: S/CLC-S Adaptive Switching WPT System with CC/CV Output Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a rechargeable green energy storage element, lithium-ion batteries are widely used in portable mobile devices due to their high energy utilization efficiency, convenience, and other advantages. However, to extend the battery life, it is necessary to switch between constant current charging and constant voltage charging modes during the charging process. In this paper, wireless power transfer (WPT) is used as the charging method for lithium batteries, and an S/CLC-S compensation structure adaptive precise switching WPT system with CC/CV characteristics is designed. This system can achieve precise adaptive switching of CC and CV charging states based on its own circuit characteristics, eliminating communication modules, greatly simplifying the control process, and exhibiting high transmission characteristics. The charging efficiency can reach 89% - 92.5%. This paper analyzes the ZPA characteristics of the designed topology and limits the resonance conditions; Secondly, the parameter design is optimized, a parameter configuration scheme is proposed, and the feasibility and ZPA characteristics of the system are verified through simulation; Finally, an experimental prototype is built to verify the correctness of the theory and simulation.

articleTitle: A Digital Simulation System For Embedded Devices Based On Configurable Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This article proposes a digital simulation scheme for embedded relay protection devices based on configurable platform technology. The scheme uses the same program as the actual device, ensuring that the simulation results are completely consistent with the actual device operation results. According to this plan, a digital simulation system for relay protection that can simulate the entire station equipment has been developed. The system supports research on protection algorithms and source code level debugging. It also supports interaction between simulation equipment and primary simulation software PSCAD, as well as data exchange with the monitoring background through the 61850 protocol. It provides recording and analysis functions, performs harmonic analysis, vector analysis, and curve operation analysis on device disturbance records, and assists in solving onsite problems. Developing various types of protection devices on this platform will greatly improve development efficiency, shorten development cycle, reduce development costs and investment. At the same time, this system is suitable for offline training and simulation testing of power users at all levels.

articleTitle: Virtual Inertia Estimation for Grid-forming Converter based on Deep Reinforcement Learning Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: A large amount of renewable energy is integrated into the power system through converters, which leads to the reduced system inertia and would deteriorate the frequency stability. Grid forming converters is proposed to deal with the inertia deficiency of converter by mimicking synchronous generator. In this context, estimating and evaluating the converter-based inertia is crucial for power system operators to understand the frequency-regulation potential of converter-integration power grids. However, due to the differences in frequency response characteristics, existing inertia estimation methods applied to synchronous generators are not suitable for virtual inertia based on digital control. To solve this problem, a non-intrusive online inertia estimation method considering frequency response based on deep reinforcement learning method is proposed. Firstly, the theory and delay characteristics of grid forming converters are analyzed. Then, a serial-parallel identification structure is designed within the framework of deep reinforcement learning. The proximal policy optimization method is utilized to establish network considering frequency measurement to estimate inertia parameters. Finally, results in numerical simulation and hardware-in-the-Ioop experiments verify the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Sensoless Control Method for Surface-Mounted Permanent Magnet Servo Motors Over Low-Speed Range in Robotics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel sensorless control strategy for surface-mounted permanent magnet servo motors (PMSMs) in robotic applications. In response to the limitations of saliency-tracking-based methods for low-speed range applications in surface-mounted PMSMs, this paper introduces an innovative sensorless control strategy. Departing from conventional methodologies, the proposed strategy initiates speed estimation through a sliding mode observer and subsequently employs integral operations to calculate the rotor position. This inversion of the traditional sequence of operations aims to address the challenges associated with saliency-tracking-based methods, particularly in scenarios where the entire saliency of the motor is not readily discernible. Simulation results are provided to validate the proposed method. The proposed sensorless control strategy offers a cost-effective solution for estimating rotor positions in surface-mounted PMSMs, addressing the demand for effective movements in modern robotic applications.

articleTitle: Online Inductance Identification Method for Dual Three-phase PMSG of Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this article, an online inductance identification method applied to dual three-phase permanent magnet synchronous generator (DTP-PMSG) is proposed. Based on the proposed method, the self-inductance and mutual inductance can be obtained in real time. Firstly, the physical model of DTP-PMSG is investigated, where the cross-coupling characteristics of the inductance is analyzed. Then, an inductance identification strategy based on the rotation signal injection under a single three-phase winding is proposed. In order to improve the robustness of the proposed method, the composite filter system is designed to achieve the signal processing in the inductance identification. The self-inductance and mutual inductance can be finally obtained based on the extracted high-frequency signal in the dual three-phase windings. For improving the identification accuracy, the inverter nonlinearity effect and the digital delay effect are analyzed and compensated. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by the experimental results.

articleTitle: AC Arc Motion Model of Parallel Gap Based on the Principle of Magnetic Fluid
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The combustion and motion law of AC arc are important factors affecting the design of parallel gap structure. The internal reaction of the AC arc is complex, and most of the existing arc motion models have simplified many physical parameters, and it is difficult to better reflect the characteristics of the AC arc motion. In this paper, based on the principle of magnetic fluid, considering the coupling effect of temperature, air conductivity, atmospheric pressure (such as thermal buoyancy, etc.), a motion simulation model of AC arc on the parallel gap is established. Taking a IOkV overhead line parallel gap as an example, the movement process of its AC arc is simulated, the calculation results reflect the characteristics of “zero rest” during AC arc movement, complicated arc column bending, arc root jumping, and different upper and lower arc root movement speeds, which is consistent with the AC arc motion law obtained from the existing experiments.

articleTitle: Optimization of Lightning Magnetic Field Detector by Attenuating the Electromagnetic Interference
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With increase of the building height, the increased risk of lightning strikes poses a threat by injecting lightning current and generating intense transient magnetic field that can damage electrical and electronic equipment. To measure the magnetic field generated by a lightning which strikes buildings, transient magnetic field detector was designed with a point coil as its sensor. By analyzing and simulating, the reasons for the distortion of the waveform in the coil output signal were identified. Through the optimization of the coil structure, the errors were minimized to make the coil's output signal closely match the real magnetic field signal. The calibration experiment of the magnetic field detector was conducted by using an impulse magnetic field generator. Experimental results indicate that the linear error of the B/U transmission coefficient of the magnetic field detector is less than 0.37%. The waveform of the magnetic field detection aligns well with the theoretical waveform, which verified the detector reliable and suitable for magnetic field measurements during lightning striking buildings.

articleTitle: An Explicit-based Model Predictive Control Strategy with Neural Network Fitting for Power Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Since the output voltage of a power converter is susceptible to fluctuate caused by load variations, an explicit-based model predictive control (EMPC) strategy with neural network fitting is designed in this paper. The control laws in different operating points are generated offline and stored as tables by the EMPC strategy, and fitted by back propagation neural network. The strategy with neural network effectively not only solves the problem that the traditional MPC strategy requires massive storage space and reduces the computational burden., but also responds rapidly and stabilizes the output voltage while the load fluctuates, improving the robustness of power converters. Finally, the above method is applied in an 14SL-boost converter, and the correctness of theoretical analysis and the feasibility of EMPC with neural network is verified by the simulation.

articleTitle: A Measurement Method for Grid Impedance and Wind Farm Impedance under Background Harmonic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The output impedance of wind farm is an important parameter to determine its small-signal stability. In this paper, the influence of background harmonics on impedance measurement at common coupling points of wind farm is analyzed. The results show that amplitude of the background harmonics affect the accuracy of the measurement. Thus, to overcome the influence, an impedance measurement method is proposed by adjusting the injected current amplitude. Then, grid impedance and wind farm impedance are obtained. The simulation results verify the feasibility and performance of the proposed method. It shows that the proposed method can accurately measure the impedance amplitude and impedance angle for the wind farm and grid impedance.
