articleTitle: Research on a Novel Multimodal Wide Voltage Input LLC Resonant Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The LLC resonant converter has the characteristics of high efficiency, high power density and good soft-switching performance, which is widely used in the field of power electronics. The LLC converter is often used to some occasions that require a wide input voltage range. Still, the traditional LLC resonant converter suffers from the defects of a narrow voltage range and a wide frequency modulation range. To address these issues, a new multi-mode wide voltage input LLC resonant converter is proposed in this paper, which has a full-bridge structure on the primary side and a special bridge rectifier structure on the secondary side. A hybrid modulation strategy combining the PFM and the secondary side shift to have three modes about the converter, which are switched by multi-mode to achieve a wide input voltage range of 107V~430V. The converter can achieve ZVS turn-on of the switching tubes on the primary and secondary sides. Meanwhile, ZCS turn-off of the diodes on the secondary side in three modes. Finally, the feasibility of the proposed topology is verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Novel Adaptive Current-Mode One-Cycle Control for Improving High-Voltage-Gain Power Converter Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Adaptive current-mode control is well known as robust load disturbance resistance and one-cycle control is known for its tolerance to input disturbance. Combining these strategies' advantages, a novel control method is proposed, named adaptive current-mode one-cycle control. It aims to overcome the control lag and maintain the compact controller design of the high-voltage-gain non-minimum phase converter whose are easily affected by external factors such as the external environment and internal parameter changes, resulting in decreased system response speed, and control system performance. As a typical study, the proposed adaptive current-mode one-cycle control is applied to an IS4L-Boost converter. The system analysis is given under input disturbances, load complexity, and unpredictability. Also, the simulation result is provided to show the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: A Topology Identification Method for Low Voltage Station Area Based on Mixed Integer Programming and Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Low voltage station topology identification is a key link in achieving transparency in the distribution network. In this paper, a topology identification method for low voltage station areas based on mixed integer programming and data mining is proposed. Firstly, principal component analysis and Z-score are used to realize data preprocessing. Secondly, the CCVP (Correlation coefficient of voltage profiles) value between each user and the master wire of the low voltage station area is calculated to preliminarily judge the household transformer relationship. Finally, the mixed integer programming method based on energy conservation is used to identify and make accurate topology. Simulation examples demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed identification method.

articleTitle: A Gate-Oxide Degradation Monitoring Method of SiC MOSFETs Based on Threshold Voltage Hysteresis
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicon carbide metal-oxide-semiconductor-field-effect transistors (SiC MOSFETs) have excellent performance under high-temperature and high-power conditions. Gate-oxide degradation has long been one of the key reliability concerns of SiC MOSFETs. In this article, a new parameter that combines the on/off drain current change rate dins/dt is proposed for gate-oxide degradation monitoring to reduce temperature interference. It is based on the finding that the threshold voltage hysteresis of SiC MOSFETs changes significantly over gate-oxide degradation. The superiority of this method is validated by the double pulse test results.

articleTitle: A Novel Current Balance Method Based on LADRC for Multilevel Paralleled Current Source Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The current source inverter, as a highly promising technology, holds broad application prospects in the field of high-power transmission. Parallel operation can significantly increase output and effectively reduce system costs. However, this introduces challenges such as circulating current issues and excessive switch stresses due to current imbalance. To address the above challenges, this paper proposes a current control strategy based on Linear Active Disturbance Rejection Control (LADRC). This strategy, by improving the switching sequence, not only successfully resolves circulating current issues but also exhibits excellent dynamic performance, ensuring the reliable operation of parallel inverters. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is validated through simulation.

Author Keywords: paralleled current Source Inverter;dc current balance;LADRC;SVPWM

articleTitle: Research on Lyapunov Energy Function Based Virtual Impedance Parameter Tuning Method for Grid-Forming Energy Storage Under Single Loop Voltage Magnitude Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In the background of high-proportion new energy source applications, the centralized grid-forming energy storage power station has the ability to actively provide inertia and damping characteristics, thus can realize the active support of the system frequency and voltage. Compared with the traditional voltage and current dual-loop control, the single loop voltage magnitude control has stronger transient support ability, but it has more serious overcurrent problem. In this paper, the control is optimized by superimposing the virtual impedance control on the initial single loop voltage magnitude control, and the virtual impedance parameters are tuned using Lyapunov energy function method. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of the single loop voltage magnitude control with the virtual impedance method, and the correctness of the virtual impedance parameter setting method.

articleTitle: Effect of Thermal Cycling on the Dielectric Properties of Epoxy Resin
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper adopts a linear temperature change method to subject epoxy resin to thermal cycling within a temperature range of -40 °C to 70°C at different rates of temperature change (1 °C/min and 10 °C/min), exploring the effects of thermal cycling duration and rate of temperature change on the glass transition temperature and dielectric properties of the epoxy resin. The results indicate that with an increase in cycling duration, both the dielectric constant and dielectric loss of the epoxy resin first decrease and then increase. Moreover, under a temperature change rate of 10 °C/min, this trend shows a smaller decrease in the early stages of cycling and a more significant increase in the later stages. Analysis reveals that thermal cycling promotes dynamic adjustment of internal chain segments in the epoxy resin, resulting in a denser structure and enhanced binding capacity to polar groups, which increases the glass transition temperature and improves the dielectric properties of the epoxy resin in the early stages. However, as the number of cycles increases, molecular chains break under the long-term effects of thermal expansion and contraction, gradually deteriorating the dielectric properties. Furthermore, a faster rate of temperature change prevents the internal chain segments of the epoxy resin from adjusting sufficiently, and the increased stress impact makes the epoxy resin more prone to degradation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Grid Parameters on the Distribution of Metro Stray Currents in Power Grids
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of urban rail transit, the hazards posed by stray currents from subway networks cannot be overlooked. Among these, the ground transformers at large substations near subway routes are the main channels for stray currents to infiltrate the power system. Investigating the effects of transformer parameter changes on the infiltration of stray currents into the power system has significant implications. This paper establishes a DC current coupling simulation model between subway lines and the power system. By simulating and analyzing the infiltration of stray currents into the transformers adjacent to the lines during the operation periods of subway trains, we alter the main parameters of different main transformers at the same substation to identify the main factors affecting the amount of stray current in the infiltrating ground transformers' neutral points.

articleTitle: Analysis And Design of LCLC-LC Compensated ECPT System with Load Adaptive Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The application of electric field coupling wireless power transmission technology in unmanned aerial vehicles(UAVs) can effectively improve the endurance capability and work efficiency of UAVs. However, frequently taking off and landing of UAVs will cause the entire power receiver of the wireless charging system to move in/out, resulting in system detuning, device voltage and current spikes, high no-load power and other problems. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes an analysis and design of LCLC-LC compensation ECPT system with load adaptive characteristics. This paper establishes the mathematical model of the LCLC-LC compensation ECPT system, and derives the constant voltage output parameter conditions when the power receiver is moved in based on the topological output characteristics. The system can achieve zero phase angle (ZPA) under different load resistance conditions. It also analyzes the low power state after the power receiver is removed. Based on this, the system parameter design method is given. Finally, the output characteristics of the system and the effectiveness of the system design were verified through simulation.

articleTitle: An Inductive Power Transfer System for Lunar Rovers
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the inductive power transfer technology (IPT), near-field wireless energy transmission technology has a huge application prospect in the space field, which can provide a powerful solution for the safe and efficient interconnection of space energy. In this paper, an inductive power transfer system for lunar rovers is proposed, and the equivalent AC impedance model of LCC/S topology is established. To solve the problem of excessively large magnetic flux leakage of loosely coupling transformer (LCT), magnetic coupler with vertical and horizontal shielding is designed based on the method of finite element analysis (FEA). A 280- W prototype is built for experiments. The maximum transmission efficiency of the prototype is 92.5%, and the minimum transmission efficiency is 91 %. The FEA simulation and experimental results verify the feasibility of the magnetic shielding structure design method. The results show that the proposed magnetic shielding structure increases the strength of magnetic field, effectively reduces the eddy current loss caused by magnetic field leakage.

articleTitle: Effect and Inversion of Phase Spacing on Current Characteristics of High Voltage Cables
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This study delves into the profound impact of high-voltage cable segment length on current characteristics, proposing an inversion method for determining cable segment length. Through experimental simulation, it's observed that the current distribution and transmission performance of the cable are significantly influenced by varying section lengths. Furthermore, machine learning techniques are employed to invert cable segment length and assess its reasonability based on current characteristics, offering practical insights for cable design and optimization. The research outcomes enhance comprehension of power system engineering, aiding in the formulation of more scientific cable layout and maintenance strategies. They also furnish crucial technical support for the sustainable advancement of power engineering.

articleTitle: Value Assessment for Source-Load-Storage Flexibility Resources Based on the Suitability Class VIKOR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper proposes the VIKOR assessment model of source-load-storage flexibility resource suitability rating which aims at the characteristics of flexibility resources. Firstly, flexibility resource evaluation index system is proposed, including suitability class assessment index and class threshold, which can realize entropy weight determination of assessment index. Second, the VIKOR assessment model of flexibility resource suitability level and the binary semantic level assessment method are proposed, which can take into account the group utility and individual regret.. Finally, through case studies and relative analyses, the rationality and practicability of the assessment methodology proposed in this paper are illustrated.

articleTitle: Analysis and Modeling of Oil Impregnated Paper Bushing Explosion Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Oil impregnated paper bushing is one of the most widely used transformer bushings, due to the internal oil-filled, there is a certain possibility of explosion, and in recent years its explosion faults have brought great challenges to the safe operation of the transmission network. Therefore, there is a need to research the bushing explosion mechanism, so as to reduce the explosion faults in fault development process. By collecting incident data and field conditions of bushing accidents of the same voltage level, analyse the common and different points of their faults, so as to carry out modelling and analysis of the bushing explosion. According to the disassembled morphology of the bushing and fault characteristics, get the simulation of the bushing electric field distribution. The temperature and pressure changes in the shrinkage bushing under the action of arc discharge have been investigated. On this basis, the methods of monitoring and early warning for bushing explosion faults are proposed.

articleTitle: An Integrated Magnetically Isolated Gate Driver Architecture for SiC MOSFET Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Applications of SiC MOSFETs as wide-bandwidth devices contains transient processes in which high-speed voltage and current fluctuations during the switching. Accordingly, the implementation of stable isolation architecture is required to ensure electrical security on the primary and stable power driving on the secondary in gate driver circuits. However, the isolation pathways are usually inconsistent, resulting in separate mechanisms for signal and power which adds to the design complexity. An integrated pulse-transformer-based gate driver is proposed in this paper, which uses only one magnetic isolation mechanism to achieve both signal and power isolation. The edge signals are converted into characteristic pulses for injection into a very high frequency isolated power supply, and a simplified signal feature extraction circuit is implemented in the secondary. The solution provides reliable simultaneous transmission with signal propagation delays on the order of the duty cycle time of the power supply. Experimental prototype is constructed on a printed circuit board with a coreless transformer to realize the low isolation capacitance, high isolation voltage, lightweight and low-cost. The proposed integrated dual-isolated gate driver (DIGD) is expected to realize the compact design of distributed isolation for SiC MOSFET applications.

articleTitle: Differential Analysis of Electronic Structural Parameters Between Mineral and Synthetic Ester Insulating Oils
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Insulating oil is a crucial dielectric fluid widely employed in oil-immersed transformers. Synthetic ester oil (SEO), characterized by its balanced performance, renewability, and biodegradability, is gradually replacing traditional mineral oil (MO). However, SEO is prone to rapid streamer discharge under lightning impulse voltage, leading to a breakdown voltage lower than that of MO. To comprehend this phenomenon, density functional theory and time-dependent density functional theory are employed to calculate and summarize the electronic structural parameter variations and correlations with macroscopic discharge behaviors of SEO and MO molecular under different electric fields. The results indicate that the inherent and induced dipole moments of SEO are greater than those of MO, making it more prone to forming space electric field. The energy gaps of MO and SEO consistently remain above 10 eV and 8 eV, respectively, suggesting their ability to maintain high resistivity under intense electric fields. The faster decrease in ionization potential of SEO triggers electron impact ionization, and the consistently negative electron affinity indicates that SEO is less prone to forming negative ions. The excitation energy of SEO is slightly smaller than that of MO, and both could maintain relatively stable excitation energy under intense electric fields, making them less susceptible to photoionization.

articleTitle: Construction Method of Typical Output Scenarios of New Energy Sources Considering Complementary Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the large-scale access of new energy in the grid, the complexity of new energy output scenario increases rapidly. In view of the uncertainty of wind power output, this paper first evaluates the complementary characteristics of new energy output. Secondly, the output curve which takes into account the uncertainty of new energy output and can be fitted with the actual historical output scene is described. Then, the joint distribution function of multiple new energy output random variables is connected with the edge distribution function, and the new energy output scenario considering the interaction or complementary relationship is generated, and the data dimension is reduced. Finally, based on the data of Haixi New energy Base in Qinghai Province, the method proposed in this paper is verified.

Author Keywords: Wind and photovoltaic complement each other

articleTitle: A Current Equalization Compensation Method for CLLLC Resonant Converter with Multiple Transformers in Parallel
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Aiming at the high-power scenario of CLLLC converter, the topological structure of multiple parallel transformers is analyzed first, and it is pointed out that there must be parameter differences among different transformers due to machining errors or material errors. Then, the effect of parameter difference on the current unbalance of multiple transformers is analyzed. Even a small parameter difference will lead to a large current unbalance. Then, an improved multi-transformer parallel compensation scheme is proposed, and the current sharing characteristics of the scheme are analyzed. The current sharing between the multi-transformers is realized without changing the characteristics of the converter resonator and the system cost and volume. Finally, a 10kW experimental platform with 3 transformers in parallel is set up to verify the effectiveness of the proposed multi-transformer in parallel compensation scheme.

articleTitle: High-Precision and High-Resolution DC Standard Source Design Based on Multi-Channel PWM Method
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-precision DC voltage standard sources can be used for calibrating measuring instruments., and generating high-precision signals in various high-tech fields. The main challenge of the standard sources lies meeting the high requirement for precision and resolution, which has become the focus of research in this field. In this paper, methods to improve accuracy and the resolution of the DC standard source are studied, and a programmable high-precision and high-resolution DC voltage standard source is proposed. By employing the automatic calibration algorithm and negative feedback circuit proposed in the paper, a high precision DC voltage output of 12 ppm is achieved. A coordinated modulation scheme is presented, utilizing multi-channel PWM signals with varying amplitudes, to enable voltage amplitude adjustment and improve the resolution of the output voltage to be higher than <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.05\mu \mathrm{V}$</tex> ‘, The proposed standard source has been successfully applied to the self-developed standard source prototype.

articleTitle: Investigation of Active Disturbance Rejection Control of Battery Energy Storage Converter
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The battery storage converter is the connection equipment between power generation system and power grid. The performance of this component is pivotal to the overall operation of the entire power grid. To control the current of the network side more accurately, the abc/dq transformation is used to convert the three-phase stationary coordinate system to two-phase rotating coordinate system, and an active dampening technique is suggested to address the LCL filter's intrinsic resonance issue. In this paper, an enhanced active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) approach, utilizing the linear extended state observer (LESO), is suggested as a solution to this issue of abundant calculation and slow dynamic observation response in conventional nonlinear ADRC. This method regards the disturbance as a whole and uses LESO for observation and compensation, which enhances the system's resistance to interference while also making control easier. The effectiveness and feasibility of the proposed strategy are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: A Mechanical-Modulated-Flux HIA with Permanent-Magnet-Iron Modulator Used for Flywheel Energy Storage System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As a new type of energy storage motor, the mechanically-modulation-flux energy storage homopolar inductor alternator (HIA) has the advantage of high reliability and low idle loss and can be applied to energy storage systems in power systems. At present, the existing mechanically-modulation-flux energy storage HIA have gaps between the modulation ring and the motor housing, and the magnetic electromotive force of the main magnetic circuit of the motor cannot be completely short circuited by the modulation ring. Therefore, under idle operating conditions, the magnetic flux density of the main air gap cannot be reduced to zero when the motor is unloaded, and there is still no-load iron loss in the motor, which limits the further improvement of the energy storage system efficiency. This paper proposes a magnetic modulation ring structure with permanent magnets and optimization method for an energy-storage HIA. By optimizing the size of the modulation ring and selecting the optimal outer diameter of the modulation ring, theoretically, the main air gap magnetic density of the motor can be reduced to zero. Therefore, the no-load loss of the motor under idle conditions is almost zero, which can greatly improve the efficiency of energy storage systems based on HIA and is very suitable for application in power system energy storage. This article analyzes the optimization design method for the size of the modulation ring. Finally, the excellent magnetic field regulation performance of the motor was verified through finite element simulation.

articleTitle: Centralized -local voltage control of low-voltage distribution network based on photovoltaic -storage combined power generation unit
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of voltage exceeding limits when high permeability photovoltaic is connected to low-voltage distribution networks, this paper proposes a centralized-local control strategy based on photovoltaic-storage combined power generation unit. In the centralized control stage, the objective function is to minimize grid loss and photovoltaic active power reduction, and the output of the photovoltaic-storage combined power generation unit is used as a decision variable to achieve global optimization. In the local control stage, an improved droop control is adopted to ensure that voltage violations can still be mitigated even when the photovoltaic and load power deviate from the predicted data. Finally, a 21-node low-voltage distribution network is used for simulation, and the results show that the proposed control strategy can effectively solve the problem of voltage exceeding limits and ensure the economic operation of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of a Radial-Flux Machine with Hybrid-Irregular Pole Pattern for High Power Density
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Spoke-type PM machines have strong flux-focusing effect and hence high average torque, however, they generally suffer from high torque ripple because of the abundant high-order magnetic harmonics of the electric machines. In this paper, a hybrid-irregular pole pattern consisting of quasi-spoke-type magnets and surface-mounted magnets is proposed for high-speed machine to reduce torque ripple while maintaining high average torque, simultaneously. The quasi-spoke-type magnets and the surface-mounted PMs with muti-direction magnetization helps to improve average torque greatly. Besides, the surface-mounted magnets with parallel magnetization are conducive to reduce high-order air-gap magnetic harmonics and hence achieving smooth torque output. Firstly, the schematic structure of the high-speed PM machine with hybrid-irregular pole pattern, and its working principle are presented. Secondly, the output performance variation with respect to the major structural parameters of the hybrid pole pattern machine is investigated. Besides, one high-speed electric machine with hybrid pole pattern is deigned. Thirdly, to confirm the merits of the hybrid-irregular pole pattern machine, its electromagnetic characteristics, such as no-load air-gap flux density, back EMF and torque profile are compared with conventional spoke-type PM machine. Finally, a useful conclusion is concluded.

articleTitle: Analysis of 3-Phase Short-Circuit and Demagnetization Characteristics in Direct-Drive SPM Wind Power Generators Considering Rotor Eddy Currents
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In direct-drive surface-mounted permanent magnet synchronous generators (DD-SPMSGs), the rotor eddy current effect usually cannot be neglected due to solid rotor back iron. This paper first investigates the influence of rotor eddy currents on three-phase short-circuit (3PSC) peak currents and irreversible demagnetization. It is found that rotor eddy currents result in an increase in 3PSC phase peak currents. However, the shielding effect of rotor eddy current mitigates the demagnetization. In addition, the rotor core eddy currents contribute more to diminishing demagnetization compared to permanent magnets (PMs). Secondly, this paper analyzes post-demagnetization eddy current losses under 3PSC. It shows although the demagnetization distribution is uneven, the harmonic content of airgap flux density does not change. Furthermore, since the amplitudes of main harmonics decrease after demagnetization, the eddy current losses are reduced. In addition, as the overall demagnetization level increases, the alleviation of demagnetization due to rotor eddy current and the reduction of eddy current loss due to demagnetization become more obvious.

articleTitle: Molecular simulation of the effect and mechanism of BN doping on local morphology and water molecules diffusion in insulating oil
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The addition of boron nitride (BN) nanoparticles to electrical materials has been proven to be an effective way to enhancing the thermal dissipation performance. In addition to the impact of elevated temperatures on the transformer's operational conditions, the presence of water molecules stands out as the primary contributor to insulation degradation. Nevertheless, the microscopic mechanism of the effect of BN doping in transformer insulating oils on their local morphology and the diffusion of water molecules within them remains largely unknown, especially at the molecular level. In order to understand this fundamental aspect, a molecular interface model of Oil/BN/Oil composites was developed, and molecular dynamics was used to explore the intrinsic mechanism at the microscopic level. We found that the local density of the insulating oil fluctuates as the interaction between the microwater-containing insulating oil and the BN, and the fluctuation was more intense the closer to the BN. Further analyses showed that this phenomenon is related to the BN surface condition as well as water molecules. The interaction energy between the surface-aminated BN crystals and the water-containing insulating oil was the largest, mainly due to the effects of van der Waals and hydrogen bonding. Notably, at the aminated BN interface, there were more hydrogen bonds with shorter bond lengths and stronger hydrogen bonding, which can effectively restrict the thermal movement of water molecules. This study provides theoretical support for doping nano-BN in transformer insulating oil.

articleTitle: Research on Spectral Response Characteristics of Grounding Network and Monitoring Method of Soil Resistivity
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: As China's economy enters a high-quality development stage, the electric power industry has also entered a new stage of development, the National Energy Administration released 2022 national electric power industry statistics pointed out that as of the end of December, the country's cumulative installed capacity of power generation is about 2.56 billion kilowatts, an increase of 7.8% year-on-year. At the same time as the high-quality development of energy and power in the new era, the construction of a new type of power system, accelerate the planning and construction of a new type of energy system has become the overall framework and key tasks for the development of today's power system. In the transmission and use of electricity, the safety and reliability of power supply must be guaranteed. The grounding system can prevent people from being electrocuted, prevent equipment and lines from being damaged, prevent fires and lightning strikes, prevent electrostatic damage, and is an important power facility to safeguard the normal operation of the power system and the safety of staff. In the grounding network design, soil parameters are the influencing factors to be considered. Uniform soil environment belongs to the more ideal soil environment, most areas of the soil composition is more complex, with the season, temperature and rainfall changes, will affect the grounding network in the soil environment parameters change. Through the establishment of a horizontal two-layer soil model, reflecting the changes in the environment where the grounding network is located, the changes in the resistivity of the surface layer of the soil on the impedance characteristics of the grounding network of the influence of the law, as well as for the speculation of the soil resistivity to provide a new way of thinking. It is found that the change of soil resistivity in the upper layer has a greater influence on the spectral response characteristics. The ratio of the upper and lower soil resistivity hardly affects the spectral response of the grounding electrode at low frequencies, and with the gradual increase in frequency, the response will increase with the increase in the ratio of the upper and lower soil resistivity.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimization of Reactive Power for Grid-Connected Photovoltaic Power Plants Based on Improved Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: With the increasing awareness of social environment and energy, the development of distributed photovoltaics are receiving more and more attention. To solve the voltage limit violation caused by photovoltaic access system, a optimization model of reactive power compensation location based on improved bee colony algorithm is proposed. Aiming at the weak local search mechanism of artificial bee colony algorithm, chaotic mapping and cross algorithm are introduced to improve the operation speed and ensure the balanced distribution of solution set. Finally, a photovoltaic power station in Shandong Province is taken as the research object, and the feasibility and effectiveness of the method are verified.

articleTitle: Improved sliding mode synchronous tracking control of dual linear motor based on manipulation efficiency learning
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to improve the microgravity level of the 4-second electromagnetic launch micro-gravity experimental device, in this paper, based on the vector control system of a dual linear induction motor, a new dual controller separation, and complementary control strategy are proposed to improve the synchronous performance of the dual motor. At the same time, an improved sliding mode controller (MEL-SMC) based on manipulation efficiency learning is designed to compensate for the error of position tracking in the inner capsule. Finally, the algorithm is written into the controller of the 4-second electromagnetic launch micro-gravity experimental device, which verifies the effectiveness of the control strategy and provides a high-precision microgravity environment.

articleTitle: An Optimized VSG Dynamic Response Control Strategy Based On Angular Frequency Feedforward
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Damping control and inertia control play an important role in the Virtual Synchronous Generator (VSG) control, but with the development of distributed generation, the basic damping control and inertia control have been difficult to meet the requirements of grid to provide inertia support and frequency regulation functions for grid-forming inverters. In addition, the coupling of frequency regulation coefficient and damping coefficient makes it difficult for VSG to meet the target of frequency regulation and oscillation suppression at the same time. The goal of suppressing overshoot is opposed to the goal of improving power response speed. To solve these contradictions, a VSG control based on Angular Frequency Feedforward (AFF) is proposed in this paper. AFF - VSG control not only realizes the decoupling of droop coefficient and damping coefficient, but also significantly improves the power response speed of VSG, achieving fast power response and slow frequency response. In this paper, the Conventional VSG (Con-VSG) and AFF-VSG are deduced and compared in the grid-connected mode, and the simulation verifies the effectiveness and superiority of AFF-VSG.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Algorithm for Boundary Scan Interconnection Test Vector
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Boundary scan technology is a testing technology for large-scale integrated circuits. This is a new type of embedded testing technology that get the status and reads data of chip pins. This technology solves the problem of difficult access to circuit physical nodes. This paper proposes an optimized algorithm of model boundary scan interconnect testing. Through theoretical research on the boundary scan interconnect testing method for electronic chips, a detailed interconnect testing method is proposed. Ultimately this method obtains comprehensive automatic testing results. The boundary scan interconnect testing method has high testing efficiency, strong practicality, and good application value.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Adaptive Controller Design with Position Robustness in a GaN-based Wireless Power Transfer System
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper develops an artificial-intelligence (AI)-assisted design approach for adaptive proportional-integral (PI) controllers to optimize control performance of wide band gap (WBG)-based wireless power transfer (WPT) systems. Traditional PI controllers in WPT systems are designed for static operating conditions, struggling with the dynamic nature of varying air gap distances and operating conditions. Our proposed methodology overcomes these challenges by leveraging machine learning and meta-heuristic algorithms, achieving robustness towards varying coil positions and operating conditions. The effectiveness of the adaptive PI controller has been validated through simulation experiments and has demonstrated great improvements over conventional fixed PI controllers.

articleTitle: Feasibility Study of High Temperature Superconducting Machines for Electric Aircraft
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The rapid advancements in the aviation transport sector require stringent benchmarks for emissions, noise, and fuel efficiency in commercial aircraft, thereby escalating the significance of electric propulsion aircraft technologies. High temperature superconducting (HTS) synchronous machines, standing out for their high power density and efficiency, are key enablers for the practical and commercial application of electric propulsion aircraft. This paper introduces the design of a 20 MW-class HTS synchronous generator and analyzes its feasibility for electric propulsion aircraft from an electromagnetic perspective. The design process undergoes multi-objective optimization, aiming for minimal active mass and maximal efficiency to achieve an optimal power density. The rotor of this generator employs REBCO HTS-tapes in the field winding, operating at 20 K with liquid hydrogen (LH2) cooling. The stator consists of nonmagnetic teeth and Litz wire armature winding. The generator's power density and efficiency are calculated considering armature windings made of copper and high purity aluminum, respectively. Different cooling mediums, such as direct water and LH2, are also discussed. The results show that using high purity aluminum armature winding with LH2 cooling can greatly improve power density and efficiency.

articleTitle: Coordinated Frequency Regulation Strategy of Photovoltaic and Energy Storage System Based on Adaptive Power Tracking Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Large-scale photovoltaic (PV) units connected to the grid will cause power system inertia decline and insufficient frequency regulation ability. The current frequency regulation method of active power reserve of PV system will generate a large amount of abandoned solar energy and affect generation benefit. Furthermore, the frequency regulation strategy of only replying on the energy storage system will increase the cost of investment. Thus, to improve the frequency stability of power system and reduce the investment cost, this paper proposes a novel coordinated frequency regulation strategy based on adaptive power tracking (APT) control to achieve the PV and energy storage system cooperatively provide frequency regulation. In this strategy, the PV system adopts sliding mode control (SMC)-based APT and the energy storage system adopts fuzzy virtual synchronous generator (VSG)-based APT, which not require the power estimator, and detailed PV and energy storage models. The proposed strategy has better performance compared the traditional method through the simulation.

articleTitle: Study on the Pollution Level of Silicone Rubber Composite Insulators Based on BPNN
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Pollution is one of the key factors leading to flashovers in power transmission lines, and accurately detecting the degree of pollution is crucial for assessing the insulation state of insulators. To this end, this paper utilizes hyperspectral imaging technology, collecting hyperspectral data from the surface of insulators and improving data quality through preprocessing methods such as black and white calibration, and standard normal variate transformation. Subsequently, the hyperspectral data are dimensionally reduced using the successive projection algorithm (SPA), and the insulator surface pollution levels are categorized with the backpropagation neural network (BPNN) algorithm. Experimental results show that the SPA-BPNN model, after feature extraction, achieves an overall accuracy of 95.56% in classifying the pollution levels of insulators, which is superior to the all band-BPNN model without feature extraction. This research not only enhances the accuracy of pollution level classification but also provides a scientific basis for the reliability of grid equipment and the reliability of grid operations.

articleTitle: A Semi-Physical Model of SiC MOSFETs for Improved Static Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Silicon Carbide (SiC) MOSFETs have been widely applied in power converters due to its superior properties. Accurate simulation of SiC MOSFET is essential to its application. This paper presents a semi-physical model of SiC MOSFET, which has an excellent performance at static characteristic. The proposed model is based on the description of physical phenomena include the influence of SiC/SiO2 traps and the saturate process of channel voltage. The model is validated on a 1.2kV-19A SiC MOSFET, and application of the model at different temperature is discussed.

articleTitle: Numerical Simulation on Suppression of Space Charge Accumulation by Deep Trap Coating at Electrode-Polymer Interface
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Space charge accumulation under DC electric field leads to accelerated aging of insulation, and nano-doping can effectively suppress space charge accumulation, but it is difficult to achieve uniform doping of nano-fillers in engineering. In this paper, a bipolar space charge transport model considering the interfacial layer is developed to investigate the effect of interfacial coating and its trap parameters on space charge. The results show that the construction of deep trap coating on the polymer surface can effectively suppress space charge accumulation, and the increase of coating capture coefficient, trap density and trap depth is beneficial to the coating to capture more charge, suppress charge migration into the polymer and reduce the degree of electric field distortion.

articleTitle: Analysis and Prediction of Power Load Patterns based on XGBoost
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Load forecasting is an important part of power system, which is conducive to the smooth and efficient operation of power grid. This paper uses an ensemble learning method, eXtreme Gradient Boosting(XGBoost), and combines the time features in historical data and the lag features in time series data to predict the load of power system in the long term. The time features are selected as year, quarter, month, date, week, hour, etc., while the selection of lag features relies on the results of the seasonal decomposition of load data. These features fully excavates the regular characteristics of time series data.

articleTitle: Research on Sliding Mode Observer of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Based on PI Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: This paper investigates the design and application of a sliding mode observer (SMO) in the control strategy of a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor (PMSM) without a position sensor. PMSM is widely used in industrial and transportation sectors due to its high efficiency and performance. However, accurate state estimation has always been a challenge due to its nonlinearity and parameter uncertainties. To address this issue, this paper proposes a state estimation method based on a sliding mode observer. The sliding mode observer achieves state estimation by introducing a sliding surface that can resist the influence of external disturbances and parameter variations, thereby exhibiting strong robustness. Based on the voltage equation of the PMSM, an improved sliding mode observer is designed to estimate the rotor position and velocity of the PMSM. The improved sliding mode Research on sliding mode observer of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on PI regulatorobserver effectively mitigates the chattering problem of the sliding mode observer by improving the switching function, enabling estimation of the back electromotive force without the use of filters, and significantly enhancing the accuracy of rotor velocity and position estimation.

articleTitle: A Novel High-Frequency Inverter with ZVS in Wide Load Range
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In applications such as plasma generation and wireless power transfer, high-frequency inverter capable of operating across broad power levels and load impedance is essential. This paper introduces a full-bridge inverter characterized by favorable soft-switching characteristic, which maintains a consistent power output over an extensive range of load and power levels. To facilitate Zero-Voltage Switching (ZVS) and enhance adaptability to a wide load range, dynamic frequency modulation has been implemented. A prototype with 60 V input and 60 W output, functioning at a central frequency of 10 MHz, has been developed and tested in the laboratory. The experimental results substantiate the viability of the proposed inverter design.

articleTitle: An Optimal Frequency Control Strategy for Wireless Power Transfer System to Achieve Maximum Energy Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: For wireless power transfer (WPT) systems, maximizing efficiency across a wide load range and coupling conditions is a critical challenge. This paper introduces a novel optimal frequency control strategy designed to enhance the efficiency of WPT systems. The proposed method focuses on achieving both resistive and reactive equivalent load matching with the optimal operating frequency. To demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposal, a 48W WPT system is built in Simulink, and the performance of the proposed control method is evaluated with a load variation from 20% to 100% and a coupling factor variation from 0.1 to 0.3. Comparative analysis with the state-of-the-art control method shows significant efficiency improvements across a wide range of operating conditions.

articleTitle: Simulation of Transformer Magnetic Shield Plate Loss Under Harmonics and DC Bias
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In order to study the stray losses of power transformer magnetic shielding plates under harmonics and DC bias magnetism, improved finite element modeling of the TEAM P21 reference family (V.2009) was carried out. Based on the statistical theory of Jiles-Atherton (J-A) hysteresis and Bertotti loss, the magnetic characteristics of monolithic anisotropic silicon steel sheet under the complex working conditions of harmonic and DC bias were analyzed. The harmonic flux density waveform was decomposed into the major magnetic flux and local reversal magnetic flux and the sinusoidal approximation was performed. The calculation model of magnetic loss under harmonic excitation is established, and the transient calculation of stray field and loss under complex excitation was completed. The laminated magnetic shielding plate of 800kV single-phase four-column UHV converter transformer was simulated and calculated, and the distribution and influence of stray loss under harmonic and DC bias magnetism were analyzed, which proved the correctness of the magnetic loss model and provided a reliable basis for the optimal design of transformer magnetic shielding.

articleTitle: Topology and Control of Intermediate Frequency Isolated Offshore Wind Power Centralized Hydrogen Production Equipment Based on M3C
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Hydrogen production from offshore wind power is an effective means to solve the problems of large-scale grid integration and consumption of offshore wind power and the high cost of deep-sea power transmission. Germany, the Netherlands, Denmark and other European countries have already planned for hydrogen production from offshore wind power with more than one million kilowatts. In this paper, a centralized hydrogen production equipment for intermediate frequency isolated offshore wind power based on modular multilevel matrix converter (M3C) is proposed to improve the absorption capacity of offshore wind power and the production and utilization of hydrogen. The equipment system adopts M3C converter in the front stage, which can realize the execution of offshore wind power, and give full play to the frequency conversion function of the converter, and the intermediate frequency isolation transformer is used in the 35kV equipment system to avoid the difficult problem of high-frequency transformer insulation design, and the hybrid rectifier is used in the rear stage, and the active filter is added to harmonic control the thyristor rectification. This paper completes the detailed theoretical analysis, and uses Matlab/Simulink simulation software to complete the simulation verification.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Films Combining Hydrophobicity and Multiband Stealth Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Photonic crystal material with low infrared emissivity has potential applications in the field of stealth. In order to improve its performance in the salt-spray environment, the fluorocarbon-photonic crystal film is designed through the magnetron sputtering technology. According to the simulation and experiment results, it indicates that when the thickness of the functional layer is 150 nm, it has little effect on the infrared emissivity of the photonic crystal, and the infrared emissivity of the composites increases only by 0.022 and 0.007. In the 3–5 μm and 8–14 μm bands, the infrared emissivity of the composites increases by 0.228 and 0.172, respectively, when the thickness of the hydrophobically modified film is increased to 1,000 nm. Furthermore, the use of the fluorocarbon film enhances the hydrophobicity of the photonic crystal film by approximately 1.5 times. The composite film exhibits better salt spray resistance after 240 hours of erosion, with minimal changes in IR emissivity and static contact angle, compared to the photonic crystal without the fluorocarbon film. The photonic crystal composite film can be used in high humidity, rainy, and salt spray environments to prevent degradation of stealth film performance.

articleTitle: Study on Removal of Wastewater Treatment Plant Odorous Gases by Biofilter and Pulse Plasma Discharge Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: In this study, the odorous gases of a wastewater treatment plant were treated by biofilter and pulsed plasma discharge technology. The principle and deodorization effect of biofilter and pulsed plasma discharge technology were described. The actual operation results showed that by applying the above two technologies, the average removal rate of ammonia (NH3) was 34.6% and 53.6%, the average removal rate of hydrogen sulfide (H2S) was 97.5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> and 78.2%, and the average removal rate of odor was 49.5% and 79.2%, respectively. The concentration of NH3, H2S and odor at the outlet met the national emission standards, and the deodorization effect was remarkable at the scene, which could effectively solve the problem of odorous gases pollution.

articleTitle: The Influence of Oil-Paper Insulation Aging on Trap and Breakdown Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The degradation of insulating paper is taking place with the increasingly operating time of transformers, which results in a decline in performance, increasing the probability of internal discharge accidents in transformers. Additionally, the distortion of local electric fields caused by the accumulation of charges is one of the reasons for such accidents. Traps within oil-paper insulation capture charges, but the trap characteristics of oil-impregnated paper are influenced by the extent of cellulose aging. Through accelerated thermal aging experiment, oil-paper insulation samples with varying aging degrees were acquired for this study. Using experiments including surface potential decay and alternating current breakdown, the variations in breakdown characteristics and trap qualities of different samples were examined. According to the experimental findings, during the initial phases of aging, the paper's reduced moisture content causes a notable drop in conductivity, a little rise in electrical strength, and an increase in trap energy levels. Oil-impregnated paper exhibits a decreasing trend in its trap energy levels with increasing age, along with a constant increase in conductivity and a decrease in electrical strength.

articleTitle: Partial Discharge Sensing of Fiber Composed Submarine Cable based on $\varphi$ -OTDR
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The partial discharge generated by operation voltage applied on insulation defects is one of the main reasons leading to the failure of HV submarine cables. However, the pulsed current method which is widely adopted by partial discharge cable on the land is unable to obtain high frequency pulsed signal due to attenuation of the long submarine cable. In this paper, a heterodyne interferometric phase-sensitive optical time reflectiont <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varphi$</tex> -OTDR) based method is proposed to detect the partial discharge acoustic disturbance on the composed fiber in the submarine cable. The methodology consists of the signal sampling of the balanced photodetector, orthogonal IQ demodulation, phase threshold expansion, and unwinding. The proposed methodology is verified by the partial discharge experiment by a preset insulation defect in a 110 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{kV}$</tex> single-core submarine cable. The results show that the partial discharge can be distinguished by the phase fission. Besides, the location error is within 10 meters.

articleTitle: A Hardware and Software Combined PTG Fault Traversal Control Strategy of MMC
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Modular Multilevel Converters are well adopted to the needs of future applications in power transmission owing to its modularity and expansibility. DC faults of the MMC can severely disrupt system operation. Demanding fast dynamic control strategy under DC faults., it is significant to propose a strategy which can achieve fault elimination and provide continuous and stable power to the loads at the same time. This paper presents a positive-to-ground (PTG) fault traversal strategy based on hardware and software control. Hardware hysteresis loop control is introduced in order to limit the fault current during the control delay period inherent in the real system. After that., by controlling the MMC bridge arm voltage., the elimination of fault currents and reliable supply of loads on the DC side are realized. Compared with the existing strategies., this strategy has the advantages of fast current-limiting response speed and simple control structure.

articleTitle: The Influence of Wind Speed on Wall Bushing Surface Charge Transition
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The outdoor side of the wall bushing runs in the natural environment for a long time and is blown by different wind speeds in nature. The influence of wind speed on the bushing surface charge is not clear. Based on the measurement of electric field, the surface potential transition of the true type ±100k V bushing under different wind speed conditions are measured. The results show that the transition process of surface potential with time is accelerated with the increase of wind speed. This is because the wind brings more ions from space, make the concentration and mobility of ions in the air higher. In the windward direction, the superposition of the wind and the original electric field makes the ions in the air migrate faster, forming a stronger air current density, resulting in faster charge accumulation on interface between air and sheds. In the measurement of axial surface potential, it is found that the heteropolar charge is mainly concentrated in the middle of the bushing, which causes the change of the measured surface potential trend. Non-uniform charge distribution along the axis will distort the axial electric field distribution of the bushing, which will increase the flashover probability along the surface of the bushing and affect the operation reliability of the bushing. The research in this paper can provide reference for bushing operation in actual windy conditions.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of a New Flux-Concentrated Flux Reversal Machine with Consequent Poles
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Conventional flux reversal machine (FRM) has received a lot of attention due to the simple structure and easy thermal dissipation. In order to increase torque density and efficiency, this paper proposes a novel flux-concentrated flux reversal machine (FC-FRM) with V-shaped consequent poles. Moreover, the topology and working principle of the proposed FC-FRM are introduced. Then, different slot-pole combinations are analyzed. Finally, under the same permanent magnet volume and copper loss, the proposed FC-FRM is compared with the conventional structure. The results show that the proposed FC-FRM exhibits higher torque density, power factor and efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid DC Circuit Breaker Topology with Current Limiting Capability and Rapid Fault Isolation Time
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: When fault currents in Modular Multilevel Converter High Voltage Direct Current (MMC-HVDC) transmission systems rise too rapid, the DC circuit breakers (DCCBs) often have insufficient capacity. Therefore, this paper proposes a current-limited hybrid DC circuit breaker (CL-HCB) with fault current limiting and fast fault isolation of the dc grid to reduce the capacity requirement of the DCCB. The topology of the proposed CL-HCB discusses the operation process, metal-oxide arrester (MOA) properties, and parameter design. Besides, the energy dissipation circuit (EDC) is parallel to reduce the energy dissipation in MOA and decrease fault isolation time (FIT), which could reduce the thermal effects of the MOA and improve its reliability. Extensive simulation results verify the working principle and advantages of the proposed CL-HCB. Compared to conventional HCB under the same simulation parameters, the proposed CL-HCB has more advantages in limiting fault current and fault isolation.

articleTitle: Improved Smooth Switching Scheme for Dual-Mode Converters
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: Due to the inability of a single grid-following control or grid-forming control to adequately adjust the converter to adapt to varying grid impedance, some studies have proposed a dual-mode control based on grid strength. Dual-mode converter employ grid-following control when the grid impedance is low and switch to grid-forming control as the impedance increases. This approach effectively resolves the instability issue of a single control mode when the grid impedance fluctuates. Achieving smooth switching between these two control modes is important in dual-mode control. Based on previous research, this article proposes an improved smooth switching scheme.

articleTitle: Inter-District Collaborative Linkage and Multi-Source Data Fusion of Smart Substation
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: The forward security isolation device, reverse security isolation device, vertical encryption authentication device, encryption authentication measures, firewall and other security measures have been set up in each section of the substation. The efficiency of system data interaction across security zones is low and the interoperability is difficult. It is urgent to carry out the research on cross-zone business collaboration. In addition, each professional system of the substation is arranged independently and its application functions are separated, resulting in each professional system of the substation becoming an information island; the professional systems are diverse and the collected data are crossed, resulting in massive data and redundant information, which makes the management and control of substation data information more difficult, and information fusion is an effective way to solve the above problems.

Author Keywords: system data interaction across security zones

articleTitle: Noise Analysis and Suppression for High Accuracy Current Sampling in Motor Control
publicationTitle: 2024 IEEE 7th International Electrical and Energy Conference (CIEEC)
abstract: High-performance motor control requires high-precision sampling currents, but feedback noise can significantly deteriorate the quality of sampled currents. In this paper, the effect of noise on the current loop is analysed in detail and an effective suppression strategy is proposed. Firstly, the propagation of noise is analysed and modelled, and secondly, the oversampling suppression strategy of traditional SAR ADC is discussed.In addition, the oversampling technique based on the new Sigma delta ADC further improves the sampling accuracy.
